Spoon marinara over each cutlet and top with mozzarella.
Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until the cheese bubbles and the chicken is 165°F (74°C).
Serve over spaghetti with more sauce.

recipes.name: Chicken fettuccine Alfredo
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) boneless skinless chicken breasts (optional)
steps: Season the chicken with 1/2 teaspoon salt and cook in the oil over medium heat for 6 to 7 minutes per side, until 165°F (74°C). Rest and slice. Ask an adult to help.
Boil the fettuccine in salted water as the package says. Save 1/2 cup of pasta water and drain.
Melt the butter in a big pan over medium heat and add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the cream and simmer for 3 to 4 minutes, until slightly thick.
Turn the heat to low and stir in the parmesan until smooth.
Toss in the pasta, the rest of the salt and pepper, adding pasta water if it's too thick.
Top with the chicken and parsley.

recipes.name: Baked ziti
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) ground beef or Italian sausage
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Ask an adult to help.
Boil the pasta for 2 minutes less than the package says. Drain.
Cook the meat in a big pan over medium heat for 8 minutes, breaking it up, until browned. Drain the fat and stir in the marinara and tomato sauce.
Mix the ricotta, egg, half the parmesan and the seasoning.
Toss the pasta with the meat sauce.
Spread half in a 9 by 13 inch dish, dot with the ricotta mix and sprinkle with half the mozzarella.
Add the rest of the pasta and top with the rest of the mozzarella and parmesan.
Cover with foil and bake for 20 minutes, then uncover and bake for 15 minutes more, until bubbly.

recipes.name: Classic beef lasagna
steps: Chop the onion and garlic. Ask an adult to help.
Cook the beef, sausage and onion in a big pot over medium heat for 10 minutes, until browned. Drain the fat.
Add the garlic, tomatoes, tomato paste, water, seasoning and 1 teaspoon salt and simmer for 30 minutes.
Boil the noodles as the package says, drain and lay them flat on oiled foil.
Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
Mix the ricotta, egg, half the parmesan and the rest of the salt.
In a 9 by 13 inch dish, layer: 1 cup sauce, 4 noodles, a third of the ricotta, a quarter of the mozzarella, sauce. Repeat twice, then finish with sauce, mozzarella and parmesan.
Cover with foil (sprayed so it won't stick) and bake for 25 minutes, then uncover and bake for 25 minutes more, until bubbly.
Rest for 15 minutes before cutting.

recipes.name: Spaghetti carbonara
ingredients: 6 oz (170 g) guanciale, pancetta or thick bacon, diced
1 cup (100 g) finely grated pecorino or parmesan, plus more to serve
steps: Dice the bacon. Ask an adult to help.
Whisk the eggs, yolk, cheese and pepper in a bowl.
Boil the spaghetti in salted water as the package says. Save 1 cup of pasta water.
Cook the bacon in a big pan over medium heat for 6 to 8 minutes, until crisp. Turn off the heat.
Add the drained hot pasta to the bacon pan and toss.
Wait 1 minute, then pour in the egg mix and 1/4 cup of pasta water and toss fast with tongs.
Keep tossing, adding splashes of pasta water, until creamy and glossy. The heat of the pasta cooks the eggs into a sauce. If it looks runny, warm over very low heat for 30 seconds while tossing.
Serve right away with more cheese and pepper.

recipes.name: Cacio e pepe
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups (150 g) very finely grated Pecorino Romano
steps: Boil the pasta in a smaller amount of salted water than usual so the water gets starchy. Cook for 1 minute less than the package says.
Toast the pepper in a big dry pan over medium heat for 1 minute.
Add 1/2 cup of pasta water and the butter to the pepper.
Scoop 1/2 cup more pasta water into a bowl and let it cool for 1 minute, then whisk in the cheese to a smooth paste.
Move the pasta into the pepper pan with tongs and toss for 1 minute. Ask an adult to help.
Take the pan off the heat, add the cheese paste and toss fast, adding pasta water until creamy.
Serve right away.

recipes.name: Spaghetti aglio e olio
steps: Slice the garlic thinly. Ask an adult to help.
Boil the spaghetti in salted water as the package says. Save 1 cup of pasta water.
Put the oil and garlic in a big cold pan and heat over medium-low heat for 4 to 5 minutes, until the garlic is light golden. Don't let it go brown or it turns bitter.
Add the chili flakes for 10 seconds, then 1/2 cup pasta water.
Add the drained pasta, parsley and salt and toss for 1 minute, adding more water until glossy.
Serve with parmesan.

recipes.name: Pasta primavera
steps: Cut all the vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Boil the pasta in salted water as the package says. Add the broccoli for the last 2 minutes. Save 1 cup of pasta water and drain.
Heat the oil in a big pan over medium-high heat and cook the zucchini and pepper for 5 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, peas and garlic for 2 minutes.
Add the pasta, broccoli, butter, parmesan, lemon zest and juice, salt and 1/2 cup pasta water.
Toss until glossy and serve with more parmesan.

recipes.name: Creamy penne alla vodka
ingredients: 1 small onion or shallot, finely chopped
1/4 cup (60 ml) vodka, or use pasta water instead
steps: Chop the onion and garlic. Ask an adult to help.
Boil the penne in salted water as the package says. Save 1 cup of pasta water.
Melt the butter in a big pan over medium heat and cook the onion for 4 minutes. Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the tomato paste and cook for 3 to 4 minutes, stirring, until it turns darker red.
Add the vodka (an adult should do this, away from the flame) and simmer for 1 minute.
Stir in the cream, salt and chili flakes.
Add the pasta, parmesan and splashes of pasta water and toss until silky. Top with basil.

recipes.name: Mushroom risotto
ingredients: 6 cups (1.4 liters) chicken or vegetable broth
1/2 cup (120 ml) white wine or more broth
steps: Keep the broth warm in a pot over low heat.
Slice the mushrooms and chop the onion and garlic. Ask an adult to help.
Cook the mushrooms in 1 tablespoon butter and the oil in a big pan over medium-high heat for 6 to 8 minutes, until browned. Lift out.
Melt 1 tablespoon butter and cook the onion for 4 minutes. Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the rice and stir for 2 minutes. Add the wine and stir until absorbed.
Add 1 ladle of warm broth and stir until it's mostly absorbed. Keep adding broth one ladle at a time, stirring often, for 18 to 22 minutes, until the rice is creamy but still a little firm.
Stir in the mushrooms, the rest of the butter, parmesan and salt.

recipes.name: Baked eggplant parmesan
ingredients: 2 medium eggplants, sliced into 1/2 inch rounds
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Ask an adult to help slice the eggplant.
Sprinkle the slices with salt, wait 15 minutes, then pat dry.
Mix the panko, half the parmesan and the seasoning.
Dip each slice in egg, then the crumbs, and lay on 2 oiled baking sheets. Spray the tops.
Bake for 20 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden.
Turn the oven to 375°F (190°C). Layer sauce, eggplant, mozzarella and parmesan in a 9 by 13 inch dish, twice over, ending with sauce and cheese.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, until bubbly. Rest for 10 minutes and top with basil.

recipes.name: Spinach and ricotta stuffed shells
ingredients: 1 package (10 oz / 285 g) frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed dry
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Ask an adult to help.
Boil the shells for 2 minutes less than the package says. Drain and lay them apart on a tray so they don't stick.
Mix the ricotta, spinach, 1 cup mozzarella, half the parmesan, egg, garlic and salt.
Spread 1 cup of marinara in a 9 by 13 inch dish.
Fill each shell with a heaping spoonful of the filling and set it in the dish.
Pour the rest of the sauce over and top with the rest of the cheeses.
Cover with foil and bake for 25 minutes, then uncover and bake for 10 minutes more, until bubbly.

recipes.name: Homemade potato gnocchi
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups (160 g) all-purpose flour, plus more for dusting
steps: Bake the whole potatoes at 400°F (200°C) for 50 to 60 minutes, until soft. Ask an adult to help.
While still hot, cut in half, scoop out the insides and mash or rice until smooth with no lumps. Let cool for 10 minutes.
Mix in the egg yolk and salt, then the flour, and knead gently for 1 minute into a soft dough. Don't overwork it.
Roll pieces into ropes 3/4 inch thick and cut into 1 inch pieces.
Boil the gnocchi in salted water in batches. When they float, cook for 1 minute more, then lift out with a slotted spoon.
Melt the butter in a pan over medium heat with the sage for 2 to 3 minutes, until nutty and golden.
Toss the gnocchi in the butter for 1 minute and top with parmesan.

recipes.name: Italian sausage and peppers
ingredients: Hoagie rolls or cooked pasta to serve
steps: Slice the peppers, onion and garlic. Ask an adult to help.
Brown the sausages in the oil in a big pan over medium heat for 8 to 10 minutes, turning. Lift them out.
Cook the peppers and onion in the pan for 8 minutes, until soft.
Add the garlic, oregano and salt for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes if using, and put the sausages back.
Cover and simmer for 10 to 12 minutes, until the sausages are 160°F (71°C) inside.
Serve in rolls or over pasta.

recipes.name: Chicken piccata
ingredients: 2 large boneless skinless chicken breasts, sliced in half sideways
steps: Slice the chicken into thin cutlets. Ask an adult to help.
Season with salt and pepper and dust with flour. Wash your hands.
Heat the oil and 1 tablespoon butter in a big pan over medium-high heat.
Cook the chicken for 3 to 4 minutes per side, until golden and 165°F (74°C). Move to a plate.
Turn the heat to medium, add the garlic for 30 seconds, then the broth, lemon juice and capers.
Simmer for 3 to 4 minutes, scraping the pan, until reduced by half.
Turn off the heat and swirl in the rest of the butter.
Put the chicken back, spoon the sauce over, and top with parsley.

recipes.name: Chicken marsala
ingredients: 2 large boneless skinless chicken breasts, sliced in half sideways
3/4 cup (180 ml) dry Marsala wine, or chicken broth plus 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar
steps: Slice the chicken into thin cutlets and the mushrooms. Ask an adult to help.
Season the chicken with salt, dust with flour, and wash your hands.
Heat the oil and 1 tablespoon butter in a big pan over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 3 to 4 minutes per side, until 165°F (74°C). Move to a plate.
Add 1 tablespoon butter and the mushrooms and cook for 6 minutes, until browned. Add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Pour in the Marsala (an adult should do this) and simmer for 2 minutes.
Add the broth and simmer for 4 minutes, until reduced. Stir in the cream and the rest of the butter.
Put the chicken back to warm for 1 minute and top with parsley.

recipes.name: Chicken cacciatore
steps: Season the chicken with salt and pepper. Wash your hands.
Slice the vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium-high heat and brown the chicken skin side down for 5 minutes per side. Lift it out.
Cook the onion, pepper and mushrooms for 6 minutes. Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, broth, oregano and rosemary and put the chicken back.
Cover and simmer for 30 to 35 minutes, until the chicken is 165°F (74°C).
Add the olives and serve with pasta, polenta or bread.

recipes.name: Pasta puttanesca
ingredients: 1 can (28 oz / 800 g) whole peeled tomatoes, crushed by hand
1/2 cup (70 g) pitted black olives, halved
steps: Slice the garlic. Ask an adult to help.
Boil the spaghetti in salted water as the package says.
Heat the oil in a big pan over medium heat and cook the garlic, anchovies and chili flakes for 2 minutes, mashing the anchovies.
Add the tomatoes, olives and capers and simmer for 12 to 15 minutes, until thick.
Toss the drained spaghetti in the sauce with a splash of pasta water.
Top with parsley.

recipes.name: Pasta pomodoro
ingredients: 1 can (28 oz / 800 g) whole San Marzano tomatoes
steps: Slice the garlic. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pan over medium heat and cook the garlic for 1 to 2 minutes, until just golden.
Add the tomatoes and crush them with a potato masher. Add the salt and chili flakes.
Simmer for 20 minutes, stirring, until thick.
Boil the spaghetti in salted water as the package says, then drain.
Toss the spaghetti with the sauce, butter and torn basil. Serve with parmesan.

recipes.name: Pasta all'amatriciana
ingredients: 6 oz (170 g) guanciale or pancetta, cut in strips
steps: Cut the guanciale and slice the onion. Ask an adult to help.
Cook the guanciale in the oil in a big pan over medium heat for 6 to 8 minutes, until crisp at the edges.
Add the onion and chili flakes and cook for 3 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and salt and simmer for 15 minutes.
Boil the pasta in salted water as the package says.
Toss the pasta in the sauce with half the pecorino and a splash of pasta water.
Serve with the rest of the cheese.

recipes.name: Cheese and pepperoni calzones
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) pizza dough, store-bought or homemade
1 cup (240 ml) marinara sauce, warm, for dipping
steps: Heat the oven to 450°F (230°C). Ask an adult to help.
Mix the ricotta, mozzarella, parmesan and seasoning.
Split the dough into 4 pieces and roll each into an 8 inch circle.
Put a quarter of the cheese and pepperoni on half of each circle, leaving a 1 inch border.
Fold over and pinch and roll the edges to seal.
Set on a lined sheet, brush with egg and cut 2 small slits on top.
Bake for 15 to 18 minutes, until golden brown.
Cool for 5 minutes and serve with marinara for dipping.

recipes.name: Shrimp scampi with linguine
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) large shrimp, peeled and deveined
1/2 cup (120 ml) white wine or chicken broth
steps: Chop the garlic. Ask an adult to help.
Boil the linguine in salted water as the package says. Save 1/2 cup pasta water.
Season the shrimp with salt. Heat the oil in a big pan over medium-high heat and cook the shrimp for 1 to 2 minutes per side, until pink. Move to a plate.
Turn the heat to medium, melt the butter and cook the garlic and chili flakes for 1 minute.
Add the wine and lemon juice and simmer for 2 minutes.
Add the linguine, shrimp, zest, parsley and pasta water and toss until glossy.

recipes.name: Creamy Tuscan chicken
ingredients: 4 thin boneless skinless chicken breasts or cutlets
1/2 cup (55 g) sun dried tomatoes, chopped
steps: Season the chicken with salt and seasoning. Wash your hands.
Heat the oil in a big pan over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 5 to 6 minutes per side, until 165°F (74°C). Move to a plate.
Chop the garlic and sun dried tomatoes. Ask an adult to help.
Turn the heat to medium and cook the garlic and tomatoes for 1 minute.
Add the cream and broth and simmer for 3 minutes.
Stir in the parmesan and spinach until wilted.
Put the chicken back and spoon the sauce over. Serve with pasta or bread.

recipes.name: Coq au vin
ingredients: 3 lb (1.4 kg) bone-in chicken thighs and drumsticks
2 cups (480 ml) dry red wine, or chicken broth with 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar
steps: Season the chicken. Chop the bacon and vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Cook the bacon in a big heavy pot over medium heat for 6 minutes, until crisp. Lift it out.
Brown the chicken in the bacon fat for 5 minutes per side. Lift it out.
Cook the onion, carrots and mushrooms for 6 minutes. Add the garlic, flour and tomato paste for 1 minute.
Add the wine and broth, scraping the pot. The alcohol cooks off as it simmers.
Add the chicken, bacon, thyme and bay leaves, cover and simmer on low for 1 hour, until the chicken is very tender and well over 165°F (74°C).
Take out the herbs and serve with mashed potatoes or bread.

recipes.name: Beef bourguignon
ingredients: 3 lb (1.4 kg) beef chuck, cut in 2 inch cubes
3 cups (720 ml) dry red wine, or beef broth with 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar
steps: Heat the oven to 325°F (165°C). Ask an adult to help.
Pat the beef dry and season with salt and pepper.
Cook the bacon in a big oven-safe pot over medium heat for 6 minutes. Lift it out.
Add the oil and brown the beef in 3 batches for 5 minutes each. Lift it out.
Cook the carrots and onion for 5 minutes. Add the garlic, tomato paste and flour for 1 minute.
Add the wine, broth, thyme, bay leaves, beef and bacon and bring to a simmer.
Cover and bake for 2 hours 30 minutes to 3 hours, until the beef is fork tender.
Brown the mushrooms and pearl onions in the butter for 8 minutes and stir them into the stew. Take out the herbs.

recipes.name: Bratwurst with sauerkraut and onions
ingredients: 1 cup (240 ml) chicken broth or apple juice
steps: Slice the onion and apple. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pan over medium heat and brown the bratwurst for 6 to 8 minutes, turning. Lift them out.
Cook the onion and apple in the pan for 6 minutes, until soft.
Add the sauerkraut, broth and caraway and nestle the bratwurst back in.
Cover and simmer for 15 minutes, until the bratwurst are 160°F (71°C) inside.
Serve in buns with the sauerkraut and onions and lots of mustard.

recipes.name: Baked chicken cordon bleu
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Put each breast between plastic wrap and pound it to an even 1/4 inch thick.
Season with salt and pepper and lay a slice of ham and cheese on each.
Roll up tightly and close with toothpicks.
Coat each roll in flour, then egg, then panko. Wash your hands.
Set on a lined baking sheet and drizzle with the melted butter.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes, until golden and 165°F (74°C) in the middle.
Take out the toothpicks before serving.

recipes.name: Salmon in parchment
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Fold each sheet of parchment in half to make a crease, then open it.
Lay zucchini and tomatoes next to the crease, then a salmon fillet.
Season with salt and pepper and top with lemon slices, butter and dill.
Fold the paper over and crimp the edges in small folds to seal tightly.
Bake on a baking sheet for 12 to 15 minutes, until the salmon is 145°F (63°C).
Cut the packets open carefully at the table. Hot steam comes out.

recipes.name: Chicken and shrimp paella
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) boneless chicken thighs, cut in pieces
1 1/2 cups (300 g) short grain Spanish rice like bomba, or arborio
steps: Cut the chicken and vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big wide pan over medium-high heat and brown the chicken and chorizo for 6 minutes. Lift out.
Cook the onion and pepper for 5 minutes. Add the garlic, paprika and saffron for 1 minute.
Stir in the rice for 1 minute, then add the tomatoes, broth, salt, chicken and chorizo.
Bring to a boil and spread the rice evenly. Don't stir from now on.
Simmer for 15 minutes, until most of the liquid is gone.
Push the shrimp into the rice and scatter the peas. Cook for 5 to 8 minutes, until the shrimp are pink and the chicken is 165°F (74°C).
Turn the heat up for 1 to 2 minutes to crisp the bottom. Rest for 5 minutes and serve with lemon.

recipes.name: Pork schnitzel
ingredients: 2 large eggs, beaten with 1 tablespoon milk
steps: Put each chop between plastic wrap and pound it to 1/4 inch thick with a meat mallet or rolling pin.
Season with salt and pepper.
Coat each in flour, then egg, then breadcrumbs, without pressing hard. Wash your hands.
An adult heats 1/4 inch of oil and the butter in a big pan over medium-high heat.
Fry for 2 to 3 minutes per side, swirling the pan so oil washes over the top, until puffed and golden and cooked through. An adult should do the frying.
Drain on paper towels and serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.name: Swedish meatballs
steps: Soak the breadcrumbs in the milk for 5 minutes.
Mix in the meats, egg, onion, salt, allspice and nutmeg and roll into 1 inch balls. Wash your hands.
Brown the meatballs in the oil in a big pan over medium heat for 8 to 10 minutes, turning, until 160°F (71°C) inside. Lift out.
Melt the butter in the pan and whisk in the flour for 1 minute.
Slowly whisk in the broth, then the cream and Worcestershire, and simmer for 3 to 4 minutes, until thick.
Put the meatballs back for 2 minutes.
Serve with mashed potatoes or egg noodles and lingonberry jam.

recipes.name: Beef stroganoff
ingredients: 1 1/4 lb (570 g) sirloin steak, thinly sliced
steps: Slice the beef, onion and mushrooms. Ask an adult to help.
Season the beef and sear it in the oil in a big pan over high heat in 2 batches for 1 to 2 minutes, until browned. Lift it out.
Melt the butter over medium heat and cook the onion and mushrooms for 8 minutes. Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Stir in the flour for 1 minute, then whisk in the broth, Worcestershire and mustard.
Simmer for 3 to 4 minutes, until thick.
Turn the heat to low, stir in the sour cream, and add the beef to warm for 1 minute. Don't let it boil.
Serve over egg noodles.

recipes.name: Mushroom stroganoff
steps: Slice the mushrooms and onion. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil and butter in a big pan over medium-high heat and cook the mushrooms in 2 batches for 6 to 8 minutes, until browned. Lift out.
Cook the onion for 5 minutes, then add the garlic and paprika for 1 minute.
Stir in the flour, then whisk in the broth, soy sauce and mustard. Simmer for 3 minutes.
Put the mushrooms back, turn the heat to low and stir in the sour cream and salt.
Serve over noodles with parsley.

recipes.name: Potato and cheese pierogi
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) russet potatoes, peeled and cubed
steps: Mix the flour, salt, egg, sour cream, water and melted butter into a soft dough. Knead for 5 minutes, cover and rest for 30 minutes.
Boil the potatoes for 15 minutes, until soft. Drain and mash with the cheese and a pinch of salt. Cool.
Chop the onion and cook it in 2 tablespoons butter over medium heat for 10 minutes, until golden. Ask an adult to help.
Roll the dough 1/8 inch thick and cut 3 inch circles.
Put 1 tablespoon of filling on each, fold over and pinch the edges tightly shut.
Boil in batches in salted water. When they float, cook for 2 minutes more.
Fry the boiled pierogi in the rest of the butter for 2 minutes per side, until golden.
Top with the onions and serve with sour cream.

recipes.name: Chicken paprikash
ingredients: Egg noodles or dumplings to serve
steps: Season the chicken with salt. Chop the vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Brown the chicken in the oil in a big pot over medium-high heat for 5 minutes per side. Lift out.
Cook the onions and pepper for 8 minutes, until soft. Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Take the pot off the heat and stir in the paprika. It burns easily.
Add the tomato, broth and chicken, cover and simmer on low for 30 minutes, until 165°F (74°C).
Whisk the sour cream and flour, stir in a ladle of the hot sauce, then stir it all back into the pot.
Simmer gently for 2 minutes and serve over noodles.

recipes.name: Moussaka
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) ground lamb or beef
1 cup (100 g) grated parmesan or kefalotyri
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Brush the eggplant with oil, sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon salt and roast on sheet pans for 20 to 25 minutes, flipping once, until soft.
Cook the onion in 1 tablespoon oil in a big pan over medium heat for 5 minutes. Add the garlic and meat and cook for 8 minutes, until browned. Drain.
Add the tomatoes, tomato paste, cinnamon, oregano and 1/2 teaspoon salt and simmer for 15 minutes.

Melt the butter, whisk in the flour for 1 minute, then slowly whisk in the milk and simmer for 5 minutes, until thick. Off the heat, whisk in the yolks, nutmeg, the rest of the salt and half the cheese.
Turn the oven to 350°F (175°C). Layer half the eggplant, all the meat, the rest of the eggplant in a 9 by 13 inch dish.
Pour the white sauce over and sprinkle with the rest of the cheese.
Bake for 45 minutes, until golden. Rest for 20 minutes before cutting.

recipes.name: Chicken souvlaki skewers
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) boneless skinless chicken thighs or breasts, cut in 1 1/2 inch cubes
8 skewers (soak wooden ones in water for 30 minutes)
Pita, tzatziki, tomato and red onion to serve
steps: Cut the chicken into cubes. Ask an adult to help, and wash your hands after.
Mix the oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, salt and pepper and coat the chicken. Marinate in the fridge for 30 minutes to 4 hours.
Thread the chicken onto skewers.
Heat a grill pan or the broiler to high. An adult should do this.
Cook the skewers for 10 to 12 minutes, turning every few minutes, until charred and 165°F (74°C) inside.
Serve with pita, tzatziki, tomato and onion.

recipes.name: Greek lemon chicken and potatoes
ingredients: 2 lb (900 g) Yukon gold potatoes, cut in wedges
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Ask an adult to help cut the potatoes.
Whisk the oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, salt and pepper.
Toss the potatoes with half the mix in a big roasting pan and spread them out.
Coat the chicken with the rest and nestle it skin side up between the potatoes. Wash your hands.
Pour the broth around the potatoes.
Roast for 50 to 60 minutes, until the potatoes are tender and golden and the chicken is 175°F (79°C), safely past 165°F (74°C).
Spoon the pan juices over before serving.

recipes.name: Beef kofta kebabs
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) ground beef or lamb
Pita, tahini or yogurt sauce, and salad to serve
steps: Grate the onion and chop the parsley. Ask an adult to help.
Mix the meat, onion, parsley, garlic, spices, salt and pepper well with your hands.
Split into 8 pieces and squeeze each around a skewer into a long sausage shape. Wash your hands.
Chill for 15 minutes so they hold their shape.
Cook in a grill pan or under a broiler on high for 8 to 10 minutes, turning, until browned and 160°F (71°C) inside. An adult should help.
Serve with pita, sauce and salad.

recipes.name: Oven chicken shawarma
ingredients: 2 lb (900 g) boneless skinless chicken thighs
Pita, garlic sauce or tahini, pickles, tomato and lettuce
steps: Mix the oil, lemon juice, garlic, spices and salt and coat the chicken. Marinate in the fridge for 30 minutes to overnight. Wash your hands.
Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Ask an adult to help.
Spread the chicken and onion on a lined sheet pan.
Roast for 25 to 30 minutes, until charred at the edges and 165°F (74°C).
Rest for 5 minutes and slice thinly.
Wrap in warm pita with sauce, pickles, tomato and lettuce.

recipes.name: Joojeh kabab Persian saffron chicken
ingredients: 2 lb (900 g) boneless chicken thighs or breasts, cut in 1 1/2 inch pieces
1/2 teaspoon saffron threads, ground with a pinch of sugar
Rice and grilled tomatoes to serve
steps: Steep the ground saffron in the hot water for 10 minutes.
Mix the yogurt, onion, lemon juice, oil, salt and most of the saffron water and coat the chicken. Marinate in the fridge for at least 30 minutes, up to overnight. Wash your hands.
Thread the chicken onto skewers.
Heat the broiler or a grill pan to high. An adult should do this.
Cook for 10 to 12 minutes, turning, until charred and 165°F (74°C).
Mix the melted butter with the rest of the saffron water and brush over the chicken.
Serve with rice and grilled tomatoes.

recipes.name: Stuffed cabbage rolls
steps: An adult cuts the core out of the cabbage and boils the whole head in a big pot for 8 to 10 minutes, peeling off leaves with tongs as they soften. You need about 12.
Trim the thick rib on each leaf so it rolls easily.
Mix the meats, rice, onion, egg, salt and pepper. Wash your hands after.
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C).
Put 1/3 cup of filling on each leaf, fold in the sides and roll up.
Mix the tomatoes, tomato sauce, brown sugar and lemon juice. Spread a little in a baking dish.
Lay the rolls seam side down and pour the rest of the sauce over.
Cover with foil and bake for 1 hour 15 minutes, until the filling is 160°F (71°C).

recipes.name: Garlic rosemary lamb chops
ingredients: 8 lamb loin or rib chops, about 1 inch thick
steps: Mix 2 tablespoons oil, garlic, rosemary, salt and pepper and rub it on the chops. Let them sit for 15 minutes. Wash your hands.
Heat the rest of the oil in a heavy pan over medium-high heat. Ask an adult to help, it spatters.
Cook the chops for 3 to 4 minutes per side, until 145°F (63°C) inside.
Rest for 5 minutes and squeeze lemon over the top.

recipes.name: Baked chicken Kiev
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon salt, plus more for the chicken
steps: Mix the butter, garlic, herbs and salt, shape into 4 small logs on plastic wrap and freeze for 20 minutes.
Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Pound each breast to 1/4 inch thick between plastic wrap and season with salt.
Lay a butter log on each, roll up tightly and tuck in the sides so it's sealed.
Coat in flour, then egg, then panko. Dip in egg and panko a second time. Wash your hands.
Set seam side down on a lined sheet and spray with oil.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, until golden and 165°F (74°C). Rest for 5 minutes. Careful, hot butter pours out when you cut it.

recipes.name: Butter chicken
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) boneless skinless chicken thighs, cut in bite-size pieces
1 teaspoon chili powder (Kashmiri if you have it)
1 teaspoon garam masala, plus 1 teaspoon for the sauce
1 can (14.5 oz / 410 g) tomato puree or crushed tomatoes
1 teaspoon dried fenugreek leaves (kasuri methi), optional
Basmati rice and naan to serve
steps: Mix the chicken with the yogurt, ginger garlic paste, chili powder, 1 teaspoon garam masala and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Marinate for 30 minutes. Wash your hands.
Chop the onion and garlic. Ask an adult to help.
Melt 1 tablespoon butter in a big pan over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 6 to 8 minutes, until browned. Lift it out.
Melt the rest of the butter and cook the onion for 6 minutes. Add the garlic and ginger for 1 minute.
Add the tomato puree and simmer for 10 minutes.
Blend the sauce smooth, then put it back in the pan.
Stir in the cream, sugar, garam masala, fenugreek and the rest of the salt.
Add the chicken and simmer for 8 to 10 minutes, until 165°F (74°C). Serve with rice and naan.

recipes.name: Chicken tikka masala
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) boneless skinless chicken breast or thigh, cut in 1 1/2 inch pieces
steps: Mix the chicken with the yogurt, lemon juice, 1 teaspoon each garam masala and cumin, paprika and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Marinate for 1 hour. Wash your hands.
Heat the broiler to high. Ask an adult to help.
Lay the chicken on a foil-lined pan and broil for 8 to 10 minutes, turning once, until charred at the edges.
Heat the oil in a big pan over medium heat and cook the onion for 6 minutes. Add the garlic and ginger for 1 minute.
Add the coriander, chili powder and the rest of the garam masala and cumin for 30 seconds.
Add the tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in the cream, the rest of the salt and the chicken and simmer for 8 minutes, until the chicken is 165°F (74°C).
Top with cilantro and serve with rice and naan.

recipes.name: Chana masala
ingredients: 2 cans (15 oz / 425 g each) chickpeas, drained
steps: Chop the onion, garlic and chili. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat and add the cumin seeds for 30 seconds.
Add the onion and cook for 8 minutes, until golden.
Add the garlic, ginger and chili for 1 minute, then the ground spices for 30 seconds.
Add the tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the chickpeas, water and salt and simmer for 15 minutes, mashing a few chickpeas to thicken it.
Stir in the garam masala and lemon juice and top with cilantro. Serve with rice or roti.

recipes.name: Dal tadka
ingredients: 1 cup (200 g) yellow lentils (toor dal or moong dal), rinsed
steps: Simmer the lentils, water, turmeric and salt in a pot for 25 to 30 minutes, stirring now and then, until very soft. Whisk until creamy.
Add the tomato and simmer for 5 minutes. Add water if it's too thick.
Chop the onion and slice the garlic. Ask an adult to help.
For the tadka, heat the ghee in a small pan over medium heat and add the cumin seeds for 30 seconds.
Add the garlic, onion and chili and cook for 3 to 4 minutes, until golden.
Turn off the heat and stir in the chili powder and garam masala.
Pour the tadka over the dal. It sizzles. Top with cilantro and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Palak paneer
steps: Boil the spinach for 2 minutes, then drain and rinse with cold water. Blend into a smooth puree. Ask an adult to help.
Chop the onion, garlic and tomato.
Heat the ghee in a pan over medium heat and add the cumin seeds for 30 seconds.
Add the onion and cook for 6 minutes. Add the garlic, ginger and chili for 1 minute.
Add the tomato, coriander and garam masala and cook for 4 minutes.
Stir in the spinach puree, salt and 1/4 cup water and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the paneer and cream and simmer for 3 minutes. Serve with roti or rice.

recipes.name: Aloo gobi
steps: Cut the vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a wide pan over medium heat and add the cumin seeds for 30 seconds.
Add the onion and cook for 5 minutes. Add the ginger garlic paste and chili for 1 minute.
Add the tomato and ground spices and cook for 3 minutes.
Add the potatoes, cauliflower and salt and stir to coat.
Add 1/4 cup of water, cover, and cook on low for 18 to 20 minutes, stirring gently now and then, until tender.
Sprinkle with garam masala and cilantro.

recipes.name: Chicken biryani
ingredients: 2 lb (900 g) bone-in or boneless chicken thighs, cut in pieces
2 teaspoons biryani masala or garam masala
2 teaspoons salt, plus more for the rice water
2 cups (400 g) basmati rice, rinsed and soaked for 30 minutes
4 whole cardamom pods, 4 cloves, 1 cinnamon stick and 2 bay leaves
1/4 cup chopped mint and 1/4 cup chopped cilantro
1 pinch saffron soaked in 3 tablespoons warm milk
steps: Mix the chicken with the yogurt, ginger garlic paste, chili powder, turmeric, masala and salt. Marinate for 1 hour. Wash your hands.
Slice the onions thinly. Ask an adult to help.
Fry the onions in the ghee in a heavy pot over medium heat for 15 minutes, until deep golden. Lift out half for the top.
Add the chicken and marinade to the pot and cook for 15 minutes, until it's nearly cooked.
Boil the rice in lots of salted water with the whole spices for 5 to 6 minutes, until about 70% cooked. Drain.
Spread the mint and cilantro over the chicken, then layer the rice on top.
Drizzle with saffron milk and scatter the saved onions.
Cover tightly with foil and the lid and cook on very low heat for 25 minutes, until the rice is tender and the chicken is 165°F (74°C).
Rest for 5 minutes, then scoop gently from the bottom so each serving has rice and chicken.

recipes.name: Chicken korma
ingredients: 4 green cardamom pods and 1 cinnamon stick
1 1/2 lb (680 g) boneless chicken thighs, cut in pieces
steps: Soak the cashews in the hot water for 15 minutes, then blend into a smooth paste.
Chop the onion. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the ghee in a pot over medium heat with the cardamom and cinnamon for 30 seconds.
Add the onion and cook for 8 minutes, until soft and light golden. Add the ginger garlic paste for 1 minute.
Add the chicken, coriander, cumin, turmeric and salt and cook for 5 minutes.
Turn the heat to low and stir in the yogurt a spoonful at a time.
Add the cashew paste and 1/2 cup water, cover and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes, until the chicken is 165°F (74°C).
Stir in the cream, garam masala and sugar. Take out the whole spices and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Rajma kidney bean curry
ingredients: 2 tomatoes, pureed, or 1 cup (240 ml) crushed tomatoes
2 cans (15 oz / 425 g each) kidney beans, drained
steps: Chop the onion. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat and add the cumin seeds for 30 seconds.
Add the onion and cook for 8 minutes, until golden. Add the ginger garlic paste for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and spices and cook for 6 to 8 minutes, until the oil separates.
Add the beans, water and salt and simmer for 20 minutes, mashing some beans to thicken.
Stir in the garam masala, top with cilantro and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Keema matar
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) ground lamb, beef or chicken
steps: Chop the onion, chili and tomatoes. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pan over medium heat and cook the onion for 6 minutes.
Add the ginger garlic paste and chili for 1 minute.
Add the meat and cook for 8 minutes, breaking it up, until browned.
Add the tomatoes, spices and salt and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the peas and 1/2 cup water, cover and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in the garam masala and cilantro. Serve with roti, pav or rice.

recipes.name: Oven tandoori chicken
ingredients: 3 lb (1.4 kg) bone-in chicken legs and thighs, skin removed
2 teaspoons Kashmiri chili powder or paprika
Lemon wedges and sliced onion to serve
steps: Cut 2 to 3 deep slashes in each piece of chicken. Ask an adult to help.
Mix the yogurt, lemon juice, ginger garlic paste, spices, salt and oil and rub it into the slashes. Wash your hands.
Marinate in the fridge for at least 2 hours, or overnight.
Heat the oven to 450°F (230°C).
Set the chicken on a rack over a foil-lined pan.
Roast for 30 to 35 minutes, until charred in spots and 165°F (74°C) inside.
Serve with lemon wedges and onion.

recipes.name: Air fryer paneer tikka
ingredients: 14 oz (400 g) paneer, cut in 1 inch cubes
1 bell pepper, cut in 1 inch squares
1 teaspoon Kashmiri chili powder or paprika
steps: Cut the paneer and vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Mix the yogurt, lemon juice, ginger garlic paste, spices, salt and oil.
Gently coat the paneer and vegetables in it and marinate for 20 minutes.
Thread onto short skewers that fit your air fryer, or just lay the pieces in the basket.
Air fry at 400°F (200°C) for 8 to 10 minutes, turning halfway, until charred at the edges.
Serve with mint chutney and naan.

recipes.name: Egg curry
ingredients: 1/2 cup (120 ml) coconut milk or water
steps: Hard boil the eggs for 11 minutes, cool in ice water and peel. Ask an adult to help with the hot water.
Make 3 shallow slits in each egg so the sauce soaks in.
Chop the onion and tomatoes.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat and cook the onion for 8 minutes, until golden. Add the ginger garlic paste for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, turmeric, coriander, chili powder and salt and cook for 6 minutes, until soft.
Add the coconut milk and eggs and simmer for 5 minutes.
Sprinkle with garam masala and cilantro. Serve with rice or roti.

recipes.name: Goan fish curry
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) firm white fish like cod or tilapia, cut in chunks
1 teaspoon Kashmiri chili powder or paprika
1 tablespoon tamarind paste or lime juice
steps: Rub the fish with turmeric and 1/2 teaspoon salt.
Chop the onion and tomato. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a wide pan over medium heat and cook the onion for 6 minutes. Add the ginger garlic paste for 1 minute.
Add the spices for 30 seconds, then the tomato for 3 minutes.
Add the coconut milk, tamarind and the rest of the salt and simmer for 5 minutes.
Gently add the fish and simmer for 6 to 8 minutes, until it flakes and is 145°F (63°C). Don't stir too much or it breaks.
Top with cilantro and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Matar paneer
steps: Chop the onion and puree the tomatoes. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the ghee in a pan over medium heat and add the cumin seeds for 30 seconds.
Add the onion and cook for 7 minutes. Add the ginger garlic paste for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, spices and salt and cook for 6 minutes, until thick.
Add the peas and 1 cup water and simmer for 6 minutes.
Add the paneer, cream and garam masala and simmer for 3 minutes.

recipes.name: Baingan bharta
steps: Prick the eggplants with a fork. An adult roasts them over a gas flame or under the broiler for 15 to 20 minutes, turning, until black and collapsed.
Cool, peel off the skin and mash the flesh.
Chop the onion, chili and tomatoes.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat and add the cumin seeds for 30 seconds.
Add the onion and cook for 6 minutes. Add the ginger garlic paste and chili for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, spices and salt and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the mashed eggplant and cook for 8 minutes, stirring.
Stir in the garam masala and cilantro. Serve with roti.

recipes.name: Moong dal khichdi
ingredients: 1/2 cup (100 g) split yellow moong dal
1 cup (140 g) chopped vegetables like carrot, peas and potato (optional)
Plain yogurt and pickle to serve
steps: Rinse the rice and dal together until the water is clear.
Heat the ghee in a pot over medium heat and add the cumin seeds for 30 seconds.
Add the ginger, turmeric and vegetables and stir for 2 minutes.
Add the rice, dal, water and salt and bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer on low for 25 minutes, stirring now and then, until soft and porridge-like. Add hot water if it gets too thick.
Serve with a spoon of ghee, yogurt and pickle. It's a gentle comfort food.

recipes.name: Chickpea coconut curry
ingredients: 2 cans (15 oz / 425 g each) chickpeas, drained
steps: Chop the onion and garlic. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat and cook the onion for 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, ginger and curry powder for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, coconut milk, chickpeas and salt and simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in the spinach until wilted, then the lime juice.
Serve over rice with cilantro.

recipes.name: Sambar
ingredients: 3/4 cup (150 g) toor dal (split pigeon peas), rinsed
3 cups (720 ml) water, plus 1 cup for the vegetables
2 cups (280 g) mixed vegetables like carrot, eggplant, pumpkin and drumstick, chopped
steps: Simmer the dal, 3 cups water and turmeric for 30 minutes, until very soft. Mash smooth.
Chop the vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Cook the vegetables, onion and tomato in 1 cup water for 10 minutes, until tender.
Add the tamarind, sambar powder and salt and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the mashed dal and simmer for 5 minutes more.
Heat the oil in a small pan and add the mustard seeds. When they pop, add the curry leaves, chilies and asafoetida for 10 seconds.
Pour over the sambar and serve with rice, idli or dosa.

recipes.name: Lamb rogan josh
ingredients: 2 lb (900 g) boneless lamb shoulder, cut in 1 1/2 inch cubes
4 green cardamom pods, 4 cloves, 1 cinnamon stick and 2 bay leaves
2 teaspoons Kashmiri chili powder or paprika
steps: Chop the onions. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the ghee in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and add the whole spices for 30 seconds.
Add the lamb and brown for 8 minutes. Lift it out.
Cook the onions for 10 minutes, until golden. Add the ginger garlic paste for 1 minute.
Turn the heat to low and stir in the ground spices and salt, then the yogurt, a spoonful at a time.
Add the lamb and water, cover and simmer on low for 1 hour 15 minutes to 1 hour 30 minutes, until very tender.
Stir in the garam masala, take out the whole spices, and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Pork vindaloo
ingredients: 2 1/2 lb (1.1 kg) boneless pork shoulder, cut in 1 1/2 inch cubes
1/3 cup (80 ml) apple cider or white vinegar
2 teaspoons Kashmiri chili powder, plus cayenne to taste
steps: Blend the vinegar, garlic, ginger, spices and salt into a paste.
Coat the pork in the paste and marinate in the fridge for at least 1 hour. Wash your hands.
Chop the onions. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a heavy pot over medium heat and cook the onions for 10 minutes, until golden.
Add the pork and all the marinade and cook for 5 minutes, stirring.
Add the brown sugar and water, cover and simmer on low for 1 hour 30 minutes, until very tender.
Simmer uncovered for 10 minutes to thicken. Serve with rice. It's spicy, so use less cayenne for kids.

recipes.name: Chicken pad thai
ingredients: 8 oz (225 g) flat rice noodles (pad thai noodles)
2 tablespoons tamarind paste, or 3 tablespoons lime juice
12 oz (340 g) boneless chicken, thinly sliced, or shrimp
4 green onions, cut in 1 inch pieces
steps: Soak the noodles in hot tap water for 20 to 30 minutes, until soft but firm. Drain.
Stir the fish sauce, sugar, tamarind and soy sauce until the sugar dissolves.
Slice the chicken and chop the garlic. Ask an adult to help.
Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a wok over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 4 to 5 minutes, until 165°F (74°C). Lift out.
Add 1 tablespoon oil and the garlic for 30 seconds. Push aside, add the last of the oil and scramble the eggs for 1 minute.
Add the noodles and sauce and toss for 2 to 3 minutes, until the noodles soak it up.
Add the chicken, bean sprouts and green onions and toss for 1 minute.
Top with peanuts and serve with lime and chili flakes.

recipes.name: Thai green curry
ingredients: 2 cans (13.5 oz / 400 ml each) coconut milk
1 1/2 lb (680 g) boneless chicken thighs, thinly sliced
1 cup (100 g) Thai eggplant or zucchini, cut in chunks
1 cup (100 g) green beans, cut in pieces
steps: Slice the chicken and cut the vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat and fry the curry paste for 1 minute.
Add 1/2 can of coconut milk and simmer for 3 minutes, until the oil starts to separate.
Add the chicken and stir for 3 minutes.
Add the rest of the coconut milk, vegetables, fish sauce, sugar and lime leaves.
Simmer for 10 minutes, until the chicken is 165°F (74°C) and the vegetables are tender.
Stir in the basil and serve over jasmine rice.

recipes.name: Thai red curry
ingredients: 2 cans (13.5 oz / 400 ml each) coconut milk
1 1/2 lb (680 g) boneless chicken breast or thigh, thinly sliced
1 can (8 oz / 225 g) bamboo shoots, drained
steps: Slice the chicken and pepper. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat and fry the curry paste for 1 minute.
Add 1/2 can coconut milk and simmer for 3 minutes.
Add the chicken and cook for 3 minutes.
Add the rest of the coconut milk, pepper, bamboo shoots, fish sauce and sugar.
Simmer for 10 minutes, until the chicken is 165°F (74°C).
Stir in the basil and a squeeze of lime. Serve over rice.

recipes.name: Massaman curry
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) beef chuck, cut in 1 1/2 inch cubes
2 cans (13.5 oz / 400 ml each) coconut milk
1 lb (450 g) potatoes, cut in chunks
2 tablespoons tamarind paste or lime juice
steps: Cut the beef and vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a heavy pot over medium heat and fry the curry paste for 1 minute.
Add 1 can of coconut milk and simmer for 3 minutes.
Add the beef, water and cinnamon, cover and simmer on low for 50 minutes.
Add the potatoes, onion, peanuts and the second can of coconut milk.
Simmer for 25 to 30 minutes, until the beef and potatoes are tender.
Stir in the fish sauce, sugar and tamarind. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Panang chicken curry
ingredients: 3 tablespoons panang or red curry paste
1 1/2 lb (680 g) boneless chicken, thinly sliced
Thai basil and rice to serve
steps: Slice the chicken and pepper. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat and fry the curry paste for 1 minute.
Add half the coconut milk and simmer for 3 minutes.
Add the chicken and cook for 4 minutes.
Add the rest of the coconut milk, peanut butter, fish sauce, sugar and pepper.
Simmer for 6 to 8 minutes, until thick and the chicken is 165°F (74°C).
Top with lime leaves and basil and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Pad kra pao Thai basil chicken
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) ground chicken or finely chopped thighs
2 tablespoons vegetable oil, plus more for the eggs
2 cups (40 g) holy basil or Thai basil leaves
steps: Chop the garlic, chilies and shallot. Ask an adult to help.
Mix the oyster sauce, soy sauce, fish sauce, sugar and water.
Heat the oil in a wok over high heat and stir-fry the garlic, chilies and shallot for 30 seconds.
Add the chicken and cook for 5 to 6 minutes, breaking it up, until no pink is left and 165°F (74°C).
Add the sauce and toss for 1 minute.
Turn off the heat and stir in the basil until wilted.
Fry the eggs in hot oil for 2 minutes, until crispy at the edges. Serve the chicken over rice with an egg on top.

recipes.name: Pad see ew
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) fresh wide rice noodles, or 8 oz (225 g) dried, soaked
12 oz (340 g) boneless chicken, thinly sliced
4 cups (300 g) Chinese broccoli (gai lan) or broccoli, cut in pieces
steps: Separate the fresh noodles, or soak dried ones in hot water until soft. Drain.
Mix the oyster sauce, soy sauces and sugar.
Slice the chicken and greens. Ask an adult to help.
Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a wok over high heat and cook the chicken and garlic for 4 to 5 minutes, until 165°F (74°C). Add the greens for 2 minutes. Lift out.
Add the rest of the oil and scramble the eggs for 30 seconds.
Add the noodles and sauce and toss, letting them sit for 30 seconds at a time to char a little.
Add the chicken and greens back and toss for 1 minute.

recipes.name: Thai pineapple fried rice
ingredients: 4 cups (700 g) cold cooked jasmine rice
8 oz (225 g) shrimp or diced chicken
1/2 cup (70 g) frozen peas and carrots
steps: Chop the garlic and onion. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a wok over high heat and cook the shrimp for 2 minutes, until pink. Lift out.
Cook the garlic and onion for 1 minute. Push aside and scramble the eggs for 1 minute.
Add the rice, curry powder, soy sauce and fish sauce and toss for 3 minutes.
Add the pineapple, peas and carrots, shrimp and cashews and toss for 2 minutes, until hot.
Top with green onions. Serve in a hollowed pineapple for fun.

recipes.name: Chicken satay with peanut sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) boneless chicken thighs, cut in long strips
1/2 cup (120 ml) coconut milk, plus 3/4 cup (180 ml) for the sauce
1 tablespoon fish sauce or soy sauce
steps: Mix 1/2 cup coconut milk, curry powder, turmeric, sugar and fish sauce and coat the chicken. Marinate for 30 minutes. Wash your hands.
Thread the chicken onto skewers.
Simmer 3/4 cup coconut milk, peanut butter, curry paste, lime juice and honey for 3 minutes, whisking, for the peanut sauce.
Heat the broiler or a grill pan to high. An adult should do this.
Cook the skewers for 4 to 5 minutes per side, until charred and 165°F (74°C).
Serve with peanut sauce, cucumber and rice.

recipes.name: Khao man gai Thai chicken and rice
ingredients: 2 lb (900 g) bone-in, skin-on chicken thighs
2 inch piece ginger, sliced, plus 1 tablespoon grated for the sauce
4 garlic cloves, smashed, plus 2 chopped for the rice
Sauce: 3 tablespoons soy sauce, 1 tablespoon fermented soybean paste or miso, 1 tablespoon vinegar, 1 tablespoon sugar, grated ginger and 1 chili
steps: Put the chicken, water, sliced ginger, smashed garlic and salt in a pot and bring to a boil.
Turn the heat to low and simmer gently for 25 to 30 minutes, until the chicken is 165°F (74°C).
Lift the chicken into ice water for 5 minutes so the skin gets tight, then drain. Keep the broth.
Heat the oil in a pot and cook the chopped garlic for 1 minute. Add the rice and stir for 1 minute.
Add 2 1/2 cups of the chicken broth, cover and cook on low for 18 minutes. Rest for 10 minutes.
Mix the sauce ingredients.
Slice the chicken. Ask an adult to help.
Serve the chicken on the rice with cucumber, cilantro, sauce and a bowl of hot broth.

recipes.name: Chicken larb
ingredients: 2 tablespoons uncooked sticky or jasmine rice
1/4 cup (60 ml) chicken broth or water
Lettuce leaves, cucumber and sticky rice to serve
steps: Toast the rice in a dry pan over medium heat for 5 to 6 minutes, until golden. Grind it to a coarse powder.
Slice the shallots and green onions. Ask an adult to help.
Cook the chicken in the broth in a pan over medium heat for 6 to 8 minutes, breaking it up, until 165°F (74°C).
Turn off the heat and stir in the lime juice, fish sauce, sugar and chili flakes.
Add the shallots, green onions, herbs and rice powder and toss.
Serve in lettuce cups with cucumber and sticky rice.

recipes.name: Thai cashew chicken
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) boneless chicken, cut in bite-size pieces
1 red bell pepper, cut in chunks
steps: Cut the chicken and vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Toss the chicken with the cornstarch. Wash your hands.
Mix the oyster sauce, soy sauce, fish sauce, honey and water.
Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a wok over high heat and cook the chicken for 5 to 6 minutes, until golden and 165°F (74°C). Lift out.
Add the rest of the oil and stir-fry the onion, pepper, garlic and chilies for 2 minutes.
Add the chicken, sauce and cashews and toss for 1 minute, until glossy.
Add the green onions and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Thit kho caramelized pork and eggs
ingredients: 2 lb (900 g) pork belly or shoulder, cut in 1 1/2 inch cubes
Rice and pickled vegetables to serve
steps: Mix the pork with the fish sauce, garlic and shallots and marinate for 20 minutes. Ask an adult to help cut the pork.
In a heavy pot over medium heat, cook the sugar and water without stirring for 4 to 5 minutes, until dark amber. An adult should do this, caramel is very hot.
Add the pork and stir to coat in the caramel. Cook for 5 minutes.
Add the coconut water and enough water to just cover the pork. Bring to a boil and skim.
Cover partly and simmer on low for 1 hour.
Add the eggs and simmer uncovered for 20 to 30 minutes more, until the pork is tender and the sauce is a little thick.
Sprinkle with pepper and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Vietnamese lemongrass chicken
ingredients: 2 stalks lemongrass, very finely chopped, or 3 tablespoons lemongrass paste
Rice, cucumber and cilantro to serve
steps: Chop the lemongrass, garlic and shallots very finely. Ask an adult to help.
Mix them with the fish sauce, sugar, soy sauce and turmeric and coat the chicken. Marinate for 30 minutes. Wash your hands.
Heat the oil in a big pan over medium heat.
Cook the chicken for 6 to 7 minutes per side, until caramelized and 165°F (74°C).
Rest for 5 minutes and slice.
Serve over rice with cucumber, cilantro and chili.

recipes.name: Bo luc lac shaking beef
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) sirloin or ribeye, cut in 1 inch cubes
Dipping sauce: juice of 1 lime, 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1/2 teaspoon pepper
steps: Cut the beef and onion. Ask an adult to help.
Mix the oyster sauce, soy sauce, fish sauce, sugar, half the garlic and pepper and coat the beef. Marinate for 20 minutes.
Heat the oil in a big pan over high heat until it shimmers.
Add the beef in one layer and let it sear for 1 minute without moving.
Shake the pan to turn the cubes and cook for 1 to 2 minutes more, until browned outside and pink inside, or longer if you like it more done.
Add the butter, onion and the rest of the garlic and toss for 1 minute.
Serve on watercress and tomato with lime pepper salt for dipping.

recipes.name: Filipino chicken adobo
ingredients: 2 1/2 lb (1.1 kg) bone-in chicken thighs and drumsticks
1/2 cup (120 ml) white or cane vinegar
steps: Put the chicken, soy sauce, vinegar, water, garlic, bay leaves, peppercorns and sugar in a pot.
Bring to a boil and don't stir for the first 5 minutes, so the vinegar mellows.
Cover and simmer on low for 30 minutes, until the chicken is tender and 165°F (74°C).
Lift the chicken out and pat dry.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium-high heat and brown the chicken for 3 minutes per side. Ask an adult to help, it spatters.
Boil the sauce for 8 to 10 minutes, until reduced by half.
Pour the sauce over the chicken and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Filipino sweet spaghetti
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) ground beef or pork
steps: Chop the onion and garlic and slice the hot dogs. Ask an adult to help.
Boil the spaghetti as the package says and drain.
Heat the oil in a big pan over medium heat and cook the onion and garlic for 4 minutes.
Add the meat and cook for 8 minutes, until browned. Drain the fat.
Add the hot dogs, banana ketchup, tomato sauce, sugar and salt and simmer for 15 minutes.
Spoon the sauce over the spaghetti and pile on the cheese.

recipes.name: Bistek tagalog
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) beef sirloin, very thinly sliced
1/4 cup (60 ml) lemon or calamansi juice
steps: Slice the beef and onions. Ask an adult to help.
Mix the soy sauce, juice, garlic and pepper and coat the beef. Marinate for 30 minutes.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium-high heat and cook the onion rings for 2 minutes, until just soft. Lift out.
Lift the beef from the marinade and brown it in batches for 1 to 2 minutes per side. Lift out.
Add the marinade, water and sugar to the pan and simmer for 3 minutes.
Add the beef back and simmer for 5 minutes, until tender.
Top with the onion rings and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Chicken afritada
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups (360 ml) water or chicken broth
1 red and 1 green bell pepper, cut in chunks
steps: Cut the vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium-high heat and brown the chicken for 4 minutes per side. Lift it out.
Cook the onion and garlic for 4 minutes.
Add the chicken, tomato sauce, water and fish sauce and bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the potatoes and carrots and simmer for 15 minutes.
Add the peppers, peas and sugar and simmer for 5 minutes, until the chicken is 165°F (74°C). Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Beef rendang
ingredients: 2 1/2 lb (1.1 kg) beef chuck, cut in 1 1/2 inch cubes
6 dried red chilies, soaked, or 2 tablespoons sambal oelek
2 stalks lemongrass, bashed and tied in a knot
2 cans (13.5 oz / 400 ml each) coconut milk
steps: Blend the shallots, garlic, ginger, galangal and chilies into a paste. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a heavy pot over medium heat and fry the paste for 5 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the beef, lemongrass, lime leaves, cinnamon and star anise and stir for 3 minutes.
Add the coconut milk, tamarind, sugar and salt and bring to a boil.
Simmer uncovered on low for 2 hours 30 minutes to 3 hours, stirring more often near the end, until the sauce is dark, thick and clings to the very tender beef.
Stir in the toasted coconut. Take out the lemongrass and whole spices. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Nasi lemak
ingredients: 2 pandan leaves, knotted, or 1 slice ginger
1/2 cup (30 g) fried anchovies (ikan bilis), optional
1/2 cup (120 ml) sambal or chili paste
Fried chicken or chicken curry to serve (optional)
steps: Put the rice, coconut milk, water, salt and pandan in a pot and bring to a boil.
Cover and cook on low for 18 minutes, then rest for 10 minutes. Take out the pandan and fluff.
Slice the cucumber and halve the eggs. Ask an adult to help.
Shape a scoop of rice on each plate.
Arrange the eggs, peanuts, anchovies, cucumber and a spoon of sambal around it.
Add fried chicken or curry for a bigger meal.

recipes.name: Thai peanut chicken noodles
ingredients: 12 oz (340 g) linguine or rice noodles
1 lb (450 g) boneless chicken breast, thinly sliced
Chopped peanuts, cilantro and green onions
steps: Slice the chicken and vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Boil the noodles as the package says and drain.
Whisk the peanut butter, soy sauce, honey, lime juice, sriracha, garlic and hot water until smooth.
Heat the oil in a big pan over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 5 to 6 minutes, until 165°F (74°C).
Add the pepper and carrot for 2 minutes.
Add the noodles and sauce and toss for 1 minute.
Top with peanuts, cilantro and green onions.

recipes.name: Kung pao chicken
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) boneless chicken thighs, cut in 1/2 inch cubes
1 tablespoon soy sauce plus 1 tablespoon cornstarch, for the chicken
Sauce: 2 tablespoons soy sauce, 1 tablespoon black or rice vinegar, 1 tablespoon sugar, 1 teaspoon cornstarch, 3 tablespoons water
6 to 10 dried red chilies, cut in half (optional)
4 green onions, cut in 1/2 inch pieces
steps: Cut the chicken and slice the garlic. Ask an adult to help.
Mix the chicken with 1 tablespoon soy sauce and 1 tablespoon cornstarch. Wash your hands.
Stir the sauce ingredients together in a cup.
Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat and fry the chilies and peppercorns for 30 seconds, until fragrant. Don't let them burn.
Turn the heat to high, add the chicken and cook for 5 to 6 minutes, until golden and 165°F (74°C).
Add the garlic, ginger and green onions for 1 minute.
Stir the sauce again, pour it in and toss for 1 minute, until glossy.
Toss in the peanuts and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Sweet and sour chicken
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) boneless chicken breast, cut in 1 inch pieces
1 red and 1 green bell pepper, cut in chunks
1 can (20 oz / 565 g) pineapple chunks, drained, 1/2 cup juice saved
1/3 cup (80 ml) rice or apple cider vinegar
1 tablespoon cornstarch mixed with 2 tablespoons water
steps: Cut the chicken and vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Sprinkle the chicken with salt, dip in egg, then toss in cornstarch. Wash your hands.
Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a big pan over medium-high heat and cook the chicken in batches for 5 to 6 minutes, turning, until golden and 165°F (74°C). Lift out.
Add the rest of the oil and cook the peppers and onion for 3 minutes.
Add the pineapple juice, ketchup, vinegar, sugar and soy sauce and bring to a simmer.
Stir in the cornstarch mix and cook for 1 minute, until thick.
Add the chicken and pineapple and toss. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Orange chicken
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) boneless chicken thighs, cut in 1 inch pieces
Sauce: 3/4 cup (180 ml) orange juice, zest of 1 orange, 1/3 cup (65 g) brown sugar, 3 tablespoons soy sauce, 2 tablespoons rice vinegar
1 tablespoon cornstarch mixed with 2 tablespoons water
2 green onions, sliced, and sesame seeds
steps: Cut the chicken. Ask an adult to help.
Dip the chicken in egg, then toss in cornstarch and salt. Wash your hands.
Heat the oil in a big pan over medium-high heat and cook the chicken in batches for 6 to 7 minutes, turning, until crispy and 165°F (74°C). Drain on paper towels.
Wipe the pan and add the sauce ingredients, garlic and ginger. Simmer for 3 minutes.
Stir in the cornstarch mix and cook for 1 minute, until thick and glossy.
Toss the chicken in the sauce and top with green onions and sesame seeds.

recipes.name: Beef and broccoli
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) flank steak, thinly sliced across the grain
1 tablespoon soy sauce plus 1 tablespoon cornstarch, for the beef
Sauce: 3 tablespoons oyster sauce, 1 tablespoon soy sauce, 1 tablespoon brown sugar, 1 teaspoon cornstarch, 1/2 cup (120 ml) water or broth
steps: Slice the beef thinly. It's easier if it's half frozen. Ask an adult to help.
Toss the beef with 1 tablespoon soy sauce and the cornstarch.
Mix the sauce ingredients in a cup.
Steam or boil the broccoli for 2 minutes, until bright green. Drain.
Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a wok over high heat and sear the beef in one layer for 1 to 2 minutes per side. Lift out.
Add the rest of the oil, garlic and ginger for 30 seconds.
Add the sauce and simmer for 1 minute, until thick.
Add the beef and broccoli and toss. Drizzle with sesame oil and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Mapo tofu
ingredients: 1 block (16 oz / 450 g) soft or medium tofu, cut in 1 inch cubes
6 oz (170 g) ground pork or beef
2 tablespoons doubanjiang (chili bean paste), or 1 tablespoon for less heat
1 cup (240 ml) chicken broth or water
1 tablespoon cornstarch mixed with 2 tablespoons water
steps: Cut the tofu gently and slide it into lightly salted simmering water for 2 minutes so it firms up. Drain. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a wok over medium-high heat and cook the pork for 3 to 4 minutes, until browned.
Add the doubanjiang, black beans, garlic and ginger and stir for 1 minute.
Add the broth, soy sauce and sugar and bring to a simmer.
Slide in the tofu and simmer for 4 minutes. Push it gently, don't stir hard.
Add the cornstarch mix in two parts and simmer for 1 minute, until thick.
Sprinkle with Sichuan pepper and green onions. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Chicken lo mein
ingredients: 12 oz (340 g) lo mein egg noodles or spaghetti
12 oz (340 g) boneless chicken, thinly sliced
1 cup (100 g) snow peas or bean sprouts
Sauce: 3 tablespoons soy sauce, 1 tablespoon oyster sauce, 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce (optional), 2 teaspoons sugar, 2 teaspoons sesame oil
steps: Boil the noodles as the package says. Drain and rinse with cold water.
Slice the chicken and vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Mix the sauce ingredients.
Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a wok over high heat and cook the chicken for 4 to 5 minutes, until 165°F (74°C). Lift out.
Add the rest of the oil and stir-fry the garlic, cabbage, carrot and snow peas for 2 to 3 minutes.
Add the noodles, chicken and sauce and toss for 2 minutes, until hot and coated.
Toss in the green onions and serve.

recipes.name: Crispy chow mein
ingredients: 12 oz (340 g) thin fresh chow mein noodles or steamed noodles
8 oz (225 g) chicken or shrimp, thinly sliced (optional)
Sauce: 2 tablespoons soy sauce, 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce, 1 tablespoon oyster sauce, 1 teaspoon sugar, 1 teaspoon sesame oil
steps: Loosen the noodles. If they're dry, boil them for 2 minutes and drain well.
Mix the sauce ingredients.

Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a big pan over medium-high heat. Spread the noodles flat and cook for 4 to 5 minutes, until crispy on the bottom. Flip and cook for 3 minutes more. An adult should help flip. Slide onto a plate.
Add the rest of the oil and cook the chicken for 4 minutes, until 165°F (74°C), or the shrimp for 2 minutes, until pink.
Add the garlic, cabbage and carrot for 2 minutes.
Add the bean sprouts, green onions and sauce and toss for 1 minute.
Pile the vegetables over the crispy noodles.

recipes.name: Oven char siu pork
ingredients: 2 lb (900 g) pork shoulder or tenderloin, cut in long strips 2 inches thick
2 tablespoons honey, plus 2 tablespoons for glazing
steps: Mix the hoisin, soy sauce, 2 tablespoons honey, sugar, oyster sauce, five spice, garlic and food coloring.
Coat the pork and marinate in the fridge for at least 4 hours, or overnight. Wash your hands. Save some marinade in a separate cup for basting.
Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Put a rack over a foil-lined pan with 1 cup water in the pan.
Roast the pork on the rack for 25 minutes.
Brush with the saved marinade, flip, and roast for 20 minutes more, until 145°F (63°C) for tenderloin or 160°F (71°C) for shoulder.
Brush with honey and broil for 2 to 3 minutes, until sticky and charred at the edges. An adult should watch the broiler.
Rest for 10 minutes and slice. Serve with rice or in buns.

recipes.name: Chinese tomato and egg
steps: Beat the eggs with 1/4 teaspoon salt.
Cut the tomatoes into wedges. Ask an adult to help.
Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a wok over medium-high heat and scramble the eggs for 1 minute, until just set but still soft. Lift out.
Add the rest of the oil and the tomatoes and cook for 2 to 3 minutes, until soft and juicy.
Add the ketchup, sugar, water and the rest of the salt and simmer for 1 minute.
Add the eggs back and fold gently for 30 seconds.
Top with green onions and serve over rice.

recipes.name: Mongolian beef
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) flank steak, thinly sliced across the grain
6 green onions, cut in 2 inch pieces
steps: Slice the beef thinly. Ask an adult to help.
Toss the beef in cornstarch to coat.
Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a big pan over medium-high heat and fry the beef in batches for 2 minutes per side, until crispy. Lift out.
Add the rest of the oil, garlic and ginger for 30 seconds.
Add the soy sauce, water, sugar and chili flakes and simmer for 4 to 5 minutes, until a little thick.
Add the beef and green onions and toss for 1 minute. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Egg foo young
ingredients: 1/2 cup (75 g) diced cooked ham, chicken or shrimp
Gravy: 1 cup (240 ml) chicken broth, 1 tablespoon soy sauce, 1 tablespoon oyster sauce, 1 teaspoon sugar, 1 tablespoon cornstarch
steps: Beat the eggs with salt, then stir in the bean sprouts, ham, green onions and peas.
Whisk the gravy ingredients in a small pot and simmer for 2 minutes, stirring, until thick.
Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a frying pan over medium heat. Ask an adult to help with the hot oil.
Pour in 1/2 cup of the egg mix and cook for 2 minutes, until set on the bottom.
Flip and cook for 1 to 2 minutes more. Repeat with the rest, adding oil as needed.
Pour the gravy over the omelets and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Cantonese steamed fish
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) white fish fillets like cod, sea bass or tilapia
2 inch piece ginger, cut in thin matchsticks
4 green onions, cut in thin strips
steps: Cut the ginger and green onions into thin strips. Ask an adult to help.
Put the fish on a heatproof plate, sprinkle with salt and top with half the ginger.
Set the plate on a rack in a wok or wide pot with boiling water underneath. Cover and steam for 8 to 10 minutes, until the fish flakes and is 145°F (63°C).
An adult lifts out the hot plate and pours off the liquid.
Warm the soy sauce, water and sugar and pour around the fish.
Top with the rest of the ginger, the green onions and cilantro.
An adult heats the oil until it just smokes and pours it over the green onions. It sizzles. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Hong shao rou red braised pork
ingredients: 2 lb (900 g) skin-on pork belly, cut in 1 1/2 inch cubes
steps: Cut the pork. Ask an adult to help.
Put the pork in a pot of cold water, bring to a boil and boil for 3 minutes. Drain and rinse.
Heat the oil and sugar in a heavy pot over medium-low heat for 3 to 4 minutes, until it turns amber. An adult should do this, melted sugar is very hot.
Add the pork and stir for 2 minutes to coat.
Add the ginger, green onions, star anise, cinnamon, soy sauces, wine and hot water.
Cover and simmer on low for 1 hour, stirring now and then.
Uncover, turn up the heat and cook for 10 to 15 minutes, stirring, until the sauce is thick and sticky. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Taiwanese three cup chicken
ingredients: 2 lb (900 g) boneless chicken thighs, cut in bite-size pieces
steps: Cut the chicken and slice the ginger. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the sesame oil in a wok or clay pot over medium heat and fry the ginger and garlic for 3 to 4 minutes, until golden.
Add the chilies and the chicken and cook for 5 minutes, until browned.
Add the soy sauces, rice wine and sugar.
Cover and simmer for 10 minutes, then uncover and cook for 3 to 5 minutes, until the sauce is sticky and the chicken is 165°F (74°C).
Turn off the heat and toss in the basil. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Lu rou fan braised pork rice
ingredients: 2 lb (900 g) pork belly or shoulder, cut in small 1/4 inch pieces
1/2 cup (60 g) fried shallots, or 4 shallots sliced and fried
steps: Cut the pork into small pieces. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a pot over medium-high heat and cook the pork for 8 minutes, until it loses its pink and some fat melts.
Add the shallots and garlic for 2 minutes.
Add the soy sauces, rice wine, sugar and five spice and stir for 1 minute.
Add the water and eggs and bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer on low for 1 hour, stirring now and then, until the pork is very tender and the sauce is glossy.
Spoon the pork and sauce over rice with a halved egg on top.

recipes.name: Xinjiang cumin lamb
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) boneless lamb leg or shoulder, thinly sliced
steps: Slice the lamb thinly. It's easier when half frozen. Ask an adult to help.
Toss the lamb with soy sauce and cornstarch.
Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a wok over high heat and sear the lamb in batches for 2 minutes, until browned. Lift out.
Add the rest of the oil and the onion for 2 minutes.
Add the garlic, cumin and chili flakes for 30 seconds.
Add the lamb, salt and sugar and toss for 1 minute.
Toss in the cilantro and serve with rice or flatbread.

recipes.name: Chicken teriyaki
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) boneless skin-on or skinless chicken thighs
steps: Pat the chicken dry and sprinkle with salt.
Heat the oil in a frying pan over medium heat and put the chicken in skin side down.
Cook for 6 to 7 minutes, until golden. Flip and cook for 4 to 5 minutes more.
Mix the soy sauce, mirin, sake, sugar and ginger.
Wipe out extra fat, pour in the sauce and simmer for 3 to 4 minutes, spooning it over the chicken, until thick and glossy and the chicken is 165°F (74°C).
Slice the chicken. Ask an adult to help.
Top with sauce, sesame seeds and green onions. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Chicken katsu
ingredients: 2 large boneless chicken breasts, sliced in half to make 4 thin cutlets
1/2 cup (120 ml) vegetable oil for shallow frying
Katsu sauce: 1/4 cup (60 ml) ketchup, 2 tablespoons Worcestershire sauce, 1 tablespoon soy sauce, 1 tablespoon sugar
steps: Slice the chicken into thin cutlets. Ask an adult to help.
Season with salt and pepper. Coat in flour, then egg, then panko, pressing it on. Wash your hands.
Heat the oil in a frying pan over medium heat. An adult should do the frying.
Fry 2 cutlets at a time for 4 to 5 minutes per side, until golden and 165°F (74°C).
Drain on a rack and rest for 3 minutes.
Mix the katsu sauce.
Slice and serve with cabbage, rice and sauce.

recipes.name: Japanese chicken curry
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) boneless chicken thighs, cut in bite-size pieces
1 box (3.5 oz / 100 g) Japanese curry roux, mild or medium
steps: Cut the chicken and vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat and cook the onions for 5 minutes.
Add the chicken and cook for 4 minutes, until no longer pink outside.
Add the carrots, potatoes and water and bring to a boil. Skim off any foam.
Simmer for 15 to 20 minutes, until the vegetables are tender and the chicken is 165°F (74°C).
Turn off the heat, break in the curry roux and stir until it melts.
Add the ketchup and honey and simmer on low for 5 minutes, stirring, until thick.
Serve over rice.

recipes.name: Gyudon beef bowl
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) very thinly sliced beef (shabu shabu or ribeye)
4 cups (740 g) cooked short grain rice
Pickled red ginger, green onions and soft boiled eggs to serve
steps: Slice the onion. Ask an adult to help.
Simmer the dashi, soy sauce, mirin, sugar and sake in a pan.
Add the onion and simmer for 5 minutes, until soft.
Add the beef, pulling the slices apart, and simmer for 2 to 3 minutes, until cooked through. Skim any foam.
Spoon the beef, onion and some broth over bowls of rice.
Top with pickled ginger, green onions and an egg.

recipes.name: Oyakodon chicken and egg bowl
ingredients: 8 oz (225 g) boneless chicken thighs, cut in small pieces
2 cups (370 g) cooked short grain rice
steps: Cut the chicken and onion. Ask an adult to help.
Simmer the dashi, soy sauce, mirin and sugar in a small frying pan.
Add the onion and chicken and simmer for 6 to 7 minutes, until the chicken is 165°F (74°C).
Pour the eggs over in a circle. Cover and cook on low for 1 to 2 minutes, until just set but still soft.
Slide over bowls of hot rice and top with green onion.

recipes.name: Tonkatsu pork cutlet
ingredients: 4 boneless pork loin chops, 1/2 inch (1.3 cm) thick
Vegetable oil for frying, about 1 inch (2.5 cm) deep
Shredded cabbage, lemon wedges and rice
steps: Snip the fat on the edges of the chops so they stay flat. Pound lightly. Ask an adult to help.
Season, then coat in flour, egg and panko. Wash your hands.
An adult heats the oil in a deep pan to 340°F (170°C). Hot oil is dangerous, so an adult does the frying.
Fry 2 chops at a time for 3 to 4 minutes per side, until golden and 145°F (63°C).
Drain on a rack and rest for 3 minutes.
Slice and serve with cabbage, rice, lemon and sauce.

recipes.name: Teriyaki salmon
ingredients: Sesame seeds, green onions and rice
steps: Pat the salmon dry and sprinkle with salt.
Mix the soy sauce, mirin, honey, sake and ginger.
Heat the oil in a frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the salmon skin side down for 4 minutes.
Flip and cook for 2 to 3 minutes.
Pour in the sauce and simmer for 1 to 2 minutes, spooning it over, until thick and the salmon is 145°F (63°C).
Top with sesame seeds and green onions. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Oven yakitori chicken skewers
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) boneless chicken thighs, cut in 1 inch pieces
1 bunch green onions (white and light green parts), cut in 1 inch pieces
Tare sauce: 1/3 cup (80 ml) soy sauce, 1/3 cup (80 ml) mirin, 2 tablespoons sake or water, 2 tablespoons sugar
steps: Simmer the tare ingredients in a small pot for 8 to 10 minutes, until slightly syrupy. Save a little in a separate cup for serving.
Cut the chicken and green onions. Ask an adult to help.
Thread chicken and green onion pieces onto the skewers, switching between them. Wash your hands.
Heat the broiler to high with the rack 6 inches from the heat. An adult should do this.
Broil the skewers on a foil-lined pan for 5 minutes per side.
Brush with tare and broil for 1 to 2 minutes more per side, until glazed and 165°F (74°C).
Brush with the saved tare and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Nikujaga meat and potatoes
ingredients: 8 oz (225 g) thinly sliced beef or pork
1/2 cup (50 g) snow peas or green beans
steps: Cut the vegetables and beef. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat and cook the beef for 2 minutes. Add the onion for 2 minutes.
Add the potatoes, carrot and dashi and bring to a boil. Skim the foam.
Add the sugar, mirin and sake and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the soy sauce, lay a small lid or foil right on top of the food, and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes, until the potatoes are tender.
Add the snow peas for 2 minutes. Let it sit for 10 minutes so the flavors soak in.

recipes.name: Chicken karaage
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) boneless chicken thighs, cut in 1 1/2 inch pieces
3/4 cup (95 g) potato starch or cornstarch
Vegetable oil for frying, about 1 1/2 inches (4 cm) deep
steps: Cut the chicken. Ask an adult to help.
Mix the chicken with soy sauce, sake, ginger, garlic and sesame oil. Marinate for 30 minutes. Wash your hands.
Toss the chicken in potato starch until coated.
An adult heats the oil in a deep pot to 340°F (170°C). Hot oil is dangerous, so an adult does all the frying.
Fry in batches for 4 minutes. Lift out and rest for 4 minutes.
Heat the oil to 375°F (190°C) and fry again for 1 minute, until extra crispy and 165°F (74°C).
Drain and serve with lemon and mayo.

recipes.name: Hambagu Japanese hamburger steak
ingredients: 1/2 cup (25 g) panko soaked in 3 tablespoons milk
1 lb (450 g) ground beef, or half beef and half pork
Sauce: 1/4 cup (60 ml) ketchup, 3 tablespoons Worcestershire sauce, 2 tablespoons water, 1 tablespoon butter
steps: Chop the onion. Ask an adult to help.
Cook the onion in the butter over medium heat for 6 to 8 minutes, until soft and golden. Let it cool.
Mix the meat, onion, soaked panko, egg, salt, pepper and nutmeg. Wash your hands.
Shape into 4 oval patties about 3/4 inch thick and press a dip in the middle.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat and cook the patties for 4 minutes, until browned. Flip.
Add 2 tablespoons water, cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 minutes, until 160°F (71°C) inside.
Lift out the patties, add the sauce ingredients to the pan and simmer for 1 minute. Pour over the patties.

recipes.name: Beef bulgogi
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) ribeye or sirloin, very thinly sliced
Sesame seeds, rice and lettuce leaves
steps: Slice the beef very thinly. It's easier when half frozen. Ask an adult to help.
Mix the soy sauce, pear, sugar, sesame oil, garlic, ginger and pepper.
Add the beef, onion and green onions and marinate for 30 minutes. Wash your hands.
Heat the oil in a big pan over high heat.
Cook the beef in batches for 2 to 3 minutes, until browned and cooked through.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds and serve with rice and lettuce for wrapping.

recipes.name: Bibimbap
ingredients: 4 cups (740 g) cooked short grain rice
8 oz (225 g) ground beef or thinly sliced beef
2 tablespoons sesame oil, divided, plus more for serving
Sauce: 3 tablespoons gochujang, 1 tablespoon sesame oil, 1 tablespoon sugar, 1 tablespoon water
steps: Cut the vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Mix the beef with 1 tablespoon soy sauce, the sugar, 1 tablespoon sesame oil and garlic. Cook in a pan over medium-high heat for 5 minutes, until browned.
