Blanch the spinach and bean sprouts in boiling water for 1 minute each. Drain and squeeze. Toss each with a little sesame oil and soy sauce.
Cook the carrot and zucchini separately in the vegetable oil for 2 minutes each, until just soft.
Fry the eggs for 2 to 3 minutes, keeping the yolks runny if you like.
Mix the sauce ingredients.
Put rice in each bowl and arrange the beef and vegetables on top in groups. Add an egg.
Add sauce and sesame seeds, then mix it all together to eat.

recipes.name: Korean fried chicken
ingredients: 2 lb (900 g) chicken wings or boneless thigh pieces
3/4 cup (95 g) potato starch or cornstarch
Vegetable oil for frying, about 2 inches (5 cm) deep
Sauce: 3 tablespoons gochujang, 3 tablespoons honey, 2 tablespoons ketchup, 1 tablespoon soy sauce, 3 garlic cloves grated, 1 tablespoon butter
steps: Season the chicken with salt, pepper and ginger. Toss in the starch. Wash your hands.
An adult heats the oil in a deep pot to 350°F (175°C). Hot oil is dangerous, so an adult does the frying.
Fry in batches for 8 to 10 minutes for wings or 5 to 6 minutes for boneless. Lift out and rest for 5 minutes.
Fry again at 375°F (190°C) for 2 to 3 minutes, until very crispy and 165°F (74°C).
Simmer the sauce ingredients in a big pan for 2 minutes, until bubbly.
Toss the chicken in the sauce and top with sesame seeds and peanuts.

recipes.name: Dak galbi spicy chicken
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) boneless chicken thighs, cut in bite-size pieces
Sauce: 3 tablespoons gochujang, 1 tablespoon gochugaru (optional), 2 tablespoons soy sauce, 1 tablespoon sugar, 1 tablespoon honey, 3 garlic cloves grated, 1 teaspoon grated ginger
3 cups (210 g) cabbage, cut in pieces
steps: Cut the chicken and vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Mix the sauce, add the chicken and marinate for 20 minutes. Wash your hands.
Heat the oil in a big pan over medium heat.
Add the cabbage, sweet potato, onion and rice cakes, then the chicken on top.
Cook for 12 to 15 minutes, stirring often, until the sweet potato is tender and the chicken is 165°F (74°C).
Add the perilla leaves. For cheesy dak galbi, sprinkle on mozzarella, cover and cook for 2 minutes, until melted.

recipes.name: Galbi jjim braised short ribs
ingredients: 3 lb (1.4 kg) bone-in beef short ribs, cut in 2 inch pieces
1 daikon radish or 2 potatoes, cut in chunks
steps: Soak the ribs in cold water for 30 minutes to draw out blood, then drain.
Boil the ribs in a pot of water for 5 minutes. Drain and rinse. Ask an adult to help with the hot water.
Mix the soy sauce, pear, onion, sugar, honey, garlic, ginger and sesame oil.
Put the ribs, sauce and 3 cups water in a heavy pot and bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer on low for 1 hour 15 minutes.
Add the carrots, daikon, mushrooms, chestnuts and jujubes and simmer for 30 to 40 minutes, until the meat is very tender.
Uncover and simmer for 10 minutes to thicken the sauce. Skim off fat and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Jeyuk bokkeum spicy pork
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) pork shoulder or belly, very thinly sliced
Sauce: 3 tablespoons gochujang, 1 tablespoon gochugaru, 2 tablespoons soy sauce, 1 tablespoon sugar, 1 tablespoon honey, 1 tablespoon sesame oil, 4 garlic cloves grated, 1 teaspoon grated ginger
steps: Slice the pork and vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Mix the sauce and toss the pork in it. Marinate for 20 minutes. Wash your hands.
Heat the oil in a big pan over medium-high heat.
Add the pork, onion and carrot and cook for 8 to 10 minutes, stirring, until the pork is cooked through and a little charred.
Toss in the green onions for 1 minute.
Top with sesame seeds and serve with rice and lettuce for wrapping.

recipes.name: Dakdoritang spicy braised chicken
ingredients: Sauce: 2 tablespoons gochujang, 2 tablespoons gochugaru, 3 tablespoons soy sauce, 1 tablespoon sugar, 5 garlic cloves grated, 1 teaspoon grated ginger
steps: Cut the vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Boil the chicken in water for 3 minutes, drain and rinse. This keeps the stew clear.
Mix the sauce ingredients.
Put the chicken, sauce and 2 cups water in a pot and bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer for 15 minutes.
Add the potatoes, carrot and onion and simmer for 20 to 25 minutes, until tender and the chicken is 165°F (74°C).
Add the green onions and sesame oil. Serve with rice. Use less gochugaru for milder heat.

recipes.name: Korean ground beef bowl
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon chili flakes or 1 teaspoon gochujang (optional)
Rice, cucumber, sesame seeds and fried eggs to serve
steps: Chop the garlic and slice the green onions. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pan over medium-high heat and cook the beef for 6 to 8 minutes, breaking it up, until browned. Drain the fat.
Add the garlic and ginger for 1 minute.
Add the soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil and chili and simmer for 2 minutes.
Stir in most of the green onions.
Spoon over rice and top with cucumber, sesame seeds, the rest of the green onions and an egg.

recipes.name: Huli huli chicken
ingredients: Grilled pineapple and green onions to serve
steps: Whisk the pineapple juice, soy sauce, sugar, ketchup, ginger, garlic and sriracha. Save 1 cup in a separate pot for the glaze.
Pour the rest over the chicken and marinate in the fridge for at least 2 hours. Wash your hands.
Simmer the saved cup for 8 to 10 minutes, until syrupy.
Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C) or heat a grill to medium-high. An adult should run the grill.
Lay the chicken on a foil-lined pan and bake for 20 minutes, or grill for 5 to 6 minutes per side.
Brush with glaze and bake for 5 minutes more, until sticky and 165°F (74°C).
Serve with pineapple and green onions.

recipes.name: Slow cooker kalua pork
ingredients: 4 to 5 lb (1.8 to 2.3 kg) boneless pork shoulder
1 tablespoon coarse Hawaiian or sea salt
Rice and macaroni salad to serve
steps: Poke the pork all over with a fork and tuck in the garlic. Ask an adult to help.
Rub the salt all over the pork. Wash your hands.
Put the pork in the slow cooker and pour the liquid smoke and water over it.
Cover and cook on low for 9 to 10 hours, until it falls apart.
If you're using cabbage, add it for the last 30 to 45 minutes.
Shred the pork with two forks and stir it into the juices. Taste and add more salt if needed.

recipes.name: Slow cooker honey garlic chicken
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cornstarch mixed with 3 tablespoons water
Sesame seeds, green onions and rice
steps: Chop the garlic. Ask an adult to help.
Put the chicken in the slow cooker.
Whisk the honey, soy sauce, ketchup, garlic, ginger and chili flakes and pour over.
Cover and cook on low for 4 hours, or on high for 2 hours 30 minutes, until 165°F (74°C).
Lift out the chicken. Stir the cornstarch mix into the sauce, cover and cook on high for 10 to 15 minutes, until thick.
Shred or slice the chicken, toss in the sauce, and top with sesame seeds and green onions.

recipes.name: Slow cooker teriyaki chicken
ingredients: 2 1/2 lb (1.1 kg) boneless chicken thighs or breasts
1/4 cup (60 ml) water or pineapple juice
3 tablespoons cornstarch mixed with 3 tablespoons water
Rice, steamed broccoli and sesame seeds
steps: Chop the garlic. Ask an adult to help.
Put the chicken in the slow cooker.
Whisk the soy sauce, sugar, vinegar, water, garlic and ginger and pour over.
Cover and cook on low for 4 hours, or on high for 2 hours 30 minutes, until 165°F (74°C).
Lift out the chicken and shred it.
Stir the cornstarch mix into the sauce, cover and cook on high for 10 to 15 minutes, until thick.
Toss the chicken in the sauce and serve over rice with broccoli.

recipes.name: Slow cooker beef ragu
ingredients: 3 lb (1.4 kg) boneless beef chuck roast, cut in 4 pieces
1/2 cup (120 ml) beef broth or red wine
2 bay leaves and 1 teaspoon dried oregano
steps: Chop the vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Season the beef and brown it in the oil in a big pan over medium-high heat for 3 minutes per side. Put it in the slow cooker.
Cook the onion, carrots and celery in the same pan for 5 minutes. Add the garlic and tomato paste for 1 minute.
Add everything to the slow cooker with the tomatoes, broth, bay leaves and oregano.
Cover and cook on low for 8 hours, until the beef shreds easily.
Shred the beef in the sauce with two forks and take out the bay leaves.
Boil the pasta as the package says, toss with the ragu and top with parmesan.

recipes.name: Slow cooker chile verde
ingredients: 3 lb (1.4 kg) boneless pork shoulder, cut in 2 inch chunks
1 lb (450 g) tomatillos, husked and halved
Tortillas, rice and lime to serve
steps: Chop the peppers and onion. Ask an adult to help.
Blend the tomatillos, poblanos, jalapeno, onion, garlic, cilantro and broth until fairly smooth.
Season the pork with salt, cumin and oregano and put it in the slow cooker. Wash your hands.
Pour the sauce over the pork.
Cover and cook on low for 8 hours, until the pork falls apart.
Break up the pork a little and serve with tortillas, rice and lime.

recipes.name: Air fryer chicken tenders
ingredients: Honey mustard or ketchup for dipping
steps: Season the chicken with salt, garlic powder and paprika.
Mix the panko and parmesan.
Coat each tender in flour, then egg, then panko, pressing it on. Wash your hands.
Lay in the air fryer basket in one layer and spray with oil.
Air fry at 400°F (200°C) for 10 to 12 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and 165°F (74°C).
Serve with dipping sauce.

recipes.name: Air fryer chicken wings
ingredients: 2 lb (900 g) chicken wings, split into flats and drums
1/2 cup (120 ml) buffalo, barbecue or honey garlic sauce
steps: Pat the wings very dry with paper towels.
Toss with baking powder, salt, garlic powder and pepper. Wash your hands.
Lay in the air fryer basket in one layer.
Air fry at 380°F (195°C) for 12 minutes. Flip.
Turn up to 400°F (200°C) and air fry for 8 to 10 minutes more, until crispy and 165°F (74°C).
Toss with your favorite sauce and serve with celery and ranch.

recipes.name: Air fryer salmon
steps: Pat the salmon dry and brush with oil.
Mix the paprika, garlic powder, salt and pepper and sprinkle on top. Drizzle with honey.
Lay the salmon skin side down in the air fryer basket.
Air fry at 400°F (200°C) for 7 to 9 minutes, until it flakes and is 145°F (63°C).
Serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.name: Air fryer pork chops
ingredients: 4 boneless pork chops, about 1 inch (2.5 cm) thick
steps: Pat the pork chops dry and rub with oil.
Mix the sugar and spices and rub on both sides. Wash your hands.
Lay in the air fryer basket in one layer.
Air fry at 400°F (200°C) for 10 to 12 minutes, flipping halfway, until 145°F (63°C).
Rest for 5 minutes before cutting.

recipes.name: Air fryer fish sticks
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) cod or other firm white fish, cut in 1 x 3 inch strips
Tartar sauce and lemon to serve
steps: Cut the fish into strips. Ask an adult to help.
Season the fish with salt. Mix the panko, paprika and garlic powder.
Coat each strip in flour, egg, then panko. Wash your hands.
Lay in the air fryer basket in one layer and spray with oil.
Air fry at 400°F (200°C) for 8 to 10 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and 145°F (63°C).
Serve with tartar sauce and lemon.

recipes.name: Air fryer coconut shrimp
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) large shrimp, peeled and deveined, tails on
steps: Pat the shrimp dry and sprinkle with salt.
Mix the coconut and panko.
Coat each shrimp in flour, egg, then the coconut mix. Wash your hands.
Lay in the air fryer basket in one layer and spray with oil.
Air fry at 390°F (200°C) for 8 to 10 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and pink inside.
Serve with sweet chili sauce.

recipes.name: Crispy tofu and vegetables
ingredients: 1 block (14 oz / 400 g) extra firm tofu, pressed for 15 minutes
Sauce: 3 tablespoons soy sauce, 2 tablespoons maple syrup or honey, 1 tablespoon rice vinegar, 1 teaspoon sesame oil, 1 teaspoon cornstarch, 1/4 cup (60 ml) water
steps: Press the tofu between towels under a heavy pan for 15 minutes, then cut in cubes. Ask an adult to help cut the vegetables.
Toss the tofu in cornstarch.
Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a big pan over medium-high heat and fry the tofu for 8 to 10 minutes, turning, until crispy on all sides. Lift out.
Add the rest of the oil and stir-fry the broccoli, pepper and carrot for 4 minutes. Add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Mix the sauce, pour it in and cook for 1 minute, until thick.
Toss in the tofu and top with sesame seeds. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Air fryer crispy tofu
ingredients: 1 block (14 oz / 400 g) extra firm tofu, pressed for 15 minutes
Peanut sauce or sweet chili sauce for dipping
steps: Press the tofu for 15 minutes and cut in 1 inch cubes. Ask an adult to help.
Toss the tofu with soy sauce, oil and garlic powder.
Sprinkle with cornstarch and toss gently until coated.
Lay in the air fryer basket in one layer.
Air fry at 400°F (200°C) for 12 to 15 minutes, shaking halfway, until crispy.
Serve with dipping sauce, over rice or in a bowl with vegetables.

recipes.name: Egg roll in a bowl
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) ground pork, chicken or turkey
steps: Chop the garlic and slice the green onions. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pan over medium-high heat and cook the meat for 6 to 8 minutes, breaking it up, until browned and cooked through (165°F / 74°C for chicken or turkey).
Add the garlic and ginger for 1 minute.
Add the coleslaw mix, soy sauce, vinegar and sriracha and cook for 4 to 5 minutes, until the cabbage is just tender.
Top with green onions and sesame seeds.

recipes.name: Sweet potato black bean tacos
ingredients: 2 sweet potatoes, peeled and cut in 1/2 inch cubes
1 can (15 oz / 425 g) black beans, drained
Crumbled cotija or feta, cilantro and lime
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Cut the sweet potatoes. Ask an adult to help.
Toss with oil, spices and salt and spread on a sheet pan.
Roast for 20 to 25 minutes, stirring once, until tender and browned.
Warm the black beans in a small pot for 3 minutes.
Warm the tortillas and fill with sweet potato, beans, avocado, cheese, cilantro and a squeeze of lime.

recipes.name: Stuffed sweet potatoes
ingredients: 1 can (15 oz / 425 g) black beans, drained
1 cup (100 g) shredded cheddar or pepper jack
Sour cream, green onions and avocado to serve
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Prick the sweet potatoes with a fork and bake on a sheet pan for 45 to 50 minutes, until soft.
Mix the beans, corn, salsa, cumin and salt.
An adult splits the hot potatoes open. Fluff the inside with a fork.
Spoon the bean mix in and top with cheese.
Bake for 5 to 8 minutes more, until the cheese melts.
Top with sour cream, green onions and avocado.

recipes.name: Lentil bolognese
ingredients: 1 cup (200 g) brown or green lentils, rinsed
1 teaspoon dried oregano and 1 bay leaf
steps: Chop the vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat and cook the onion, carrot and celery for 8 minutes.
Add the garlic and tomato paste for 1 minute.
Add the lentils, tomatoes, broth, oregano, bay leaf and salt and bring to a boil.
Simmer for 30 to 35 minutes, stirring now and then, until the lentils are tender and the sauce is thick.
Boil the pasta as the package says and toss with the sauce. Top with parmesan and basil.

recipes.name: Sheet pan chicken and vegetables
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) boneless chicken thighs or breasts, cut in 1 1/2 inch pieces
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Cut the chicken and vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Toss the potatoes with 1 tablespoon oil and a pinch of salt and roast for 15 minutes.
Toss the chicken, broccoli and onion with the rest of the oil and the seasonings. Wash your hands.
Add them to the pan with the potatoes and roast for 20 to 22 minutes, until the chicken is 165°F (74°C).
Squeeze the lemon over everything.

recipes.name: White sandwich bread
ingredients: 2 1/4 teaspoons (1 packet / 7 g) instant or active dry yeast
3 1/2 cups (440 g) bread flour or all-purpose flour
steps: Stir the warm milk, yeast and sugar in a big bowl and let sit for 5 minutes, until foamy.
Add the flour, salt and butter and stir into a shaggy dough.
Knead on a floured counter for 8 to 10 minutes, until smooth and stretchy.
Put it in an oiled bowl, cover and let rise for 1 hour, until doubled.
Press it flat into a rectangle, roll it up tight from the short end and pinch the seam.
Put it seam side down in a greased 9 by 5 inch loaf pan.
Cover and let rise for 45 minutes, until it domes 1 inch over the pan.
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes, until golden and hollow sounding when tapped.
Turn out and let cool for 1 hour before slicing.

recipes.name: Honey whole wheat bread
ingredients: 2 1/4 teaspoons (7 g) instant or active dry yeast
1 3/4 cups (220 g) bread flour or all-purpose flour
steps: Stir the water, yeast and honey and let sit for 5 minutes, until foamy.
Stir in the oil, both flours and the salt.
Knead for 10 minutes, until smooth and springy. It will feel a little tacky.
Put it in an oiled bowl, cover and let rise for 1 hour 15 minutes, until doubled.
Shape into a log and put it in a greased 9 by 5 inch loaf pan.
Cover and let rise for 45 minutes.
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Bake for 35 to 40 minutes, until browned and hollow sounding.
Let cool for 1 hour before slicing.

recipes.name: French baguettes
ingredients: 2 1/4 teaspoons (7 g) instant or active dry yeast
steps: Stir the water, yeast and sugar and let sit for 5 minutes, until foamy.
Add the flour and salt and knead for 8 to 10 minutes, until smooth.
Cover and let rise for 1 hour, until doubled.
Split in half. Press each half into a rectangle and roll it into a 14 inch log, tapering the ends.
Put the logs on a floured baking sheet, cover and let rise for 40 minutes.
Heat the oven to 450°F (230°C). Ask an adult to help.
Put an empty metal pan on the bottom rack.
Have an adult cut 4 slanted slashes on each loaf with a sharp knife.
Put the bread in and have an adult pour 1 cup of hot water into the empty pan to make steam.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until deep golden.
Let cool for 20 minutes.

recipes.name: Rosemary focaccia
ingredients: 2 1/4 teaspoons (7 g) instant or active dry yeast
steps: Stir the water, yeast and sugar and let sit for 5 minutes.
Stir in the flour and salt until no dry flour shows. It will be very sticky. No kneading needed.
Cover and let rise for 1 hour 30 minutes, until bubbly and doubled.
Pour 4 tablespoons of the oil into a 9 by 13 inch pan.
Tip the dough into the pan and gently stretch it toward the corners with oiled hands.
Let rise for 30 minutes.
Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Ask an adult to help.
Drizzle the rest of the oil on top and press your fingertips all over to make deep dimples.
Sprinkle with rosemary and flaky salt.
Bake for 22 to 25 minutes, until golden and crisp at the edges.
Let cool for 10 minutes, then cut into squares.

recipes.name: No-knead crusty bread
ingredients: 3 cups (390 g) all-purpose or bread flour
steps: Stir the flour, yeast, salt and water in a big bowl until a shaggy, sticky dough forms.
Cover and let sit at room temperature for 12 to 18 hours, until bubbly.
Tip onto a floured counter and fold it over itself a few times into a ball.
Set it on parchment, cover and let rest for 1 hour.
Put a covered Dutch oven in the oven and heat to 450°F (230°C) for 30 minutes. An adult should handle the pot.
Lift the dough by the parchment into the hot pot and cover.
Bake for 30 minutes, then take off the lid and bake for 10 to 15 minutes more, until deep brown.
Let cool for 1 hour before slicing.

recipes.name: Cinnamon rolls
ingredients: 2 1/4 teaspoons (7 g) instant or active dry yeast
Filling: 1 cup (220 g) packed brown sugar, 2 1/2 tablespoons ground cinnamon, 1/3 cup (75 g) butter, softened
Icing: 4 oz (115 g) cream cheese, 1/4 cup (55 g) butter, 1 1/2 cups (180 g) powdered sugar, 1/2 teaspoon vanilla
steps: Stir the milk, yeast and sugar and let sit for 5 minutes.
Mix in the melted butter, eggs, flour and salt.
Knead for 6 to 8 minutes, until soft and smooth.
Cover and let rise for 1 hour, until doubled.
Roll the dough into a 16 by 21 inch rectangle.
Spread with the soft butter and sprinkle with the brown sugar and cinnamon.
Roll it up from the long side and cut into 12 rolls with dental floss or a sharp knife.
Put them in a greased 9 by 13 inch pan, cover and let rise for 30 minutes.
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, until golden.
Beat the icing ingredients and spread on the warm rolls.

recipes.name: Soft pretzels
ingredients: 2 1/4 teaspoons (7 g) instant or active dry yeast
10 cups (2.4 liters) water and 2/3 cup (about 145 g) baking soda for the bath
1 egg yolk beaten with 1 tablespoon water
steps: Stir the warm water, sugar, salt and yeast and let sit for 5 minutes.
Add the flour and butter and knead for 5 minutes, until smooth.
Cover and let rise for 1 hour, until doubled.
Heat the oven to 450°F (230°C). Ask an adult to help.
Have an adult bring the 10 cups water and baking soda to a boil in a big pot.
Split the dough into 8 pieces, roll each into a 24 inch rope and twist into a pretzel shape.
Have an adult dip each pretzel in the boiling water for 30 seconds, then lift it out with a slotted spatula.
Put them on a lined baking sheet, brush with egg wash and sprinkle with coarse salt.
Bake for 12 to 14 minutes, until dark golden brown.
For pretzel bites, cut the ropes into 1 inch pieces and bake for 8 to 10 minutes.

recipes.name: Homemade bagels
ingredients: 2 1/4 teaspoons (7 g) instant or active dry yeast
1 tablespoon honey for the boiling water
Toppings: everything seasoning, sesame seeds or poppy seeds
steps: Stir the water, yeast and sugar and let sit for 5 minutes.
Add the flour and salt and knead for 10 minutes. The dough will be stiff.
Cover and let rise for 1 hour.
Split into 8 balls. Poke your thumb through the middle of each and stretch into a 2 inch hole.
Rest on a lined sheet for 20 minutes.
Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Ask an adult to help.
Have an adult bring a big pot of water and the honey to a boil.
Boil the bagels 2 or 3 at a time for 1 minute per side, then lift them out with a slotted spoon.
Put them back on the sheet and sprinkle with toppings.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until golden brown.

recipes.name: Skillet naan
ingredients: 2 1/4 teaspoons (7 g) instant or active dry yeast
Garlic butter: 3 tablespoons butter, melted, with 1 minced garlic clove and chopped cilantro
steps: Stir the water, yeast and sugar and let sit for 5 minutes.
Stir in the yogurt, oil, flour, salt and baking powder and knead for 5 minutes, until soft.
Cover and let rise for 1 hour.
Split into 8 balls and roll each into an oval about 1/4 inch thick.
Heat a cast iron skillet over medium high heat until very hot. Ask an adult to help.
Cook one naan for 1 to 2 minutes, until bubbles puff up and the bottom has dark spots.
Flip and cook for 1 minute more.
Brush with garlic butter and keep warm under a towel.

recipes.name: Pita bread
ingredients: 2 1/4 teaspoons (7 g) instant or active dry yeast
steps: Stir the water, yeast and sugar and let sit for 5 minutes.
Add the flour, salt and oil and knead for 6 minutes, until smooth.
Cover and let rise for 1 hour.
Put a baking sheet in the oven and heat to 475°F (245°C). Ask an adult to help.
Split into 8 balls and roll each into a 6 inch circle about 1/4 inch thick.
Have an adult put 2 or 3 at a time on the hot sheet.
Bake for 4 to 5 minutes, until puffed like balloons and pale golden.
Wrap in a towel right away so they stay soft.

recipes.name: Challah
ingredients: 2 1/4 teaspoons (7 g) instant or active dry yeast
2 large eggs, plus 1 egg for brushing
steps: Stir the water, yeast and sugar and let sit for 5 minutes.
Whisk in the oil and 2 eggs, then add the flour and salt.
Knead for 8 to 10 minutes, until smooth.
Cover and let rise for 1 hour 30 minutes, until doubled.
Split into 3 pieces and roll each into a 16 inch rope.
Pinch the ends together at the top and braid them, then pinch the bottom and tuck the ends under.
Put on a lined baking sheet, cover and let rise for 45 minutes.
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Brush with the beaten egg and sprinkle with seeds.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes, until deep golden.

recipes.name: Homemade burger buns
ingredients: 2 1/4 teaspoons (7 g) instant or active dry yeast
1 large egg, plus 1 egg for brushing
steps: Stir the milk, yeast and sugar and let sit for 5 minutes.
Add 1 egg, the butter, flour and salt and knead for 8 minutes, until soft and smooth.
Cover and let rise for 1 hour.
Split into 8 balls and press each into a 3 1/2 inch disk on a lined sheet. For hot dog buns, shape 6 inch logs.
Cover and let rise for 45 minutes.
Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Ask an adult to help.
Brush with beaten egg and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Bake for 15 to 18 minutes, until golden.

recipes.name: Monkey bread
ingredients: 2 cans (16.3 oz / 462 g each) refrigerated biscuits
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease a 12 cup bundt pan.
Mix the sugar and cinnamon in a big zip bag.
Cut each biscuit into 4 pieces with kitchen scissors and shake them in the bag a handful at a time.
Pile the coated pieces into the pan.
Heat the butter and brown sugar in a pot until it boils for 1 minute. Ask an adult to help.
Pour it over the dough.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes, until golden and cooked through.
Let cool for 10 minutes, then flip onto a plate with oven mitts.

recipes.name: Garlic knots
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) pizza dough, store bought or homemade
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Cut the dough into 12 pieces and roll each into an 8 inch rope.
Tie each rope into a loose knot and put them on a lined baking sheet.
Bake for 15 to 18 minutes, until golden.
Melt the butter with the garlic in a small pan over low heat for 2 minutes.
Toss the hot knots in the garlic butter, then sprinkle with parmesan, parsley and salt.

recipes.name: Soft breadsticks
ingredients: 2 1/4 teaspoons (7 g) instant or active dry yeast
Topping: 3 tablespoons butter, melted, and 1 teaspoon garlic salt
steps: Stir the water, yeast and sugar and let sit for 5 minutes.
Add the butter, salt and flour and knead for 6 minutes.
Cover and let rise for 45 minutes.
Split into 16 pieces and roll each into a 7 inch stick. Put them on lined sheets.
Cover and let rise for 30 minutes.
Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until golden.
Brush with melted butter and sprinkle with garlic salt.

recipes.name: English muffins
ingredients: 2 1/4 teaspoons (7 g) instant or active dry yeast
steps: Stir the milk, yeast and sugar and let sit for 5 minutes.
Mix in the butter, egg, flour and salt and knead for 5 minutes. It will be soft.
Cover and let rise for 1 hour.
Roll 1/2 inch thick and cut 3 inch circles.
Put them on a cornmeal-dusted tray, sprinkle more cornmeal on top and let rest for 30 minutes.
Heat a griddle or skillet over medium low heat. Ask an adult to help.
Cook for 6 to 8 minutes per side, until golden and cooked through.
Split with a fork and toast.

recipes.name: Hot cross buns
ingredients: 2 1/4 teaspoons (7 g) instant or active dry yeast
Cross paste: 1/2 cup (65 g) flour and 1/3 cup (80 ml) water
2 tablespoons apricot jam, warmed, for glazing
steps: Stir the milk, yeast and sugar and let sit for 5 minutes.
Mix in the butter, egg, flour, salt and spices and knead for 8 minutes.
Knead in the raisins.
Cover and let rise for 1 hour.
Split into 12 balls and put them in a greased 9 by 13 inch pan. Let rise for 45 minutes.
Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Ask an adult to help.
Mix the cross paste and pipe a cross on each bun.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until golden.
Brush the warm buns with the jam.

recipes.name: Cinnamon swirl raisin bread
ingredients: 2 1/4 teaspoons (7 g) instant or active dry yeast
Swirl: 1/3 cup (65 g) sugar mixed with 1 tablespoon cinnamon, and 1 tablespoon milk for brushing
steps: Stir the milk, yeast and sugar and let sit for 5 minutes.
Add the flour, salt and butter and knead for 8 minutes, then knead in the raisins.
Cover and let rise for 1 hour.
Roll into an 8 by 16 inch rectangle, brush with milk and sprinkle with the cinnamon sugar.
Roll it up tight from the short end and put it in a greased 9 by 5 inch loaf pan.
Cover and let rise for 45 minutes.
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Bake for 35 to 40 minutes, until golden. Cover with foil for the last 10 minutes if it browns fast.
Let cool for 1 hour before slicing.

recipes.name: Japanese milk bread
ingredients: Tangzhong: 3 tablespoons (25 g) bread flour and 1/2 cup (120 ml) milk
1 large egg, plus 1 egg for brushing
steps: Whisk the tangzhong flour and milk in a small pot over low heat for 1 to 2 minutes, until it turns into a thick paste. Let cool.
Mix the flour, sugar, yeast and salt, then add the warm milk, egg and tangzhong.
Knead for 5 minutes, then knead in the butter.
Knead for 10 to 15 minutes more, until very smooth and stretchy. A stand mixer helps.
Cover and let rise for 1 hour, until doubled.
Split into 4 balls, roll each into an oval, roll up and stand them side by side in a greased 9 by 5 inch loaf pan.
Cover and let rise for 45 minutes.
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Brush with egg and bake for 30 to 35 minutes, until golden.
Let cool for 1 hour. It stays soft for days.

recipes.name: Conchas
ingredients: 2 1/4 teaspoons (7 g) instant or active dry yeast
Topping: 1/2 cup (60 g) powdered sugar, 1/2 cup (65 g) flour, 1/4 cup (55 g) butter, 1 teaspoon vanilla, 1 tablespoon cocoa (optional)
steps: Stir the milk, yeast and sugar and let sit for 5 minutes.
Add the eggs, butter, flour, salt and vanilla and knead for 8 to 10 minutes. It will be soft.
Cover and let rise for 1 hour 30 minutes.
Mix the topping into a soft paste. Stir cocoa into half if you want brown ones.
Split the dough into 12 balls and set them on lined sheets.
Flatten a ball of topping between plastic wrap and lay it on each bun.
Press a shell pattern into the topping with a knife or concha cutter.
Let rise for 1 hour.
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes, until the bottoms are golden.

recipes.name: Brazilian cheese bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups (150 g) grated parmesan or a mix of parmesan and mozzarella
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Have an adult bring the milk, oil and salt to a boil.
Pour it over the tapioca flour in a bowl and stir until smooth and sticky.
Let cool for 10 minutes.
Beat in the eggs one at a time, then the cheese.
Scoop 1 1/2 tablespoon balls onto a lined baking sheet.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until puffed and golden. They are hollow and chewy inside.

recipes.name: Steamed buns
ingredients: 2/3 cup (150 ml) warm milk or water
steps: Mix the flour, yeast and sugar, then stir in the milk and oil.
Knead for 10 minutes, until very smooth.
Cover and let rise for 1 hour.
Roll into a log and cut into 8 pieces. Put each on a square of parchment.
Let rise in the steamer basket for 20 minutes.
Have an adult set the basket over a pot of boiling water and cover.
Steam for 12 to 15 minutes.
Turn off the heat and wait 5 minutes before lifting the lid so they do not shrink.

recipes.name: Flour tortillas
ingredients: 1/4 cup (50 g) shortening, lard or vegetable oil
steps: Mix the flour, baking powder and salt, then rub in the shortening.
Stir in the hot water and knead for 2 minutes, until smooth.
Split into 8 balls, cover and rest for 30 minutes.
Roll each ball into a thin 8 inch circle.
Heat a dry skillet over medium high heat. Ask an adult to help.
Cook each tortilla for 30 to 60 seconds per side, until bubbly with light brown spots.
Stack them in a towel to keep soft.

recipes.name: Corn tortillas
steps: Mix the masa harina, salt and water into a soft dough like play dough. Add water a spoonful at a time if it cracks.
Cover and rest for 20 minutes.
Roll into 12 balls.
Press each ball between 2 pieces of plastic in a tortilla press or under a heavy pan to about 6 inches.
Heat a dry skillet over medium high heat. Ask an adult to help.
Cook for 1 minute, flip and cook for 1 minute, then flip again for 30 seconds. It may puff.
Keep warm in a towel.

recipes.name: Chocolate babka
ingredients: Filling: 4 oz (115 g) chocolate and 1/2 cup (115 g) butter melted together, 1/2 cup (60 g) powdered sugar, 1/4 cup (20 g) cocoa
Syrup: 1/3 cup (65 g) sugar and 1/3 cup (80 ml) water
steps: Mix the milk, yeast, sugar, eggs, flour and salt, then knead in the butter for 10 minutes, until smooth.
Cover and let rise for 1 hour 30 minutes.
Stir the filling together until smooth.
Roll the dough into a 10 by 15 inch rectangle and spread the filling over it.
Roll up from the long side and chill for 15 minutes.
Cut the log in half lengthwise and twist the two halves together, cut sides up.
Put in a greased 9 by 5 inch loaf pan and let rise for 1 hour.
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Bake for 35 to 45 minutes, until a skewer comes out without wet dough.
Boil the syrup ingredients for 1 minute and brush over the hot babka.

recipes.name: Chapati
ingredients: 2 cups (240 g) whole wheat atta flour
steps: Mix the flour and salt, then add the oil and water and knead for 5 minutes into a soft dough.
Cover and rest for 20 minutes.
Split into 8 balls and roll each into a thin 7 inch circle, dusting with flour.
Heat a dry skillet over medium high heat. Ask an adult to help.
Cook for 30 to 60 seconds, until bubbles show, then flip.
Cook for 1 minute, pressing gently with a folded towel so it puffs.
Brush with ghee and stack in a towel.

recipes.name: Honey oat bread
ingredients: 1 cup (90 g) rolled oats, plus more for the top
2 1/4 teaspoons (7 g) instant or active dry yeast
steps: Pour the boiling water over the oats, honey and butter. Let sit for 20 minutes, until just warm. Ask an adult to help.
Stir the yeast into the warm water and add it to the oats.
Add the flour and salt and knead for 8 minutes.
Cover and let rise for 1 hour.
Shape into a log, brush the top with water, sprinkle with oats and put it in a greased 9 by 5 inch loaf pan.
Let rise for 45 minutes.
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Bake for 35 to 40 minutes, until golden.
Let cool for 1 hour before slicing.

recipes.name: Swedish cardamom buns
ingredients: 2 1/4 teaspoons (7 g) instant or active dry yeast
Filling: 1/2 cup (115 g) butter, softened, 1/2 cup (110 g) packed brown sugar, 2 teaspoons cardamom, 1 teaspoon cinnamon
1 egg for brushing and pearl sugar or coarse sugar
steps: Stir the milk, yeast and sugar and let sit for 5 minutes.
Add the butter, cardamom, salt and flour and knead for 8 minutes.
Cover and let rise for 1 hour.
Roll into a 12 by 16 inch rectangle, spread with the filling and fold into thirds like a letter.
Cut into 12 strips. Twist each strip and tie it into a knot.
Put on lined sheets and let rise for 45 minutes.
Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Brush with egg and sprinkle with pearl sugar.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until golden.

recipes.name: Vanilla layer cake
ingredients: 1 cup (240 ml) milk, at room temperature
1 batch vanilla buttercream or chocolate frosting
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease two 9 inch round pans and line the bottoms with parchment paper.
Whisk the flour, baking powder and salt in a bowl.
Beat the butter and sugar for 3 minutes, until light and fluffy.
Beat in the eggs one at a time, then the vanilla.
Mix in a third of the flour mix, then half the milk. Repeat, ending with flour. Mix until just combined.
Split the batter between the pans and smooth the tops.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, until a toothpick in the middle comes out clean.
Let cool for 10 minutes in the pans, then turn out onto a wire rack.
Let cool for 1 hour before frosting.

recipes.name: Red velvet cake
ingredients: 1 cup (240 ml) buttermilk, at room temperature
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease two 9 inch round pans and line the bottoms with parchment paper.
Whisk the flour, sugar, cocoa, baking soda and salt in a big bowl.
Whisk the oil, buttermilk, eggs, food coloring, vanilla and vinegar in another bowl.
Pour the wet mix into the dry mix and stir until smooth.
Split the batter between the pans.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean. For 24 cupcakes, bake for 18 to 20 minutes.
Let cool for 10 minutes in the pans, then turn out onto a rack.
Let cool for 1 hour, then fill and frost with the cream cheese frosting.

recipes.name: Carrot cake
ingredients: 3 cups (300 g) finely grated carrots, about 5 carrots
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease a 9 by 13 inch pan.
Grate the carrots on the small holes of a box grater. Keep your fingers away from the blades.
Whisk the flour, baking soda, cinnamon and salt in a bowl.
Whisk the eggs, oil, sugar, brown sugar and vanilla in a big bowl.
Stir in the flour mix, then the carrots and walnuts.
Pour into the pan.
Bake for 35 to 40 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.
Let cool for 1 hour, then spread the frosting on top.

recipes.name: Lemon drizzle cake
ingredients: Drizzle: 1/2 cup (100 g) sugar and 1/4 cup (60 ml) lemon juice
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease a 9 by 5 inch loaf pan and line it with parchment paper.
Beat the butter and sugar until fluffy, then beat in the eggs one at a time and the zest.
Stir in the flour, baking powder and salt, then the milk.
Spread in the pan.
Bake for 45 to 50 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.
Stir the drizzle sugar and lemon juice together.
Poke holes all over the warm cake with a skewer and spoon the drizzle over it.
Let cool for 30 minutes in the pan. The drizzle sets into a crunchy crust.

recipes.name: Pound cake
steps: Heat the oven to 325°F (165°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease and flour a 9 by 5 inch loaf pan.
Beat the butter and sugar for 4 minutes, until very light and fluffy.
Beat in the eggs one at a time, then the vanilla.
Stir in the flour, baking powder and salt until just combined.
Spread in the pan.
Bake for 60 to 70 minutes, until golden and a toothpick comes out clean.
Let cool for 15 minutes in the pan, then turn out onto a rack to cool.

recipes.name: Pineapple upside-down cake
ingredients: Topping: 1/4 cup (55 g) butter, melted, 1/2 cup (110 g) packed brown sugar
1/2 cup (120 ml) pineapple juice from the can
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Pour the melted butter into a 9 inch round cake pan and sprinkle the brown sugar over it.
Lay the pineapple rings on top and put a cherry in each hole.
Beat the butter and sugar until fluffy, then beat in the eggs and vanilla.
Stir in the flour, baking powder and salt, then the pineapple juice.
Spread the batter over the pineapple.
Bake for 40 to 45 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.
Let cool for 10 minutes.
Put a plate on top and flip the pan over with oven mitts. Ask an adult to help.

recipes.name: Tres leches cake
ingredients: 1 can (14 oz / 397 g) sweetened condensed milk
Topping: 1 1/2 cups (360 ml) heavy cream whipped with 3 tablespoons sugar, plus cinnamon
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease a 9 by 13 inch pan.
Beat the egg yolks with 3/4 cup of the sugar until pale, then stir in the milk and vanilla.
Stir in the flour, baking powder and salt.
Beat the egg whites in a clean bowl until soft peaks form, then beat in the last 1/4 cup sugar until stiff.
Gently fold the whites into the batter and spread in the pan.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, until golden and a toothpick comes out clean. Let cool for 30 minutes.
Whisk the condensed milk, evaporated milk and cream.
Poke holes all over the cake with a fork and slowly pour the milk mix over it.
Chill for 4 hours so it soaks in.
Spread the whipped cream on top and dust with cinnamon.

recipes.name: Strawberry shortcake
ingredients: 1/4 cup (50 g) sugar for the berries
1/2 cup (115 g) cold butter, cut in cubes
3/4 cup (180 ml) cold heavy cream, plus a little for brushing
Whipped cream: 1 cup (240 ml) heavy cream, 2 tablespoons powdered sugar, 1/2 teaspoon vanilla
steps: Stir the strawberries and 1/4 cup sugar and let sit for 20 minutes to get juicy.
Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Ask an adult to help.
Mix the flour, 3 tablespoons sugar, baking powder and salt.
Rub in the cold butter with your fingers until it looks like coarse crumbs.
Stir in the cream until a shaggy dough forms.
Pat it 3/4 inch thick and cut 8 rounds. Put them on a lined sheet and brush with cream.
Bake for 15 to 18 minutes, until golden.
Whip the cream, powdered sugar and vanilla until soft peaks form.
Split the warm shortcakes, fill with strawberries and whipped cream.

recipes.name: Angel food cake
ingredients: 12 large egg whites (about 1 1/2 cups / 360 ml), at room temperature
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Sift the cake flour with 3/4 cup of the sugar twice.
Beat the egg whites, cream of tartar and salt in a very clean bowl until foamy.
Beat in the other 3/4 cup sugar a little at a time until stiff, glossy peaks form. Beat in the vanilla.
Sift the flour mix over the whites a quarter at a time, folding gently each time.
Spoon into an ungreased 10 inch tube pan and run a knife through to pop big bubbles.
Bake for 35 to 40 minutes, until golden and springy.
Turn the pan upside down onto a bottle neck or its feet and let cool for 2 hours.
Run a knife around the edges to release the cake.

recipes.name: Funfetti sprinkle cake
ingredients: 1/2 cup (80 g) rainbow sprinkles, plus more on top
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease a 9 by 13 inch pan.
Whisk the flour, baking powder and salt.
Beat the butter and sugar until fluffy, then beat in the egg whites and vanilla.
Mix in the flour mix and milk in turns, starting and ending with flour.
Gently fold in the sprinkles.
Spread in the pan.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.
Let cool for 1 hour, then frost and add more sprinkles.

recipes.name: Chocolate cupcakes
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Line a 12-cup muffin pan with paper liners.
Whisk the flour, cocoa, sugar, baking soda, baking powder and salt in a big bowl.
Whisk in the egg, milk, oil and vanilla.
Carefully stir in the hot water. The batter will be thin.
Fill each liner 2/3 full.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.
Let cool for 1 hour, then frost.

recipes.name: Lemon cupcakes
ingredients: Frosting: 1/2 cup (115 g) butter, 2 cups (240 g) powdered sugar, 2 tablespoons lemon juice, 1 teaspoon zest
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Line a 12-cup muffin pan with liners.
Rub the zest into the sugar with your fingers, then beat with the butter until fluffy.
Beat in the eggs and lemon juice.
Mix in the flour, baking powder and salt in turns with the milk.
Fill the liners 2/3 full.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.
Let cool for 1 hour.
Beat the frosting ingredients until fluffy and pipe or spread on top.

recipes.name: Strawberry cupcakes
ingredients: Frosting: 1/2 cup (115 g) butter, 2 1/2 cups (300 g) powdered sugar, 3 tablespoons of the strawberry puree
steps: Blend the strawberries until smooth.
Simmer the puree in a small pot for 10 to 15 minutes, stirring, until it cooks down to about 1/2 cup. Let cool.
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Line a muffin pan with 12 liners.
Beat the butter and sugar, then beat in the eggs and vanilla.
Stir in the flour, baking powder and salt, then the milk and 1/3 cup of the puree.
Fill the liners 2/3 full and bake for 18 to 20 minutes.
Let cool for 1 hour.
Beat the frosting ingredients until fluffy and spread on top.

recipes.name: Baked New York cheesecake
ingredients: Crust: 1 1/2 cups (150 g) graham cracker crumbs, 1/4 cup (50 g) sugar, 6 tablespoons (85 g) butter, melted
steps: Heat the oven to 325°F (165°C). Ask an adult to help.
Mix the crust ingredients and press into the bottom of a 9 inch springform pan.
Bake the crust for 10 minutes.
Beat the cream cheese, sugar and flour on low until smooth.
Beat in the sour cream and vanilla.
Beat in the eggs one at a time on low, just until mixed. Too much beating makes cracks.
Pour over the crust.
Bake for 60 to 70 minutes, until the edges are set and the middle still jiggles a little.
Turn off the oven, crack the door and leave the cheesecake inside for 1 hour.
Chill for at least 6 hours before slicing.

recipes.name: Mini cheesecakes
ingredients: Fruit or pie filling to top
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Line a muffin pan with 12 foil or paper liners and put a wafer in each.
Beat the cream cheese, sugar and vanilla until smooth.
Beat in the eggs on low, just until mixed.
Fill each liner 3/4 full.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes, until the middles are almost set.
Let cool for 30 minutes, then chill for 2 hours.
Top with fruit before serving.

recipes.name: Texas chocolate sheet cake
ingredients: Frosting: 1/2 cup (115 g) butter, 1/4 cup (20 g) cocoa, 6 tablespoons milk, 3 1/2 cups (420 g) powdered sugar, 1 teaspoon vanilla, 1 cup (115 g) chopped pecans
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease a 10 by 15 inch rimmed pan.
Whisk the flour, sugar, baking soda and salt in a big bowl.
Heat the butter, water and cocoa in a pot until it boils. Ask an adult to help.
Pour the hot cocoa mix into the flour mix and stir.
Stir in the sour cream, eggs and vanilla.
Pour into the pan and bake for 20 to 22 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.
For the frosting, heat the butter, cocoa and milk until it bubbles, then take it off the heat.
Whisk in the powdered sugar and vanilla, then the pecans.
Pour the warm frosting over the warm cake and spread. Let cool for 30 minutes.

recipes.name: Black Forest cake
ingredients: 1 can (21 oz / 595 g) cherry pie filling
Cream: 2 1/2 cups (600 ml) heavy cream, 1/3 cup (40 g) powdered sugar, 1 teaspoon vanilla
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease two 9 inch round pans and line with parchment paper.
Whisk the flour, cocoa, sugar, baking powder, baking soda and salt.
Beat in the eggs, milk, oil and vanilla for 2 minutes.
Carefully stir in the boiling water. Ask an adult to help.
Pour into the pans and bake for 30 to 35 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.
Let cool for 10 minutes in the pans, then 1 hour on a rack.
Whip the cream, powdered sugar and vanilla until stiff peaks form.
Put one cake on a plate, spread with cream, then spoon on half the cherry filling.
Add the second cake, cover the whole cake with cream, then top with the rest of the cherries and chocolate shavings.
Chill for 30 minutes before slicing.

recipes.name: Tiramisu
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups (360 ml) strong coffee or decaf, cooled
steps: Brew the coffee and let it cool. Decaf works and has less caffeine for kids.
Whip the cream until soft peaks form.
Beat the mascarpone, powdered sugar and vanilla until smooth, then fold in the whipped cream.
Dip each ladyfinger in the coffee for 1 second and lay it in an 8 by 8 inch dish.
Spread half the cream over the ladyfingers.
Add another layer of dipped ladyfingers and the rest of the cream.
Cover and chill for 6 hours.
Dust with cocoa through a strainer before serving.

recipes.name: Victoria sponge
ingredients: 1/2 cup (160 g) strawberry or raspberry jam
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease two 8 inch round pans and line the bottoms with parchment paper.
Beat the butter and sugar until pale and fluffy.
Beat in the eggs one at a time, then the vanilla.
Fold in the flour and baking powder, then the milk.
Split between the pans and smooth the tops.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until golden and springy.
Let cool for 10 minutes in the pans, then 30 minutes on a rack.
Spread jam on one cake, then whipped cream, and put the other cake on top.
Dust with powdered sugar.

recipes.name: Swiss roll
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Line a 10 by 15 inch rimmed pan with greased parchment paper.
Beat the eggs and sugar for 5 minutes, until thick and pale. Beat in the vanilla.
Sift in the flour, baking powder and salt and fold gently.
Spread in the pan.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes, until springy.
Dust a clean kitchen towel with powdered sugar and flip the hot cake onto it. Ask an adult to help.
Peel off the paper and roll the cake up in the towel from the short end.
Let cool rolled up for 1 hour.
Unroll, spread with jam and whipped cream, and roll it back up without the towel.

recipes.name: Gingerbread cake
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease a 9 by 9 inch pan.
Beat the butter and sugar, then beat in the egg and molasses.
Whisk the flour, baking soda, spices and salt in another bowl.
Stir the flour mix into the molasses mix.
Carefully stir in the hot water until smooth.
Pour into the pan.
Bake for 50 to 60 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.
Let cool for 20 minutes. Serve with whipped cream.

recipes.name: Apple cake
ingredients: 2 medium apples, peeled and thinly sliced
Topping: 1 tablespoon sugar mixed with 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease a 9 inch round or square pan.
Peel, core and slice the apples. Ask an adult to help with the knife.
Beat the butter and sugar, then beat in the eggs and vanilla.
Stir in the flour, baking powder, cinnamon and salt, then the milk.
Spread the batter in the pan and press the apple slices into the top in circles.
Sprinkle with the cinnamon sugar.
Bake for 45 to 50 minutes, until golden and a toothpick comes out clean.
Let cool for 20 minutes before slicing.

recipes.name: Orange olive oil cake
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease a 9 inch round pan and line the bottom with parchment paper.
Whisk the eggs, sugar and zest for 2 minutes, until pale.
Whisk in the olive oil, milk and orange juice.
Stir in the flour, baking powder and salt until smooth.
Pour into the pan.
Bake for 40 to 45 minutes, until golden and a toothpick comes out clean.
Let cool for 20 minutes, then dust with powdered sugar.

recipes.name: Hot fudge pudding cake
ingredients: Topping: 1 cup (220 g) packed brown sugar and 1/4 cup (20 g) cocoa
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Stir the flour, sugar, cocoa, baking powder and salt in an ungreased 9 by 9 inch pan.
Stir in the milk, oil and vanilla, then spread it flat.
Sprinkle the brown sugar and cocoa topping evenly over the batter.
Carefully pour the hot water over the top. Do not stir. Ask an adult to help.
Bake for 40 minutes, until the top looks like cake. The sauce forms underneath.
Let cool for 15 minutes, then spoon into bowls with the sauce. Great with ice cream.

recipes.name: Cherry pineapple dump cake
ingredients: 1 can (20 oz / 567 g) crushed pineapple with its juice
1 can (21 oz / 595 g) cherry pie filling
1 box (15.25 oz / 432 g) yellow cake mix, dry
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Spread the pineapple and juice in a 9 by 13 inch pan.
Spoon the cherry pie filling over it.
Sprinkle the dry cake mix evenly on top. Do not stir.
Drizzle the melted butter all over the cake mix so most of it is wet.
Bake for 45 to 50 minutes, until golden and bubbly.
Let cool for 15 minutes. Serve warm with ice cream.

recipes.name: Basbousa
ingredients: Syrup: 1 cup (200 g) sugar, 3/4 cup (180 ml) water, 1 teaspoon lemon juice
steps: Simmer the syrup ingredients for 10 minutes, then let cool. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease an 8 by 8 inch pan.
Mix the semolina, coconut, sugar and baking powder.
Stir in the yogurt, melted butter and milk. It will be thick.
Spread it in the pan, cut it into 16 diamonds or squares and press an almond into each.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes, until golden brown.
Pour the cool syrup over the hot cake right away.
Let rest for 1 hour so it soaks in, then cut along the lines.

recipes.name: Coconut cake
ingredients: 1 cup (240 ml) canned coconut milk, stirred
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease a 9 by 13 inch pan.
Beat the butter and sugar until fluffy, then beat in the eggs and vanilla.
Mix in the flour, baking powder and salt in turns with the coconut milk.
Spread in the pan.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.
Let cool for 1 hour.
Spread the frosting on top and press the shredded coconut all over it.

recipes.name: Marble cake
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cocoa powder mixed with 2 tablespoons milk
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease and line a 9 by 5 inch loaf pan.
Beat the butter and sugar, then beat in the eggs and vanilla.
Stir in the flour, baking powder and salt in turns with the milk.
Spoon half the batter into another bowl and stir in the cocoa mix.
Drop spoonfuls of both batters into the pan, then swirl once with a knife.
Bake for 50 to 55 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.
Let cool for 15 minutes in the pan, then on a rack.

recipes.name: Pavlova
ingredients: 4 large egg whites, at room temperature
2 cups fresh berries and kiwi slices
steps: Heat the oven to 250°F (120°C). Ask an adult to help.
Draw an 8 inch circle on parchment paper and put it upside down on a baking sheet.
Beat the egg whites until soft peaks form.
Add the sugar 1 tablespoon at a time while beating, until stiff and glossy.
Beat in the vinegar, cornstarch and vanilla.
Spread inside the circle, making the edges a little higher than the middle.
Bake for 1 hour 15 minutes, until crisp outside.
Turn off the oven and leave it inside with the door shut for 1 hour.
Just before serving, top with whipped cream and fruit.

recipes.name: Cream puffs
ingredients: Filling: 1 cup (240 ml) heavy cream, 2 tablespoons powdered sugar, 1/2 teaspoon vanilla
Powdered sugar or melted chocolate for the tops
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Bring the water, butter and salt to a boil in a pot. Ask an adult to help.
Dump in the flour and stir hard for 1 minute, until it forms a ball.
Take it off the heat and let cool for 5 minutes.
Beat in the eggs one at a time until the dough is smooth and glossy.
Drop 12 mounds onto a lined baking sheet.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, until puffed and deep golden. Do not open the oven early or they collapse.
Poke a small hole in each and let cool for 30 minutes.
Whip the filling until stiff, cut the puffs in half and fill them.
Dust with powdered sugar or dip the tops in melted chocolate.

recipes.name: Churros
ingredients: Coating: 1/2 cup (100 g) sugar mixed with 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon
steps: An adult should do the frying. Hot oil is dangerous.
Bring the water, sugar, salt and 2 tablespoons oil to a boil in a pot.
Take it off the heat, add the flour and stir until it forms a smooth ball.
Let cool for 5 minutes, then spoon it into a piping bag with a big star tip.
Heat 2 inches of oil in a deep pot to 375°F (190°C).
Pipe 5 inch strips into the oil and cut them off with scissors.
Fry for 2 to 3 minutes, turning once, until golden.
Drain on paper towels for 1 minute, then roll in the cinnamon sugar.

recipes.name: Strawberry mochi
ingredients: 1/2 cup (140 g) sweet red bean paste
steps: Wrap each strawberry in about 1 tablespoon of red bean paste, leaving the tip showing.
Whisk the rice flour, sugar and water in a microwave-safe bowl until smooth.
Cover and microwave for 1 minute, then stir with a wet spatula.
Microwave for 1 minute more, stir, then 30 seconds more, until thick and see-through.
Dust the counter with cornstarch and tip the hot dough onto it. It is very hot, so let it cool for 5 minutes.
Cut into 8 pieces with a dusted knife.
Flatten each piece, wrap it around a strawberry and pinch it closed.
Eat the same day.

recipes.name: Strawberry poke cake
ingredients: 1 box (15.25 oz / 432 g) white cake mix, plus the eggs, oil and water on the box
8 oz (225 g) frozen whipped topping, thawed
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Make and bake the cake in a 9 by 13 inch pan following the box. Let cool for 20 minutes.
Poke holes all over the cake with a fork or the handle of a wooden spoon.
Stir the gelatin into the boiling water for 2 minutes, until dissolved. Ask an adult to help.
Stir in the cold water.
Slowly pour the gelatin over the cake so it fills the holes.
Chill for 3 hours.
Spread the whipped topping over the cake and add sliced strawberries.

recipes.name: Chocolate icebox cake
ingredients: 1 package (9 oz / 255 g) thin chocolate wafer cookies
Chocolate shavings or berries to top
steps: Whip the cream, powdered sugar and vanilla until stiff peaks form.
Spread a little cream on a plate.
Spread a spoonful of cream on each wafer and stack them in a long log on its side on the plate.
Cover the whole log with the rest of the cream.
Chill for 6 hours. The wafers soften into cake.
Top with shavings or berries and cut slices at an angle.

recipes.name: Fruit pizza
ingredients: Topping: 8 oz (225 g) cream cheese, softened, 1/2 cup (60 g) powdered sugar, 1 teaspoon vanilla
3 cups sliced fruit like strawberries, kiwi, blueberries and mandarin oranges
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Beat the butter and sugar, then the egg and vanilla. Stir in the flour, baking powder and salt.
Press the dough into a 12 inch round pizza pan.
Bake for 15 to 18 minutes, until light golden. Let cool for 45 minutes.
Beat the cream cheese, powdered sugar and vanilla until smooth.
Spread it over the cookie crust.
Arrange the fruit on top in circles.
Cut into wedges with a pizza cutter.

recipes.name: Cookies and cream cupcakes
ingredients: Frosting: 1/2 cup (115 g) butter, 2 cups (240 g) powdered sugar, 2 tablespoons milk, 5 crushed cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Line a muffin pan with 12 liners and put a whole cookie in the bottom of each.
Crush 5 more cookies into crumbs for the frosting.
Beat the butter and sugar, then beat in the eggs and vanilla.
Mix in the flour, baking powder and salt in turns with the milk.
Fill the liners 2/3 full over the cookies.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.
Let cool for 1 hour.
Beat the frosting butter, sugar and milk, stir in the crumbs, and frost.

recipes.name: Vanilla buttercream frosting
steps: Beat the butter for 2 minutes, until pale and creamy.
Add the powdered sugar 1 cup at a time on low speed.
Add the milk, vanilla and salt.
Beat on high for 3 minutes, until light and fluffy.
Add more milk to make it softer or more sugar to make it stiffer. This frosts 24 cupcakes or a 2 layer cake.

recipes.name: Chocolate frosting
steps: Beat the butter until creamy.
Sift the powdered sugar and cocoa together so there are no lumps.
Add the sugar mix a little at a time with the milk, beating on low.
Add the vanilla and salt.
Beat on high for 2 minutes, until fluffy.

recipes.name: Cream cheese frosting
steps: Beat the cream cheese and butter until smooth.
Add the powdered sugar a little at a time on low.
Beat in the vanilla and salt until fluffy. Do not overbeat or it gets runny.
Keep anything frosted with it in the fridge.

recipes.name: Whipped cream
steps: Chill the bowl and beaters in the freezer for 10 minutes.
Pour in the cream, powdered sugar and vanilla.
Beat on medium high for 2 to 3 minutes, until soft peaks form.
Stop as soon as it holds its shape. Too much beating turns it into butter.

recipes.name: Royal icing
steps: Use meringue powder instead of raw egg whites so it is safe to eat.
Beat the powdered sugar, meringue powder and 6 tablespoons water on low for 5 minutes, until glossy and stiff.
Add water a teaspoon at a time to thin it for flooding cookies.
Tint with gel coloring.
Keep it covered with a damp towel. It dries hard in about 6 hours.

recipes.name: Powdered sugar glaze
ingredients: 1 1/2 to 2 tablespoons milk or lemon juice
steps: Put the powdered sugar in a bowl.
Stir in the milk a little at a time with the vanilla until smooth and thick but pourable.
Drizzle over cakes, cinnamon rolls or cookies.
Let set for 15 minutes.

recipes.name: Peanut butter cookies
ingredients: 1/2 cup (100 g) sugar, plus 2 tablespoons for rolling
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Whisk the flour, baking soda and salt in a bowl.
Beat the butter, peanut butter, sugar and brown sugar in a big bowl until creamy.
Beat in the egg and vanilla.
Stir in the flour mix until no dry flour shows.
Roll the dough into 1 1/4 inch balls and roll them in the extra sugar.
Put them on a baking sheet 2 inches apart and press each one with a fork to make a criss cross.
Bake for 9 to 11 minutes, until the edges are just golden.
Let cool for 5 minutes on the sheet, then move them to a wire rack.

recipes.name: Oatmeal raisin cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Beat the butter, brown sugar and sugar in a big bowl until creamy.
Beat in the eggs one at a time, then the vanilla.
Whisk the flour, baking soda, cinnamon and salt in another bowl, then stir it into the butter mix.
Stir in the oats and raisins.
Drop rounded tablespoons of dough onto a baking sheet, 2 inches apart.
Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until the edges are golden and the middles still look a little soft.
Let cool for 5 minutes on the sheet, then move them to a wire rack.

recipes.name: Snickerdoodles
ingredients: For rolling: 3 tablespoons sugar mixed with 1 tablespoon ground cinnamon
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Ask an adult to help.
Whisk the flour, cream of tartar, baking soda and salt in a bowl.
Beat the butter and sugar in a big bowl for 2 minutes, until light and fluffy.
Beat in the eggs and vanilla.
Stir in the flour mix until a soft dough forms.
Roll the dough into 1 1/2 inch balls and roll each ball in the cinnamon sugar.
Put them on a baking sheet 2 inches apart.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes, until set at the edges and puffed in the middle.
Let cool for 5 minutes on the sheet. They sink and crinkle as they cool.

recipes.name: Double chocolate cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Whisk the flour, cocoa, baking soda and salt in a bowl.
Beat the butter, sugar and brown sugar in a big bowl until creamy.
Beat in the eggs and vanilla.
Stir in the flour mix, then the chocolate chips.
Scoop 2 tablespoon balls onto a baking sheet, 2 inches apart.
Bake for 9 to 11 minutes. They should still look soft in the middle.
Let cool for 5 minutes on the sheet, then move them to a wire rack.

recipes.name: White chocolate macadamia cookies
ingredients: 1 cup (135 g) macadamia nuts, roughly chopped
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Whisk the flour, baking soda and salt in a bowl.
Beat the butter, brown sugar and sugar until creamy.
Beat in the egg, egg yolk and vanilla.
Stir in the flour mix, then the white chocolate chips and nuts.
Scoop 2 tablespoon balls onto a baking sheet, 2 inches apart.
Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until the edges are light golden.
Let cool for 5 minutes on the sheet, then move them to a wire rack.

recipes.name: Candy-coated chocolate cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Whisk the flour, baking soda and salt in a bowl.
Beat the butter, brown sugar and sugar until creamy, then beat in the eggs and vanilla.
Stir in the flour mix.
Stir in 1 cup of the candies and save the rest.
Scoop 2 tablespoon balls onto a baking sheet, 2 inches apart, and press a few extra candies on top of each.
Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until the edges are golden.
Let cool for 5 minutes on the sheet, then move them to a wire rack.

recipes.name: Chewy molasses cookies
ingredients: 1 cup (200 g) sugar, plus 1/4 cup (50 g) for rolling
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Ask an adult to help.
Whisk the flour, baking soda, ginger, cinnamon, cloves and salt in a bowl.
Beat the butter and 1 cup of sugar until fluffy.
Beat in the egg and molasses.
Stir in the flour mix.
Roll the dough into 1 inch balls and roll them in the extra sugar.
Put them on a baking sheet 2 inches apart.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes, until the tops crack. Bake 2 minutes longer for crisp ginger snaps.
Let cool for 5 minutes on the sheet, then move them to a wire rack.

recipes.name: Gingerbread cookies
ingredients: Icing: 1 cup (120 g) powdered sugar mixed with 1 to 2 tablespoons milk
steps: Whisk the flour, spices, baking soda and salt in a bowl.
Beat the butter and brown sugar until fluffy, then beat in the egg, molasses and vanilla.
Stir in the flour mix until a dough forms.
Split the dough in half, flatten each half into a disk and wrap it.
Chill for 1 hour.
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Roll the dough 1/4 inch thick on a floured counter and cut out shapes.
Put them on a lined baking sheet 1 inch apart.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes, until the edges are firm.
Let cool for 5 minutes on the sheet, then move them to a wire rack.
Decorate with the icing once they are completely cool.

recipes.name: Scottish shortbread
ingredients: 1/2 cup (100 g) sugar, plus a little for sprinkling
steps: Heat the oven to 325°F (165°C). Ask an adult to help.
Beat the butter, sugar and salt until creamy.
Stir in the flour until it comes together as a soft dough.
Press the dough evenly into an 8 by 8 inch pan.
Prick it all over with a fork and sprinkle with a little sugar.
Bake for 35 to 40 minutes, until pale golden at the edges.
Cut it into 16 bars while still warm. Ask an adult to help.
Let cool for 20 minutes in the pan before lifting out the bars.

recipes.name: Jam thumbprint cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Beat the butter and sugar until creamy, then beat in the egg yolks and vanilla.
Stir in the flour and salt.
Roll the dough into 1 inch balls and put them on a baking sheet 1 inch apart.
Press your thumb into the middle of each ball to make a dent.
Fill each dent with about 1/2 teaspoon of jam.
Bake for 12 to 14 minutes, until the edges are light golden.
Let cool for 5 minutes on the sheet, then move them to a wire rack.

recipes.name: No-bake chocolate oat cookies
steps: Line 2 baking sheets with wax paper.
Put the butter, sugar, milk and cocoa in a pot over medium heat. Ask an adult to help, the mix gets very hot.
Bring it to a rolling boil, then boil for 1 minute without stirring.
Take the pot off the heat and stir in the peanut butter, vanilla and salt until smooth.
Stir in the oats.
Drop spoonfuls onto the wax paper.
Let set for 30 minutes at room temperature.

recipes.name: Monster cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Beat the butter, peanut butter, brown sugar and sugar until creamy.
Beat in the eggs, vanilla, baking soda and salt.
Stir in the oats, chocolate chips and candies. There is no flour in these.
Scoop 2 tablespoon balls onto a baking sheet, 2 inches apart, and flatten them a little.
Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until the edges are golden.
Let cool for 5 minutes on the sheet, then move them to a wire rack.

recipes.name: Lemon crinkle cookies
ingredients: 1/2 cup (60 g) powdered sugar for rolling
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Beat the butter and sugar until fluffy.
Beat in the egg, lemon zest, lemon juice and vanilla.
Stir in the flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt.
Roll the dough into 1 inch balls and roll them thickly in the powdered sugar.
Put them on a baking sheet 2 inches apart.
Bake for 9 to 11 minutes, until the bottoms are just golden.
Let cool for 5 minutes on the sheet, then move them to a wire rack.

recipes.name: Chocolate crinkle cookies
ingredients: 1/2 cup (60 g) powdered sugar for rolling
steps: Mix the cocoa, sugar and oil in a big bowl.
Beat in the eggs one at a time, then the vanilla.
Stir in the flour, baking powder and salt.
Cover and chill for 4 hours, until firm.
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Roll the dough into 1 inch balls and roll them thickly in the powdered sugar.
Put them on a lined baking sheet 2 inches apart.
Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until puffed and cracked.
Let cool for 5 minutes on the sheet, then move them to a wire rack.

recipes.name: Snowball cookies
ingredients: 1/2 cup (60 g) powdered sugar, plus 1 cup (120 g) for rolling
3/4 cup (85 g) pecans or walnuts, finely chopped
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Ask an adult to help.
Beat the butter, 1/2 cup powdered sugar and vanilla until creamy.
Stir in the flour, salt and nuts until a dough forms.
Roll the dough into 1 inch balls and put them on a baking sheet.
Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until set but not brown.
Let cool for 5 minutes, then roll the warm cookies in powdered sugar.
Let cool completely, then roll them in powdered sugar again.

recipes.name: Oatmeal chocolate chip cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Beat the butter, brown sugar and sugar until creamy.
Beat in the eggs and vanilla.
Stir in the flour, baking soda and salt.
Stir in the oats and chocolate chips.
Drop rounded tablespoons onto a baking sheet, 2 inches apart.
Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until golden at the edges.
Let cool for 5 minutes on the sheet, then move them to a wire rack.

recipes.name: Peanut butter blossoms
ingredients: 1/3 cup (65 g) sugar, plus 1/4 cup (50 g) for rolling
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Ask an adult to help.
Beat the butter, peanut butter, sugar and brown sugar until fluffy.
Beat in the egg, milk and vanilla.
Stir in the flour, baking soda and salt.
Roll into 1 inch balls, roll them in the extra sugar and put them on a baking sheet.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes, until light golden.
Right away, press a chocolate kiss into the middle of each cookie. The cookie cracks around it.
Let cool for 1 hour so the chocolate sets.

recipes.name: Funfetti sprinkle cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Beat the butter and sugar until fluffy.
Beat in the egg and vanilla.
Stir in the flour, cornstarch, baking soda and salt.
Gently stir in the sprinkles.
Roll into 1 1/2 inch balls and put them on a baking sheet 2 inches apart.
Bake for 9 to 11 minutes, until the edges are set but the tops are still pale.
Let cool for 5 minutes on the sheet, then move them to a wire rack.

recipes.name: Coconut macaroons
ingredients: 1 can (14 oz / 397 g) sweetened condensed milk
steps: Heat the oven to 325°F (165°C). Ask an adult to help.
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Mix the coconut, condensed milk and vanilla in a big bowl.
Beat the egg whites and salt in a clean bowl until stiff peaks form.
Gently fold the egg whites into the coconut mix.
Scoop 2 tablespoon mounds onto the baking sheet.
Bake for 22 to 25 minutes, until golden on the outside.
Let cool for 30 minutes, then dip the bottoms in melted chocolate if you like.

recipes.name: Meringue cookies
ingredients: 3 large egg whites, at room temperature
steps: Heat the oven to 225°F (110°C). Ask an adult to help.
Line 2 baking sheets with parchment paper.
Beat the egg whites and cream of tartar until foamy.
Add the sugar 1 tablespoon at a time while beating on high.
Beat until stiff, glossy peaks form and the sugar has dissolved. Beat in the vanilla and coloring.
Pipe or spoon small mounds onto the sheets.
Bake for 1 hour 30 minutes, until dry and they lift off the paper easily.
Turn off the oven and leave them inside for 1 hour to dry more.

recipes.name: Almond biscotti
ingredients: 1 cup (140 g) whole almonds, roughly chopped
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt in a big bowl.
Beat the eggs and both extracts in a small bowl, then stir them into the flour mix.
Stir in the almonds. The dough will be sticky.
Shape it into 2 logs about 12 inches long and 2 inches wide on a lined baking sheet.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, until firm and light golden.
Let cool for 10 minutes, then cut the logs into 1/2 inch slices with a serrated knife. Ask an adult to help.
Lay the slices cut side down and bake for 10 minutes.
Flip them and bake for 10 minutes more, until dry and crisp.

recipes.name: Anzac biscuits
ingredients: 2 tablespoons golden syrup or light corn syrup
steps: Heat the oven to 325°F (165°C). Ask an adult to help.
Mix the oats, flour, coconut and brown sugar in a big bowl.
Melt the butter and syrup in a small pot over low heat.
Mix the baking soda with the boiling water and stir it into the butter. It will foam. Ask an adult to help.
Pour the butter mix into the dry mix and stir well.
Roll tablespoons of dough into balls, put them on a lined baking sheet and flatten them a little.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until golden.
Let cool for 10 minutes on the sheet. They crisp up as they cool.

recipes.name: Alfajores
ingredients: 1/3 cup (25 g) shredded coconut for rolling
steps: Whisk the cornstarch, flour, baking powder and salt.
Beat the butter and sugar until creamy, then beat in the yolks, vanilla and lemon zest.
Stir in the dry mix until a soft dough forms. Wrap it and chill for 30 minutes.
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Roll the dough 1/4 inch thick and cut 2 inch circles.
Bake on a lined sheet for 10 to 12 minutes. They should stay pale.
Let cool for 20 minutes. They are fragile, so handle gently.
Spread dulce de leche on half the cookies and top with the others.
Roll the edges in coconut.

recipes.name: Speculoos spice cookies
ingredients: 1 cup (220 g) packed dark brown sugar
steps: Whisk the flour, spices, baking soda and salt.
Beat the butter and brown sugar until creamy, then beat in the egg.
Stir in the flour mix. Flatten the dough into a disk, wrap it and chill for 1 hour.
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Roll the dough 1/8 inch thick and cut into rectangles or shapes.
Bake on a lined sheet for 10 to 12 minutes, until browned at the edges.
Let cool on a wire rack. They get crisp as they cool.

recipes.name: Blondies
ingredients: 1/2 cup (85 g) chocolate chips or butterscotch chips
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Line an 8 by 8 inch pan with parchment paper.
Stir the melted butter and brown sugar together.
Stir in the egg and vanilla.
Stir in the flour, baking powder and salt, then the chips.
Spread the batter in the pan.
Bake for 22 to 25 minutes, until golden and just set in the middle.
Let cool for 30 minutes, then cut into squares.

recipes.name: Lemon bars
ingredients: Crust: 1/2 cup (115 g) butter, softened, 1/4 cup (30 g) powdered sugar, 1 cup (125 g) all-purpose flour, pinch of salt
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Line an 8 by 8 inch pan with parchment paper.
Mix the crust ingredients until crumbly and press into the pan.
Bake for 15 to 18 minutes, until light golden.
Whisk the sugar, flour, eggs, lemon juice and zest until smooth.
Pour the lemon mix over the hot crust.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes, until the filling no longer jiggles.
Let cool for 30 minutes, then chill for 1 hour.
Dust with powdered sugar and cut into squares.

recipes.name: Magic cookie bars
ingredients: 1 can (14 oz / 397 g) sweetened condensed milk
1 cup (115 g) chopped walnuts or pecans
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Mix the crumbs and melted butter and press into a 9 by 13 inch pan.
Pour the condensed milk evenly over the crust.
Sprinkle on the chocolate chips, butterscotch chips, coconut and nuts.
Press everything down gently with a fork.
Bake for 25 minutes, until golden on top.
Let cool completely before cutting into bars.

recipes.name: No-bake peanut butter bars
ingredients: 1 cup (260 g) peanut butter, plus 4 tablespoons for the topping
steps: Line a 9 by 13 inch pan with parchment paper.
Mix the melted butter, crumbs, powdered sugar and 1 cup peanut butter.
Press the mix evenly into the pan.
Microwave the chocolate chips and 4 tablespoons peanut butter for 30 seconds at a time, stirring, until smooth.
Spread the chocolate over the peanut butter layer.
Chill for 1 hour, until firm.
Let sit for 10 minutes, then cut into bars.

recipes.name: Millionaire shortbread
ingredients: Base: 1 cup (125 g) all-purpose flour, 1/4 cup (50 g) sugar, 1/2 cup (115 g) butter, softened
Caramel: 1/2 cup (115 g) butter, 1/2 cup (110 g) packed brown sugar, 1 can (14 oz / 397 g) sweetened condensed milk
Topping: 7 oz (200 g) milk chocolate, chopped
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Line an 8 by 8 inch pan with parchment paper.
Rub the base ingredients together, press into the pan and prick with a fork.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until light golden. Let cool.
Put the caramel ingredients in a pot over medium heat. Ask an adult to help, hot caramel burns.
Stir all the time for 8 to 10 minutes, until thick and golden.
Pour the caramel over the base and chill for 1 hour.
Melt the chocolate in the microwave for 30 seconds at a time, stirring each time, and spread it over the caramel.
Chill for 1 hour, then cut into squares with a hot knife.

recipes.name: Nanaimo bars
ingredients: Base: 1/2 cup (115 g) butter, 1/4 cup (50 g) sugar, 5 tablespoons cocoa powder, 1 egg, beaten
Middle: 1/2 cup (115 g) butter, softened, 3 tablespoons milk, 2 tablespoons custard powder, 2 cups (240 g) powdered sugar
Top: 4 oz (115 g) semisweet chocolate and 2 tablespoons butter
steps: Put the base butter, sugar and cocoa in a heatproof bowl over a pot of simmering water. Ask an adult to help.
Stir until melted, then whisk in the egg and cook for 2 to 3 minutes, stirring, until thick.
Stir in the crumbs, coconut and walnuts, and press into a lined 8 by 8 inch pan. Chill for 30 minutes.
Beat the middle layer ingredients until smooth and spread over the base. Chill for 30 minutes.
Melt the chocolate and butter together and spread over the top.
Chill for 1 hour, then cut with a hot knife.

recipes.name: Oatmeal jam bars
ingredients: 1 cup (320 g) raspberry or strawberry jam
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Line an 8 by 8 inch pan with parchment paper.
Mix the flour, oats, brown sugar, baking soda and salt, then stir in the melted butter.
Press 2/3 of the mix into the pan.
Spread the jam over it, leaving a small border.
Sprinkle the rest of the crumbs on top.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes, until golden.
Let cool completely before cutting.

recipes.name: S'mores bars
ingredients: 3 milk chocolate bars (1.55 oz / 44 g each)
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Beat the butter, sugar and brown sugar, then beat in the egg and vanilla.
Stir in the flour, crumbs, baking powder and salt.
Press half the dough into a lined 8 by 8 inch pan.
Lay the chocolate bars on top, then spread on the marshmallow creme.
Flatten small pieces of the rest of the dough and lay them over the marshmallow.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes, until golden.
Let cool completely before cutting.

recipes.name: Cream cheese brownies
ingredients: Swirl: 8 oz (225 g) cream cheese, softened, 1/4 cup (50 g) sugar, 1 egg yolk, 1/2 teaspoon vanilla
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Line an 8 by 8 inch pan with parchment paper.
Microwave the butter and chocolate for 30 seconds at a time, stirring, until smooth.
Stir in the sugar, then the eggs and vanilla, then the flour and salt.
Beat the swirl ingredients until smooth.
Spread most of the brownie batter in the pan, drop spoonfuls of the swirl on top, then the rest of the batter.
Drag a knife through to make swirls.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes, until the swirl is set.
Let cool for 1 hour, then chill before cutting.

recipes.name: Edible cookie dough
