Toss gently.
Put the feta on top and sprinkle with oregano.

recipes.name: Caprese salad
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon flaky salt and a pinch of pepper
steps: Slice the tomatoes and mozzarella about 1/4 inch thick. Ask an adult to help.
Lay them on a plate, overlapping and switching between tomato and cheese.
Tuck basil leaves between the slices.
Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic glaze.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper.

recipes.name: Cobb salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup (60 g) crumbled blue cheese or cheddar
Dressing: 1/4 cup (60 ml) olive oil, 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar, 1 teaspoon Dijon mustard, 1/4 teaspoon salt
steps: Spread the lettuce on a big platter.
Lay the chicken, bacon, eggs, avocado, tomatoes and cheese on top in neat rows.
Shake the dressing in a jar.
Drizzle over the salad, or serve it on the side.

recipes.name: Classic potato salad
ingredients: 2 1/2 lb (1.1 kg) Yukon Gold or red potatoes, cut in 1 inch cubes
1 tablespoon pickle relish or chopped pickles
1/2 teaspoon salt and a pinch of pepper
steps: Put the potatoes in a pot of cold salted water and bring to a boil. Ask an adult to help.
Boil for 10 to 12 minutes, until a fork slides in easily but they hold their shape.
Drain and let cool for 20 minutes.
Stir the mayo, mustard, relish, vinegar, salt and pepper in a big bowl.
Add the potatoes, celery, green onions and eggs and fold gently.
Chill for 1 hour. Sprinkle with paprika.

recipes.name: German potato salad
ingredients: 2 lb (900 g) small red potatoes, sliced 1/4 inch thick
steps: Boil the potatoes for 10 to 12 minutes, until just tender. Ask an adult to help drain them.
Cook the bacon in a big pan over medium heat for 6 to 8 minutes, until crisp. Lift it out.
Cook the onion in the bacon fat for 4 minutes, until soft.
Stir in the vinegar, water, sugar, mustard and salt and simmer for 1 minute.
Add the potatoes and bacon and toss gently.
Sprinkle with parsley and serve warm.

recipes.name: Macaroni salad
steps: Boil the macaroni in salted water following the package, plus 1 minute so it is soft. Ask an adult to help drain it.
Rinse with cold water and drain well.
Whisk the mayo, vinegar, sugar, mustard and salt in a big bowl.
Stir in the macaroni, celery, carrot, pepper and green onions.
Chill for 1 hour. Stir in a spoonful of milk if it gets dry.

recipes.name: Italian pasta salad
ingredients: 8 oz (225 g) mozzarella pearls or cubes
Dressing: 1/2 cup (120 ml) olive oil, 1/4 cup (60 ml) red wine vinegar, 1 teaspoon Italian seasoning, 1 minced garlic clove, 1 teaspoon sugar, 1/2 teaspoon salt
steps: Cook the pasta in salted boiling water following the package. Ask an adult to help drain it.
Rinse with cold water and drain well.
Shake the dressing ingredients in a jar.
Toss the pasta with the vegetables, olives, salami and mozzarella.
Pour on the dressing and toss.
Chill for 1 hour. Sprinkle with parmesan before serving.

recipes.name: Creamy coleslaw
ingredients: 6 cups (about 450 g) shredded green cabbage, or a 14 oz bag of coleslaw mix
steps: Whisk the mayo, vinegar, sugar, mustard, celery seed and salt in a big bowl.
Add the cabbage and carrot and toss well.
Chill for 30 minutes so it softens a little.

recipes.name: Asian sesame slaw
ingredients: 4 cups (about 300 g) shredded napa or green cabbage
Dressing: 3 tablespoons rice vinegar, 2 tablespoons soy sauce, 1 tablespoon sesame oil, 1 tablespoon honey, 1 tablespoon vegetable oil, 1 teaspoon grated ginger
steps: Put the cabbages, carrot, pepper, green onions and cilantro in a big bowl.
Whisk the dressing ingredients.
Pour over the slaw and toss.
Top with peanuts and sesame seeds.

recipes.name: Broccoli salad
ingredients: 6 cups (about 450 g) small raw broccoli florets
1/2 cup (75 g) raisins or dried cranberries
Dressing: 3/4 cup (170 g) mayonnaise, 2 tablespoons sugar, 2 tablespoons apple cider vinegar
steps: Cut the broccoli into very small florets.
Whisk the dressing in a big bowl.
Add the broccoli, bacon, cheese, raisins, onion and sunflower seeds and toss.
Chill for 1 hour so the flavors blend.

recipes.name: Creamy cucumber dill salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup (120 g) sour cream or Greek yogurt
steps: Toss the cucumber slices with the salt in a strainer and let drain for 20 minutes.
Pat them dry with a towel.
Stir the sour cream, vinegar, sugar and dill in a bowl.
Add the cucumbers and onion and toss.
Chill for 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.name: Smashed cucumber salad
ingredients: 1 tablespoon rice vinegar or black vinegar
steps: Lay a cucumber on a cutting board and press down hard with the flat side of a big knife or a rolling pin until it cracks. Ask an adult to help.
Break it into bite size chunks. Do the same with the other one.
Toss with the salt and sugar and let sit for 10 minutes, then pour off the water.
Stir the garlic, soy sauce, vinegar, sesame oil and chili oil.
Toss with the cucumbers and sprinkle with sesame seeds.

recipes.name: Tabbouleh
ingredients: 3 bunches flat-leaf parsley, finely chopped (about 3 cups)
steps: Pour the boiling water over the bulgur, cover and let sit for 20 minutes, until soft. Ask an adult to help.
Fluff it with a fork and let cool.
Have an adult help finely chop the parsley, mint and tomatoes.
Mix everything in a big bowl.
Taste and add more lemon or salt. It should taste bright and lemony.

recipes.name: Fattoush
ingredients: 2 tablespoons olive oil for the pita
Dressing: 1/4 cup (60 ml) olive oil, 3 tablespoons lemon juice, 1 small garlic clove, grated, 1 teaspoon sumac, 1/2 teaspoon salt
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Ask an adult to help.
Toss the pita pieces with oil and bake for 8 to 10 minutes, until crisp.
Put the lettuce, cucumber, tomatoes, radishes, green onions and herbs in a big bowl.
Whisk the dressing.
Toss the salad with the dressing, then add the crispy pita and toss again.
Sprinkle with more sumac.

recipes.name: Mediterranean quinoa salad
ingredients: 1 can (15 oz / 425 g) chickpeas, drained and rinsed
Dressing: 1/4 cup (60 ml) olive oil, 3 tablespoons lemon juice, 1 teaspoon dried oregano, 1/2 teaspoon salt
steps: Simmer the quinoa in the water, covered, for 15 minutes. Ask an adult to help.
Let sit for 5 minutes, fluff and spread on a plate to cool for 15 minutes.
Whisk the dressing.
Toss the quinoa with the cucumber, tomatoes, chickpeas, olives and parsley.
Pour on the dressing and fold in the feta.

recipes.name: Three bean salad
ingredients: 1 can (15 oz / 425 g) cut green beans, drained
1 can (15 oz / 425 g) kidney beans, drained and rinsed
1 can (15 oz / 425 g) chickpeas, drained and rinsed
Dressing: 1/3 cup (80 ml) apple cider vinegar, 1/4 cup (60 ml) vegetable oil, 1/4 cup (50 g) sugar, 1/2 teaspoon salt
steps: Whisk the dressing until the sugar dissolves.
Put the beans, chickpeas, onion and parsley in a bowl.
Pour on the dressing and stir.
Chill for 1 hour, stirring once.

recipes.name: Waldorf salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup (55 g) walnuts, toasted and chopped
steps: Toss the apples with the lemon juice so they stay white.
Stir the mayo and yogurt in a bowl.
Add the apples, celery, grapes and walnuts and fold together.
Serve on lettuce leaves.

recipes.name: Ambrosia salad
ingredients: 1 can (11 oz / 312 g) mandarin oranges, drained
1 can (8 oz / 227 g) pineapple tidbits, drained
1 cup (240 g) sour cream or whipped topping
steps: Drain the fruit well.
Stir everything together in a bowl.
Chill for 1 hour.

recipes.name: Watermelon feta salad
steps: Put the watermelon and cucumber in a big bowl.
Drizzle with lime juice and olive oil.
Toss gently.
Sprinkle with feta, mint and salt. Serve cold right away.

recipes.name: Strawberry spinach salad
ingredients: 1/3 cup (50 g) crumbled feta or goat cheese
Dressing: 3 tablespoons olive oil, 2 tablespoons apple cider vinegar, 1 tablespoon honey, 1 teaspoon poppy seeds, pinch of salt
steps: Put the spinach in a big bowl and top with strawberries, almonds, cheese and onion.
Shake the dressing in a jar.
Drizzle over the salad just before serving.

recipes.name: Massaged kale salad
ingredients: 1 large bunch curly or lacinato kale
1/4 cup (35 g) toasted sunflower seeds or almonds
steps: Pull the kale leaves off the stems and tear or slice them thin.
Put the kale in a bowl with the oil, lemon juice, honey and salt.
Squeeze and rub the kale with your hands for 2 minutes, until it turns darker and softer.
Toss in the parmesan, cranberries and seeds.

recipes.name: Wedge salad
ingredients: Dressing: 1/2 cup (120 g) sour cream, 1/4 cup (60 g) mayonnaise, 2 tablespoons milk, 1/2 cup (60 g) crumbled blue cheese, 1 teaspoon lemon juice, pinch of salt and pepper
steps: Stir the dressing ingredients, mashing some of the blue cheese.
Have an adult cut the lettuce into 4 wedges through the core.
Put each wedge on a plate.
Spoon the dressing over the wedges.
Top with bacon, tomatoes and green onions.

recipes.name: Taco salad
ingredients: 1 can (15 oz / 425 g) black beans, drained and rinsed
Sour cream and salsa to top
steps: Cook the beef in a pan over medium high heat for 7 to 8 minutes, breaking it up, until no pink is left. Ask an adult to help.
Drain the fat, stir in the taco seasoning and water, and simmer for 3 minutes.
Put the lettuce in bowls and top with beef, tomatoes, beans and cheese.
Add crushed chips, sour cream and salsa just before eating.

recipes.name: Panzanella
ingredients: 2 tablespoons olive oil for the bread
1 1/2 lb (680 g) ripe tomatoes, cut in chunks
Dressing: 1/4 cup (60 ml) olive oil, 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar, 1 small garlic clove, grated, 1/2 teaspoon salt
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Toss the bread with oil and bake for 10 minutes, until crisp at the edges.
Put the tomatoes, cucumber and onion in a big bowl with the salt from the dressing. Let sit for 10 minutes so the juice comes out.
Whisk the rest of the dressing.
Add the bread, dressing and basil and toss.
Let sit for 10 minutes so the bread soaks up the juices.

recipes.name: Thai mango salad
ingredients: 2 firm, slightly underripe mangoes, cut in thin strips
Dressing: 2 tablespoons lime juice, 1 tablespoon fish sauce or soy sauce, 1 tablespoon brown sugar, 1/2 small chili, minced (optional)
steps: Have an adult peel and cut the mangoes into thin strips.
Stir the dressing until the sugar dissolves.
Toss the mango, pepper, onion, cilantro and mint with the dressing.
Top with peanuts.

recipes.name: Kachumber salad
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon ground cumin or chaat masala
steps: Have an adult help dice the vegetables into small, even pieces.
Put everything in a bowl.
Toss and serve right away, so it stays crunchy.

recipes.name: Lemony lentil salad
ingredients: 1 cup (200 g) green or brown lentils, rinsed
Dressing: 1/4 cup (60 ml) olive oil, 3 tablespoons lemon juice, 1 teaspoon Dijon mustard, 1 small garlic clove, grated, 1/2 teaspoon salt
steps: Cover the lentils and bay leaf with 3 cups of water in a pot and bring to a boil. Ask an adult to help.
Simmer for 20 to 25 minutes, until tender but not mushy. Drain and take out the bay leaf.
Whisk the dressing and toss it with the warm lentils.
Let cool for 10 minutes.
Stir in the carrot, onion, parsley and feta.

recipes.name: Lemon orzo salad
ingredients: Dressing: 1/4 cup (60 ml) olive oil, 3 tablespoons lemon juice, 1 teaspoon honey, 1/2 teaspoon salt
steps: Cook the orzo in salted boiling water following the package. Ask an adult to help drain it.
Rinse with cold water and drain well.
Whisk the dressing.
Toss the orzo with the cucumber, tomatoes, spinach, herbs and dressing.
Fold in the feta.

recipes.name: Carrot raisin salad
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) carrots, peeled and shredded
1 can (8 oz / 227 g) crushed pineapple, drained
1/3 cup (75 g) mayonnaise or Greek yogurt
steps: Shred the carrots on a box grater, keeping your fingers away from the blades.
Stir the mayo, honey, lemon juice and salt in a bowl.
Add the carrots, raisins and pineapple and toss.
Chill for 30 minutes.

recipes.name: Summer corn salad
ingredients: 4 ears corn, or 3 cups (450 g) frozen corn, thawed
steps: Boil the corn ears for 4 minutes, let cool, and have an adult cut off the kernels. Frozen corn can skip this.
Put the corn, tomatoes, cucumber, onion and basil in a bowl.
Drizzle with olive oil and lime juice and sprinkle with salt.
Toss and serve.

recipes.name: Chinese chicken salad
ingredients: 4 cups (about 300 g) shredded napa cabbage or romaine
1 can (11 oz / 312 g) mandarin oranges, drained
1 cup crispy wonton strips or chow mein noodles
Dressing: 1/4 cup (60 ml) rice vinegar, 2 tablespoons soy sauce, 2 tablespoons honey, 2 tablespoons vegetable oil, 1 tablespoon sesame oil, 1 teaspoon grated ginger
steps: Whisk the dressing.
Toss the chicken, cabbages, carrot and green onions with most of the dressing.
Top with mandarin oranges, almonds and wonton strips.
Drizzle with the rest of the dressing.

recipes.name: Avocado tomato salad
steps: Have an adult cut and pit the avocados.
Put the avocado, tomatoes, onion and cilantro in a bowl.
Drizzle with lime juice and olive oil and sprinkle with salt.
Toss gently and eat right away.

recipes.name: Arugula parmesan salad
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon flaky salt and a pinch of pepper
steps: Put the arugula in a big bowl.
Drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice and sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Toss gently with your hands.
Top with parmesan and pine nuts. Serve right away.

recipes.name: Antipasto salad
ingredients: 4 oz (115 g) salami, sliced into strips
1/2 cup jarred roasted red peppers, sliced
Dressing: 1/3 cup (80 ml) olive oil, 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar, 1 teaspoon Italian seasoning, 1/4 teaspoon salt
steps: Put the lettuce in a big bowl.
Add the salami, cheese, olives, peppers, artichokes, tomatoes and pepperoncini.
Shake the dressing in a jar.
Toss the salad with the dressing just before serving.

recipes.name: Sesame soba noodle salad
ingredients: Dressing: 3 tablespoons soy sauce, 2 tablespoons rice vinegar, 1 tablespoon sesame oil, 1 tablespoon honey, 1 teaspoon grated ginger
steps: Cook the soba in boiling water following the package, usually 4 to 5 minutes. Ask an adult to help.
Drain and rinse under cold water, rubbing gently to wash off the starch.
Whisk the dressing.
Toss the noodles with the vegetables and dressing.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds.

recipes.name: Olivier salad
ingredients: 4 oz (115 g) cooked ham or bologna, diced (optional)
steps: Boil the whole potatoes and carrots for 20 to 25 minutes, until a knife slides in. Ask an adult to help.
Let cool for 30 minutes.
Dice the potatoes, carrots, eggs and pickles into small cubes about the size of the peas.
Put everything in a big bowl with the peas and ham.
Fold in the mayo, salt and dill.
Chill for 30 minutes.

recipes.name: Mediterranean chickpea salad
ingredients: 2 cans (15 oz / 425 g each) chickpeas, drained and rinsed
Dressing: 3 tablespoons olive oil, 2 tablespoons lemon juice, 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano, 1/2 teaspoon salt
steps: Put the chickpeas, cucumber, tomatoes, onion and parsley in a bowl.
Whisk the dressing.
Toss everything together and top with feta.

recipes.name: Beet and goat cheese salad
ingredients: 1 package (8 oz / 225 g) cooked peeled beets, cut in wedges
5 oz (140 g) mixed greens or arugula
1/4 cup (30 g) candied or toasted walnuts
Dressing: 3 tablespoons olive oil, 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar, 1 teaspoon honey, pinch of salt
steps: Shake the dressing in a jar.
Toss the greens with half the dressing and spread on a platter.
Add the beets. They stain everything pink, so add them last.
Top with goat cheese and walnuts and drizzle with the rest of the dressing.

recipes.name: Pizza sauce
steps: Stir everything together in a bowl.
Taste and add more salt or sugar if needed.
For a thicker, deeper sauce, simmer it in a small pot for 10 minutes, stirring. Ask an adult to help.
Let cool before spreading on pizza dough. This covers 2 large pizzas.

recipes.name: Marinara sauce
steps: Warm the olive oil and garlic in a pot over medium low heat for 2 minutes, until the garlic sizzles but does not brown. Ask an adult to help.
Pour in the tomatoes carefully, they may spatter.
Stir in the oregano, salt and pepper flakes.
Simmer for 20 minutes, stirring now and then, until a little thicker.
Tear in the basil and taste for salt.

recipes.name: Alfredo sauce
steps: Melt the butter in a pan over medium heat and cook the garlic for 1 minute. Ask an adult to help.
Pour in the cream and simmer gently for 3 to 4 minutes, until a little thick.
Take it off the heat and stir in the parmesan a handful at a time until smooth.
Season with salt, pepper and nutmeg.
Toss with 12 oz (340 g) cooked fettuccine right away. It thickens as it sits.

recipes.name: Brown gravy
ingredients: 4 tablespoons (55 g) butter or pan drippings
2 cups (480 ml) beef or chicken broth
steps: Melt the butter in a pan over medium heat. Ask an adult to help.
Whisk in the flour and cook for 2 to 3 minutes, whisking, until golden brown.
Slowly whisk in the broth so no lumps form.
Add the Worcestershire and onion powder.
Simmer for 3 to 5 minutes, whisking, until thick.
Season with salt and pepper.

recipes.name: Mushroom gravy
steps: Melt the butter in a pan over medium high heat. Ask an adult to help.
Cook the mushrooms and onion for 6 to 8 minutes, until browned.
Add the garlic and flour and stir for 1 minute.
Slowly stir in the broth, soy sauce and thyme.
Simmer for 5 minutes, stirring, until thick. Season with pepper.

recipes.name: Teriyaki sauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cornstarch mixed with 2 tablespoons cold water
steps: Put the soy sauce, water, brown sugar, honey, vinegar, garlic and ginger in a small pot.
Bring to a simmer over medium heat, stirring. Ask an adult to help.
Stir the cornstarch mix again and pour it in.
Simmer for 1 to 2 minutes, stirring, until thick and glossy.
Use on chicken, salmon or stir fries. Keeps in the fridge for a week.

recipes.name: Barbecue sauce
steps: Whisk everything in a small pot.
Bring to a simmer over medium heat. Ask an adult to help, it bubbles and spits.
Simmer on low for 10 to 15 minutes, stirring often, until thick.
Let cool. It keeps in the fridge up to 2 weeks.

recipes.name: Ranch dressing
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chopped fresh dill or 1 teaspoon dried
1/4 teaspoon salt and a pinch of pepper
steps: Whisk everything together in a bowl.
Add more buttermilk for a thinner dressing, or less for a thick dip.
Chill for 30 minutes so the flavors mix.
Keeps in the fridge for 1 week.

recipes.name: Honey mustard sauce
steps: Put everything in a small bowl.
Whisk until smooth.
Taste and add more honey for sweeter or mustard for tangier.
Great for dipping chicken nuggets and pretzels.

recipes.name: Caesar dressing
steps: Whisk the mayo, parmesan, lemon juice, mustard, Worcestershire, garlic and anchovy paste.
Slowly whisk in the olive oil.
Add water a little at a time until it pours.
Season with pepper. This version uses mayo, so there are no raw eggs.

recipes.name: Balsamic vinaigrette
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon salt and a pinch of pepper
steps: Put everything in a jar.
Screw the lid on tight.
Shake hard for 30 seconds, until creamy.
Shake again before each use. Keeps in the fridge for 1 week.

recipes.name: Italian dressing
steps: Put everything in a jar.
Close the lid and shake for 30 seconds.
Let sit for 5 minutes so the herbs soften.
Shake again before using.

recipes.name: Thousand Island dressing
steps: Put everything in a bowl.
Stir until smooth and pink.
Chill until ready to use.

recipes.name: Blue cheese dressing
steps: Whisk the sour cream, mayo, buttermilk, lemon juice, Worcestershire and garlic powder.
Stir in the blue cheese, mashing a little of it.
Season with salt and pepper.
Chill for 30 minutes. Great with wings and celery.

recipes.name: Sesame ginger dressing
steps: Put everything in a jar.
Shake hard for 30 seconds.
Use on salads, slaw or cold noodles.

recipes.name: Ginger carrot dressing
ingredients: 1 large carrot (about 100 g), peeled and chopped
steps: Put everything in a blender.
Blend for 30 to 60 seconds, until mostly smooth but still a little chunky.
Pour over iceberg lettuce like at a Japanese steakhouse.
Keeps in the fridge for 5 days.

recipes.name: Tzatziki
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chopped fresh dill or mint
steps: Grate the cucumber on a box grater, keeping fingers clear.
Squeeze the grated cucumber in a clean towel to get the water out.
Stir the cucumber into the yogurt with the garlic, olive oil, lemon juice, dill and salt.
Chill for 10 minutes.

recipes.name: Cucumber raita
steps: Whisk the yogurt until smooth.
Stir in the cucumber, cumin and salt.
Sprinkle with mint.
Serve cold with curries, biryani or spicy food. It cools your mouth.

recipes.name: Lemon tahini sauce
ingredients: 1/4 to 1/2 cup (60 to 120 ml) ice water
steps: Stir the tahini, lemon juice, garlic and salt. It will get thick and clumpy. That is normal.
Whisk in the ice water a spoonful at a time.
Keep going until it is smooth, pale and pourable.
Drizzle on falafel, roasted vegetables or salads.

recipes.name: Cheddar cheese sauce
steps: Melt the butter in a pot over medium heat and whisk in the flour for 1 minute. Ask an adult to help.
Slowly whisk in the milk and cook for 2 to 3 minutes, until it thickens.
Turn the heat to low and stir in the cheese a handful at a time until melted.
Stir in the salt and paprika.
Pour over nachos, broccoli, fries or pasta.

recipes.name: Bechamel white sauce
steps: Melt the butter in a pot over medium heat. Ask an adult to help.
Whisk in the flour and cook for 1 to 2 minutes, until bubbly but not brown.
Pour in the warm milk a little at a time, whisking all the time so no lumps form.
Simmer for 4 to 5 minutes, whisking, until thick enough to coat a spoon.
Season with salt and nutmeg. Stir in grated cheese to make a cheese sauce.

recipes.name: Hot fudge sauce
steps: Put the cream, corn syrup, brown sugar and cocoa in a small pot.
Bring to a simmer over medium heat, whisking, and cook for 1 to 2 minutes. Ask an adult to help.
Take it off the heat and add the chocolate and butter.
Let sit for 1 minute, then whisk until smooth and glossy.
Stir in the vanilla and salt. Serve warm over ice cream.

recipes.name: Salted caramel sauce
ingredients: 6 tablespoons (85 g) butter, cubed, at room temperature
1/2 cup (120 ml) heavy cream, at room temperature
steps: An adult should make this. Melted sugar is much hotter than boiling water and sticks to skin.
Heat the sugar in a heavy pot over medium heat, stirring with a heatproof spatula, for 5 to 8 minutes, until melted and amber.
Add the butter. It will bubble up hard. Stir until melted.
Slowly pour in the cream while stirring. It bubbles again.
Boil for 1 minute, then take it off the heat and stir in the vanilla and salt.
Let cool for 10 minutes. It thickens as it cools.

recipes.name: Chocolate syrup
steps: Whisk the cocoa, sugar, water and salt in a small pot.
Bring to a boil over medium heat, whisking. Ask an adult to help.
Simmer for 3 to 5 minutes, until a little thick.
Take it off the heat and stir in the vanilla.
Let cool. It thickens more in the fridge. Stir 2 tablespoons into a glass of milk to make chocolate milk.

recipes.name: Strawberry sauce
ingredients: 1 teaspoon cornstarch mixed with 1 tablespoon water (optional, for thicker sauce)
steps: Put the strawberries, sugar and lemon juice in a small pot.
Simmer over medium heat for 8 to 10 minutes, stirring and mashing a little, until saucy. Ask an adult to help.
Stir in the cornstarch mix and cook for 1 minute more if you want it thicker.
Serve warm or cold on ice cream, cheesecake or waffles.

recipes.name: Lemon curd
steps: Whisk the lemon juice, zest, sugar and eggs in a heavy pot until smooth.
Add the butter and cook over medium low heat, whisking all the time. Ask an adult to help.
Cook for 8 to 10 minutes, until thick enough to coat a spoon and it reaches 170°F (77°C). Do not let it boil.
Pour through a strainer into a jar.
Press plastic wrap onto the top and chill for 2 hours, until set.

recipes.name: Vanilla custard sauce
steps: Heat the milk and cream in a pot until steaming. Ask an adult to help.
Whisk the yolks and sugar in a bowl.
Slowly whisk the hot milk into the yolks, then pour it all back into the pot.
Cook on low, stirring all the time, for 6 to 8 minutes, until it coats a spoon and reaches 170°F (77°C). Do not let it boil.
Strain into a jug and stir in the vanilla.
Serve warm over pies, crumbles and puddings.

recipes.name: Cranberry sauce
ingredients: 12 oz (340 g) fresh or frozen cranberries
1 cup (240 ml) water or orange juice
steps: Stir the sugar and water in a pot over medium heat until the sugar dissolves. Ask an adult to help.
Add the cranberries and bring to a boil.
Simmer for 10 minutes, stirring now and then, until most berries pop.
Stir in the zest.
Let cool for 15 minutes, then chill for 2 hours. It sets as it cools.

recipes.name: Homemade applesauce
ingredients: 3 lb (1.4 kg) apples, about 7, peeled, cored and chopped
1/2 cup (120 ml) water or apple juice
steps: Peel, core and chop the apples. Ask an adult to help with the knife.
Put everything in a pot, cover and bring to a simmer.
Cook for 15 to 20 minutes, stirring now and then, until the apples are very soft.
Mash with a potato masher for chunky sauce, or blend for smooth.
Serve warm or chilled. Keeps in the fridge for a week.

recipes.name: Sweet and sour sauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cornstarch mixed with 2 tablespoons water
steps: Whisk the pineapple juice, vinegar, brown sugar, ketchup and soy sauce in a small pot.
Bring to a simmer over medium heat. Ask an adult to help.
Stir in the cornstarch mix.
Simmer for 1 to 2 minutes, until thick and shiny.
Use as a dip or toss with crispy chicken.

recipes.name: All-purpose stir fry sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup (60 ml) chicken broth or water
steps: Put everything in a jar.
Close it and shake until the cornstarch dissolves.
Pour into your stir fry for the last 1 to 2 minutes of cooking, stirring until thick and glossy. Ask an adult to help at the hot pan.
Shake again right before using, the cornstarch sinks.

recipes.name: Peanut sauce
ingredients: 1/4 to 1/2 cup (60 to 120 ml) hot water
steps: Put everything except the water in a bowl.
Whisk in the hot water a little at a time until smooth and pourable.
Taste and add more lime or honey.
Serve with summer rolls, noodles, chicken skewers or vegetables.

recipes.name: Spicy mayo
steps: Put the mayo in a small bowl.
Stir in 1 tablespoon sriracha, the lime juice and sesame oil.
Taste and add more sriracha if you want it spicier.
Drizzle on sushi bowls, burgers or fries.

recipes.name: Easy garlic aioli
steps: Stir everything together in a small bowl.
Let sit for 10 minutes so the garlic flavor spreads.
Serve with fries, sandwiches or roasted vegetables. Using mayo means no raw egg.

recipes.name: Tartar sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dill pickle relish or finely chopped pickles
steps: Stir everything together in a small bowl.
Chill until ready to use.
Serve with fish sticks, fried fish or crab cakes.

recipes.name: Shrimp cocktail sauce
steps: Stir everything together.
Start with 1 tablespoon horseradish and add more if you want it stronger.
Chill and serve with cold cooked shrimp.

recipes.name: Special burger sauce
ingredients: 1 teaspoon pickle juice or white vinegar
steps: Stir everything together in a bowl.
Chill for 30 minutes if you have time, so the flavors blend.
Spread on burgers or use as a dip for fries.

recipes.name: Red enchilada sauce
ingredients: 2 cups (480 ml) chicken or vegetable broth
steps: Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat. Ask an adult to help.
Whisk in the flour and spices and cook for 1 minute, stirring.
Stir in the tomato paste.
Slowly whisk in the broth.
Simmer for 5 to 7 minutes, until a little thick.
Stir in the salt and vinegar. Makes enough for one 9 by 13 inch pan of enchiladas.

recipes.name: Salsa verde
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) tomatillos, husks removed and rinsed
1 or 2 jalapenos, seeds removed for mild
steps: Turn on the oven broiler. Ask an adult to help.
Put the tomatillos, onion, jalapenos and garlic on a foil-lined sheet.
Broil for 5 to 7 minutes, until charred, then flip and broil for 5 minutes more.
Let cool for 10 minutes.
Blend with the cilantro, lime juice and salt until mostly smooth.

recipes.name: Mango salsa
steps: Have an adult help peel and dice the mango and vegetables.
Put everything in a bowl.
Stir gently.
Serve with chips, fish tacos or grilled chicken.

recipes.name: Taco seasoning
steps: Stir all the spices together in a small bowl.
Store in a jar with a lid.
Use about 2 tablespoons with 1 lb (450 g) cooked ground meat and 1/2 cup water, then simmer for 5 minutes.

recipes.name: Buffalo sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup (120 ml) cayenne pepper hot sauce
steps: Put everything in a small pot over low heat. Ask an adult to help.
Whisk for 2 to 3 minutes, until the butter melts and it is smooth.
Toss with wings, cauliflower or chicken tenders.

recipes.name: Honey garlic sauce
ingredients: 1 teaspoon cornstarch mixed with 1 tablespoon water
steps: Melt the butter in a small pot and cook the garlic for 30 seconds. Ask an adult to help.
Stir in the honey, soy sauce and vinegar and bring to a simmer.
Stir in the cornstarch mix and simmer for 1 minute, until sticky.
Brush on chicken, salmon or shrimp.

recipes.name: Dumpling dipping sauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon rice vinegar or black vinegar
steps: Stir the soy sauce, vinegar, sesame oil and sugar until the sugar dissolves.
Add the green onion, garlic and chili oil.
Serve in small bowls for dipping dumplings and spring rolls.

recipes.name: Green mint chutney
ingredients: 1 cup packed cilantro, with tender stems
steps: Put everything in a blender with 2 tablespoons water.
Blend until smooth, scraping down and adding water as needed.
Taste for salt and lemon.
Stir 2 tablespoons into 1/2 cup yogurt for a creamy dip.

recipes.name: Tamarind chutney
ingredients: 1/2 cup (100 g) jaggery or packed brown sugar
steps: Put everything in a small pot and stir.
Bring to a simmer over medium heat. Ask an adult to help.
Simmer for 10 to 12 minutes, stirring, until syrupy. It thickens more as it cools.
Let cool and serve with samosas, pakoras and chaat.

recipes.name: Homemade ketchup
ingredients: Pinch of ground allspice or cloves
steps: Whisk everything in a small pot.
Bring to a simmer over medium low heat. Ask an adult to help, it spatters.
Simmer for 10 minutes, stirring often.
Let cool, then chill for 1 hour. Keeps in the fridge for 2 weeks.

recipes.name: Dulce de leche
ingredients: 1 can (14 oz / 397 g) sweetened condensed milk
Hot water for the water bath
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Ask an adult to help.
Pour the condensed milk into a 9 inch pie plate and stir in the salt. Never heat an unopened can, it can burst.
Cover tightly with foil.
Set it in a bigger pan and have an adult pour hot water halfway up the pie plate.
Bake for 1 hour 15 minutes to 1 hour 30 minutes, until thick and caramel brown. Add water to the pan if it gets low.
Whisk until smooth and let cool for 15 minutes.

recipes.name: Olive tapenade
steps: Put everything in a food processor.
Pulse 8 to 10 times, scraping down the sides, until finely chopped but not smooth.
Spread on toasted baguette or crackers.

recipes.name: Fruit salsa
steps: Have an adult help dice the fruit small.
Put all the fruit in a bowl.
Drizzle with honey and juice and stir gently.
Serve with cinnamon sugar tortilla chips.

recipes.name: Blueberry syrup
ingredients: 2 cups (300 g) blueberries, fresh or frozen
1 teaspoon cornstarch mixed with 1 tablespoon water (optional)
steps: Put the blueberries, sugar, water and lemon juice in a small pot.
Simmer over medium heat for 8 to 10 minutes, until the berries burst. Ask an adult to help.
Stir in the cornstarch mix for a thicker sauce and cook for 1 minute.
Pour warm over pancakes, waffles or ice cream.

recipes.name: Cinnamon honey butter
steps: Put everything in a bowl.
Beat with a mixer for 2 minutes, until light and fluffy.
Spread on warm rolls, cornbread or sweet potatoes.

recipes.name: Yum yum sauce
steps: Whisk everything together until smooth.
Add water until it drizzles.
Chill for 1 hour so the flavors blend.
Serve with fried rice, grilled chicken and vegetables.

recipes.name: Lemon butter sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup (60 ml) chicken or vegetable broth
steps: Melt 1 cube of butter in a small pan and cook the garlic for 30 seconds. Ask an adult to help.
Add the broth and lemon juice and simmer for 2 minutes.
Turn off the heat and whisk in the rest of the butter one cube at a time until creamy.
Stir in the zest, parsley and salt. Spoon over fish, chicken or vegetables.

recipes.name: Poppy seed dressing
steps: Put everything in a jar.
Shake hard for 30 seconds, until creamy.
Pour over spinach salads and fruit salads.

recipes.name: Lemon vinaigrette
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon salt and a pinch of pepper
steps: Put everything in a jar.
Shake until mixed and a little creamy.
Use on greens, grain salads or roasted vegetables.

recipes.name: Lime crema
ingredients: 1 teaspoon adobo sauce from canned chipotles (optional, for chipotle crema)
steps: Whisk everything together.
Add a teaspoon of water if you want it thinner for drizzling.
Drizzle over tacos, burrito bowls and nachos.

recipes.name: Crispy roasted potatoes
ingredients: 2 lb (900 g) Yukon Gold or red potatoes
1 tablespoon chopped fresh rosemary or 1 teaspoon dried
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Ask an adult to help.
Cut the potatoes into 1 inch chunks. Ask an adult to help with the knife.
Toss with the oil, salt, pepper, garlic powder and rosemary on a baking sheet.
Spread out in one layer with a cut side down.
Roast for 20 minutes, then flip with a spatula.
Roast for 15 to 20 minutes more, until crispy and golden.

recipes.name: Oven-baked fries
steps: Have an adult cut the potatoes into 1/4 inch sticks.
Soak the sticks in cold water for 30 minutes. This makes them crispier.
Heat the oven to 450°F (230°C). Ask an adult to help.
Drain and dry them really well with towels.
Toss with the oil and spread in one layer on 2 baking sheets.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and crisp.
Toss with salt and garlic powder right away.

recipes.name: Sweet potato fries
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Ask an adult to help.
Have an adult cut the sweet potatoes into 1/4 inch sticks.
Toss with the cornstarch until lightly dusted, then with the oil.
Spread them out on 2 lined baking sheets so they do not touch.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, flipping halfway, until crisp at the edges.
Sprinkle with salt and paprika.

recipes.name: Seasoned potato wedges
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Ask an adult to help.
Have an adult cut each potato in half lengthwise, then each half into 4 wedges.
Toss with the oil, salt, garlic powder and paprika.
Lay them skin side down on a lined baking sheet.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes, until golden and tender inside.
Sprinkle with parmesan and serve.

recipes.name: Cheesy scalloped potatoes
ingredients: 2 1/2 lb (1.1 kg) Yukon Gold potatoes, peeled
1 1/2 cups (170 g) shredded cheddar or Gruyere
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Ask an adult to help.
Have an adult slice the potatoes 1/8 inch thick.
Melt the butter in a pot, whisk in the flour and cook for 1 minute.
Slowly whisk in the milk, add the garlic, salt and pepper, and cook for 3 to 4 minutes, until thick.
Layer half the potatoes in a greased 9 by 13 inch dish, pour on half the sauce and sprinkle with half the cheese.
Repeat with the rest.
Cover with foil and bake for 45 minutes.
Uncover and bake for 30 minutes more, until golden and the potatoes are tender.
Let rest for 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.name: Crispy smashed potatoes
steps: Boil the potatoes in salted water for 15 to 20 minutes, until a fork slides in easily. Ask an adult to help drain them.
Heat the oven to 450°F (230°C). Ask an adult to help.
Put the potatoes on an oiled baking sheet and let cool for 5 minutes.
Press each one flat with the bottom of a glass.
Drizzle with oil and sprinkle with salt and garlic powder.
Roast for 20 to 25 minutes, until crispy and golden at the edges.
Sprinkle with parmesan and parsley.

recipes.name: Hasselback potatoes
ingredients: 4 medium Yukon Gold or russet potatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Ask an adult to help.
Lay a potato between 2 chopsticks so the knife stops before cutting through.
Have an adult cut thin slices 1/8 inch apart along each potato.
Mix the butter, oil and garlic and brush over the potatoes, getting some between the slices.
Sprinkle with salt and put them in a baking dish.
Roast for 30 minutes, then brush again with the butter.
Roast for 30 to 40 minutes more, until crisp on the edges and soft inside.
Top with chives.

recipes.name: Twice-baked potatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Scrub the potatoes, poke them with a fork and bake for 1 hour, until soft.
Let cool for 10 minutes, then have an adult cut them in half lengthwise.
Scoop out the insides, leaving a thin wall of potato in the skins.
Mash the insides with the sour cream, milk, butter, half the cheese, salt and green onions.
Spoon the filling back into the skins and top with the rest of the cheese.
Bake for 15 to 20 minutes, until hot and the cheese melts.

recipes.name: Sweet potato casserole
ingredients: 3 lb (1.4 kg) sweet potatoes, peeled and cubed
steps: Boil the sweet potatoes for 15 to 20 minutes, until very soft. Ask an adult to help drain them.
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Mash with the butter, brown sugar, milk, egg, vanilla, cinnamon and salt until smooth.
Spread in a greased 2 quart baking dish.
Bake for 25 minutes.
Cover the top with the marshmallows and bake for 10 minutes more, until puffed and golden.

recipes.name: Patatas bravas
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) potatoes, cut in 1 inch cubes
Sauce: 1 tablespoon olive oil, 1 garlic clove, minced, 1 teaspoon smoked paprika, 1 tablespoon flour, 1/2 cup (120 ml) broth, 1/2 cup (120 g) tomato sauce, 1 teaspoon vinegar, pinch of cayenne
Mayonnaise or garlic aioli to serve
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Ask an adult to help.
Toss the potatoes with the oil and salt on a baking sheet.
Roast for 35 to 40 minutes, turning once, until crisp and golden.
For the sauce, warm the oil and garlic in a small pot for 30 seconds. Ask an adult to help.
Stir in the paprika and flour, then whisk in the broth, tomato sauce and vinegar.
Simmer for 3 to 4 minutes, until thick. Add cayenne if you like it spicy.
Spoon the sauce over the potatoes and add dots of mayo.

recipes.name: Bombay potatoes
steps: Boil the potatoes for 10 minutes, until just tender. Ask an adult to help drain them.
Heat the oil in a big pan over medium heat and add the cumin and mustard seeds. Cook for 30 seconds, until they sizzle.
Stir in the turmeric, coriander, chili powder and garam masala.
Add the potatoes and tomato and stir to coat.
Cook for 8 to 10 minutes, stirring now and then, until the potatoes are golden at the edges.
Sprinkle with salt and cilantro.

recipes.name: Potato latkes
ingredients: 1/4 cup (30 g) all-purpose flour or matzo meal
Applesauce and sour cream to serve
steps: Grate the potatoes and onion on the big holes of a box grater, keeping fingers clear.
Squeeze handfuls in a clean towel until no more liquid comes out.
Mix with the eggs, flour, salt, pepper and baking powder.
An adult should fry. Heat 1/4 inch of oil in a big frying pan over medium high heat.
Drop 1/4 cup mounds into the oil and flatten them.
Fry for 3 to 4 minutes per side, until deep golden and crisp.
Drain on paper towels and serve with applesauce and sour cream.

recipes.name: Colcannon
ingredients: 2 lb (900 g) potatoes, peeled and cubed
4 cups (about 300 g) shredded green cabbage or kale
steps: Boil the potatoes for 15 to 20 minutes, until very soft. Ask an adult to help drain them.
Melt 2 tablespoons butter in a pan and cook the cabbage for 5 minutes, until soft.
Mash the potatoes with the warm milk and salt.
Stir in the cabbage and green onions.
Make a dip in the top and add the rest of the butter to melt.

recipes.name: Fluffy white rice
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups (420 ml) water, or 1 1/2 cups (360 ml) for jasmine rice
steps: Rinse the rice in a strainer until the water runs almost clear.
Put the rice, water, salt and butter in a pot and bring to a boil. Ask an adult to help.
Turn the heat to low, cover with a tight lid and cook for 18 minutes. Do not lift the lid.
Turn off the heat and let it sit covered for 10 minutes.
Fluff with a fork.

recipes.name: Rice pilaf
ingredients: 1/2 cup (50 g) broken vermicelli or orzo
2 cups (480 ml) chicken or vegetable broth
steps: Melt the butter in a pot over medium heat. Ask an adult to help.
Add the vermicelli and stir for 2 to 3 minutes, until golden.
Add the rice and stir for 1 minute.
Pour in the broth and salt and bring to a boil.
Cover, turn the heat to low and cook for 18 minutes.
Let sit covered for 5 minutes, then fluff and add parsley.

recipes.name: Cilantro lime rice
ingredients: 1 cup (200 g) long-grain white rice, rinsed
steps: Stir the rice in the oil in a pot over medium heat for 1 minute. Ask an adult to help.
Add the water and salt and bring to a boil.
Cover, turn the heat to low and cook for 18 minutes.
Let sit covered for 5 minutes.
Fluff and stir in the lime zest, lime juice and cilantro.

recipes.name: Mexican rice
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups (420 ml) chicken or vegetable broth
steps: Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat. Ask an adult to help.
Add the rice and stir for 4 to 5 minutes, until light golden.
Add the onion and garlic and stir for 1 minute.
Stir in the tomato sauce, broth, cumin and salt and bring to a boil.
Cover, turn the heat to low and cook for 20 minutes.
Let sit covered for 5 minutes, then fluff.

recipes.name: Coconut rice
steps: Put everything in a pot and stir.
Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring so it does not stick. Ask an adult to help.
Cover, turn the heat to low and cook for 15 to 18 minutes.
Let sit covered for 10 minutes, then fluff.

recipes.name: Jeera rice
steps: Rinse the rice and soak it in water for 20 minutes, then drain.
Melt the ghee in a pot over medium heat and add the cumin seeds and bay leaf. Cook for 30 seconds, until they sizzle. Ask an adult to help.
Add the rice and stir gently for 1 minute.
Add the water and salt and bring to a boil.
Cover, turn the heat to low and cook for 12 to 15 minutes.
Let sit covered for 10 minutes, then fluff with a fork.

recipes.name: Yellow turmeric rice
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups (420 ml) chicken or vegetable broth
steps: Melt the butter in a pot over medium heat and cook the onion for 3 minutes. Ask an adult to help.
Add the rice, turmeric and garlic powder and stir for 1 minute, until the rice is coated and yellow.
Add the broth, salt and bay leaf and bring to a boil.
Cover, turn the heat to low and cook for 18 minutes.
Let sit covered for 5 minutes, take out the bay leaf and fluff.

recipes.name: Seasoned sushi rice
steps: Rinse the rice, swishing with your hand, until the water is almost clear.
Let it soak in the measured water in the pot for 30 minutes.
Bring to a boil, cover, turn the heat to low and cook for 15 minutes. Ask an adult to help.
Turn off the heat and let it sit covered for 10 minutes.
Warm the vinegar, sugar and salt for 30 seconds in the microwave and stir until dissolved.
Spread the rice in a big bowl and gently fold in the vinegar mix with a paddle.
Fan it while folding until it is shiny and close to room temperature.

recipes.name: Lemon herb couscous
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups (300 ml) chicken or vegetable broth
steps: Bring the broth, oil and salt to a boil. Ask an adult to help.
Stir in the couscous, cover and take it off the heat.
Let sit for 5 minutes.
Fluff with a fork and stir in the lemon and parsley.

recipes.name: Fluffy quinoa
steps: Rinse the quinoa well in a fine strainer. This washes off a bitter coating.
Put it in a pot with the water and salt and bring to a boil. Ask an adult to help.
Cover, turn the heat to low and simmer for 15 minutes, until the water is gone.
Let sit covered for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.

recipes.name: Creamy polenta
ingredients: 1 cup (160 g) coarse cornmeal or polenta
steps: Bring the water and salt to a boil in a big pot. Ask an adult to help.
Slowly whisk in the cornmeal so no lumps form.
Turn the heat to low and cook for 25 to 30 minutes, stirring often with a long spoon. It bubbles and spits, so stand back.
Stir in the butter and parmesan.
Add a splash of water if it gets too thick.

recipes.name: Refried beans
ingredients: 2 cans (15 oz / 425 g each) pinto beans, liquid saved
steps: Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat and cook the onion for 4 minutes. Ask an adult to help.
Add the garlic and cumin and cook for 30 seconds.
Add the beans and 1/2 cup of their liquid.
Mash with a potato masher as they heat for 5 minutes, adding more liquid until creamy.
Stir in the salt and top with cheese.

recipes.name: Baked beans
ingredients: 3 cans (15 oz / 425 g each) navy or great northern beans, drained
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Cook the bacon in an oven-safe pot for 5 minutes, then add the onion and cook for 5 minutes more.
Stir in the beans, ketchup, brown sugar, molasses, mustard, Worcestershire and water.
Cover and bake for 30 minutes.
Uncover and bake for 30 minutes more, until thick and bubbly.

recipes.name: Cuban black beans
ingredients: 2 cans (15 oz / 425 g each) black beans with their liquid
steps: Heat the oil in a pot and cook the onion and pepper for 5 minutes. Ask an adult to help.
Add the garlic, cumin and oregano and cook for 1 minute.
Add the beans, bay leaf, vinegar, sugar and salt.
Simmer for 20 minutes, stirring now and then, until thick.
Take out the bay leaf. Serve over white rice.

recipes.name: Herb bread stuffing
ingredients: 1 loaf (1 lb / 450 g) white or French bread, cut in 1 inch cubes
2 cups (480 ml) chicken or vegetable broth
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Spread the bread cubes on 2 baking sheets and bake for 15 minutes to dry them.
Melt the butter in a pan and cook the onion and celery for 8 minutes, until soft. Ask an adult to help.
Stir in the sage, thyme, salt and pepper.
Whisk the broth and egg.
Toss the bread with the vegetables, broth mix and parsley in a big bowl.
Spread in a greased 9 by 13 inch dish and cover with foil.
Bake for 30 minutes, then uncover and bake for 15 to 20 minutes more, until golden on top.

recipes.name: Yorkshire puddings
ingredients: 4 tablespoons vegetable oil or beef drippings
steps: Whisk the flour, eggs, milk and salt until smooth. Let rest for 10 minutes.
Heat the oven to 450°F (230°C). Ask an adult to help.
Put 1 teaspoon oil in each cup of a 12-cup muffin pan and heat it in the oven for 10 minutes, until smoking hot.
Have an adult take out the pan and quickly pour the batter into the hot oil, filling each cup halfway.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until puffed and deep golden. Do not open the oven.
Serve right away with gravy.

recipes.name: Hush puppies
steps: Whisk the cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder, salt and garlic powder.
Stir in the green onions, egg and buttermilk until just combined. Let sit for 5 minutes.
An adult should fry. Heat 2 inches of oil to 350°F (175°C).
Drop tablespoons of batter into the oil a few at a time.
Fry for 2 to 3 minutes, turning, until deep golden.
Drain on paper towels and serve hot.

recipes.name: Creamed corn
ingredients: 4 cups (600 g) corn kernels, fresh or frozen
1 cup (240 ml) heavy cream or milk
steps: Melt the butter in a pan over medium heat and stir in the flour for 1 minute. Ask an adult to help.
Slowly stir in the cream.
Add the corn, sugar and salt.
Simmer for 5 to 8 minutes, stirring, until thick and the corn is tender.
Stir in the parmesan.

recipes.name: Corn on the cob
ingredients: 6 ears of corn, husks and silk removed
steps: Bring a big pot of water to a boil. Ask an adult to help.
Add the corn and boil for 4 to 5 minutes, until bright yellow and tender.
Lift out with tongs and let drain.
Spread with butter and sprinkle with salt.

recipes.name: Elote
ingredients: 2 tablespoons Mexican crema or sour cream
steps: Have an adult grill the corn over medium high heat, or broil it, for 10 to 12 minutes, turning, until charred in spots.
Mix the mayo and crema.
Brush it all over the hot corn.
Roll the corn in the cotija.
Sprinkle with chili powder and cilantro and serve with lime wedges.

recipes.name: Parmesan roasted broccoli
ingredients: 2 heads broccoli (about 1 1/2 lb / 680 g), cut into florets
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Ask an adult to help.
Toss the broccoli with the oil, garlic, salt and pepper on a baking sheet.
Spread it out so the pieces do not touch.
Roast for 18 to 22 minutes, until the edges are crispy and brown.
Sprinkle with parmesan and squeeze the lemon over it.

recipes.name: Garlic butter green beans
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) green beans, ends snapped off
steps: Boil the green beans in salted water for 3 minutes. Ask an adult to help drain them.
Melt the butter in a big pan over medium heat.
Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds, until it smells good.
Add the beans and toss for 2 to 3 minutes.
Season with salt and lemon.

recipes.name: Green bean casserole
ingredients: 1 can (10.5 oz / 298 g) condensed cream of mushroom soup
4 cups (about 450 g) cooked cut green beans, or 2 cans (14.5 oz each), drained
1 1/3 cups (75 g) French fried onions, divided
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Stir the soup, milk, soy sauce and pepper in a 1 1/2 quart baking dish.
Stir in the green beans and 2/3 cup of the fried onions.
Bake for 25 minutes, until hot and bubbly.
Stir, then top with the rest of the fried onions.
Bake for 5 minutes more, until the onions are golden.

recipes.name: Roasted Brussels sprouts
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) Brussels sprouts, trimmed and halved
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Ask an adult to help.
Have an adult trim and halve the sprouts.
Toss with the oil, salt and pepper.
Lay them cut side down on a baking sheet.
Roast for 20 to 25 minutes, until deep brown and crispy.
Toss with the balsamic and honey.

recipes.name: Honey glazed carrots
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) carrots, sliced into 1/4 inch coins, or baby carrots
steps: Put the carrots, water, butter and salt in a pan.
Bring to a simmer, cover and cook for 8 to 10 minutes, until tender. Ask an adult to help.
Uncover, add the honey and cook for 3 to 4 minutes, stirring, until the water is gone and the carrots are shiny.
Sprinkle with parsley.

recipes.name: Roasted asparagus
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Ask an adult to help.
Snap off the woody ends of the asparagus. They break off in the right spot on their own.
Toss with the oil, salt and pepper on a baking sheet.
Roast for 10 to 12 minutes, until tender and a little browned.
Sprinkle with parmesan and squeeze lemon over it.

recipes.name: Garlic sauteed spinach
steps: Heat the oil in a big pan over medium heat. Ask an adult to help.
Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds.
Add the spinach a handful at a time, tossing with tongs as it wilts.
Cook for 3 to 4 minutes, until all the spinach is wilted.
Season with salt and lemon. It shrinks a lot.

recipes.name: Creamed spinach
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed dry
steps: Melt the butter in a pan over medium heat and cook the onion for 3 minutes. Ask an adult to help.
Add the garlic and flour and stir for 1 minute.
Slowly stir in the milk and cook for 2 to 3 minutes, until thick.
Stir in the spinach, parmesan, nutmeg and salt.
Cook for 2 minutes, until hot.

recipes.name: Roasted cauliflower
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower (about 2 lb / 900 g), cut into florets
Chopped parsley and a lemon wedge
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Ask an adult to help.
Toss the cauliflower with the oil, salt, garlic powder and paprika.
Spread on a baking sheet so the pieces do not touch.
Roast for 25 to 30 minutes, turning once, until golden and tender.
Sprinkle with parsley and lemon juice.

recipes.name: Parmesan zucchini spears
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Ask an adult to help.
Cut each zucchini in half lengthwise, then in half again to make spears.
Lay them cut side up on a lined sheet and brush with oil.
Mix the parmesan, garlic powder, Italian seasoning and salt and sprinkle over the tops.
Roast for 15 to 18 minutes, until tender and the cheese is golden.

recipes.name: Ratatouille
steps: Have an adult help chop the vegetables into small cubes.
Heat the oil in a big pot and cook the onion and pepper for 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and eggplant and cook for 5 minutes, stirring.
Add the zucchini and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in the tomatoes, thyme and salt.
Simmer for 20 to 25 minutes, until everything is soft.
Stir in torn basil.

recipes.name: Garlic bok choy
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) baby bok choy, halved lengthwise and washed
steps: Heat the oil in a wok or big pan over medium high heat. Ask an adult to help.
Add the garlic and stir for 30 seconds.
Add the bok choy and toss for 2 minutes.
Add the soy sauce, oyster sauce and water, cover and cook for 1 to 2 minutes, until the stems are just tender.
Drizzle with sesame oil.

recipes.name: Maple roasted butternut squash
ingredients: 1 butternut squash (2 to 3 lb / 900 g to 1.4 kg)
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Have an adult peel the squash, cut it in half, scoop out the seeds and cut it into 1 inch cubes. It is hard to cut.
Toss with the oil, maple syrup, salt and cinnamon.
Spread on a lined baking sheet.
Roast for 30 to 35 minutes, flipping halfway, until tender and caramelized.

recipes.name: Garlic butter mushrooms
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) cremini or white mushrooms, sliced
steps: Heat the oil and 1 tablespoon butter in a big pan over medium high heat. Ask an adult to help.
Add the mushrooms in one layer and leave them alone for 3 minutes, until browned underneath.
Stir and cook for 4 to 5 minutes more, until golden and the liquid is gone.
Add the rest of the butter, the garlic and thyme and cook for 1 minute.
Season with salt and parsley.

recipes.name: Buttered peas with mint
steps: Put the peas and water in a pot and bring to a simmer. Ask an adult to help.
Cover and cook for 3 to 4 minutes, until hot and bright green.
Drain off any water left.
Stir in the butter, salt, sugar and mint.

recipes.name: Sweet fried plantains
ingredients: 3 very ripe plantains, with mostly black skins
steps: Cut the ends off the plantains, slit the skin and peel it off.
Slice them on a slant into 1/2 inch pieces.
Heat the oil in a big frying pan over medium heat. Ask an adult to help, the oil can spatter.
Fry the slices for 2 to 3 minutes per side, until deep golden and caramelized.
Drain on paper towels and sprinkle with salt.

recipes.name: Tostones
ingredients: Dip: 2 garlic cloves, minced, 2 tablespoons olive oil, 1 tablespoon lime juice
steps: Cut off the ends, slit the skin lengthwise and peel. Green plantains are stiff, so ask an adult to help.
Cut into 1 inch thick pieces.
An adult should fry. Heat 1/2 inch of oil in a frying pan to 350°F (175°C).
Fry the pieces for 3 to 4 minutes, turning, until pale golden. Drain.
Smash each piece flat with the bottom of a glass.
Fry again for 2 to 3 minutes, until crisp and golden.
Drain, sprinkle with salt and serve with the garlic dip.

recipes.name: Crispy onion rings
steps: Have an adult slice the onions 1/2 inch thick and separate the rings.
Whisk the flour, baking powder and salt. Toss the rings in it and shake off the extra.
Whisk the egg and milk into the leftover flour to make a batter.
Dip each ring in batter, then press into the panko.
An adult should fry. Heat 2 inches of oil to 365°F (185°C).
Fry a few rings at a time for 2 to 3 minutes, until golden.
Drain on paper towels and sprinkle with salt.

recipes.name: Southern collard greens
ingredients: 2 lb (900 g) collard greens, stems removed, chopped
steps: Cook the bacon in a big pot over medium heat for 5 minutes. Ask an adult to help.
Add the onion and cook for 5 minutes, then the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the greens a handful at a time, stirring as they wilt.
Add the broth, vinegar, sugar, red pepper flakes and salt.
Cover and simmer for 45 to 60 minutes, until very tender.

recipes.name: Quick refrigerator pickles
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) small pickling cucumbers, sliced into spears or rounds
2 teaspoons dill seed or 4 sprigs fresh dill
steps: Pack the cucumbers, garlic and dill into a clean quart jar.
Heat the vinegar, water, sugar and salt in a pot, stirring, until dissolved. Ask an adult to help.
Pour the hot brine over the cucumbers so they are covered.
Let cool for 15 minutes, then put the lid on.
Chill for 2 hours. They taste even better the next day and keep for 2 weeks.

recipes.name: Pickled red onions
steps: Have an adult slice the onion into thin rings.
Pack the onion into a jar.
Stir the vinegar, warm water, sugar and salt until dissolved.
Pour it over the onions.
Let sit for 30 minutes, until bright pink. Keep in the fridge for up to 2 weeks. Great on tacos.

recipes.name: Korean seasoned spinach
ingredients: 1 teaspoon soy sauce, or 1/2 teaspoon salt
steps: Bring a pot of water to a boil. Ask an adult to help.
Add the spinach and cook for 30 seconds, until just wilted.
Drain and rinse in cold water.
Squeeze out as much water as you can with your hands.
Toss with the soy sauce, garlic, sesame oil, sesame seeds and green onion.

recipes.name: Deviled eggs
ingredients: 1 teaspoon pickle juice or white vinegar
Paprika and chopped chives to top
steps: Put the eggs in a pot and cover with cold water by 1 inch.
Bring to a boil, then turn off the heat, cover and let sit for 12 minutes. Ask an adult to help.
Move the eggs to a bowl of ice water for 10 minutes.
Peel the eggs and cut them in half lengthwise.
Pop the yolks into a bowl and mash with the mayo, mustard, pickle juice, salt and pepper.
Spoon or pipe the yolk mix back into the whites.
Sprinkle with paprika and chives. Keep in the fridge.

recipes.name: Hot spinach artichoke dip
ingredients: 1 can (14 oz / 400 g) artichoke hearts, drained and chopped
10 oz (285 g) frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed dry
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Squeeze the spinach in a clean towel until no more water comes out.
Stir the cream cheese, sour cream, mayo, parmesan, half the mozzarella and the garlic until smooth.
Stir in the artichokes, spinach and salt.
Spread in a small baking dish and top with the rest of the mozzarella.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until bubbly and golden.
Serve warm with tortilla chips, pita chips or bread.

recipes.name: Queso dip
ingredients: 8 oz (225 g) white American cheese from the deli, torn
1 can (4 oz / 115 g) diced green chiles
steps: Melt the butter in a pot over medium low heat and whisk in the flour for 1 minute. Ask an adult to help.
Slowly whisk in the milk and cook for 2 to 3 minutes, until a little thick.
Add the cheeses a handful at a time, stirring until melted and smooth.
Stir in the green chiles, cumin and garlic powder.
Serve warm with tortilla chips. Stir in a splash of milk if it gets thick.

recipes.name: Seven layer dip
ingredients: 1 cup (260 g) salsa, drained a little
1/4 cup sliced black olives and 2 sliced green onions
steps: Stir the refried beans and taco seasoning and spread in a 9 inch dish.
Spread the sour cream over the beans.
Spread the guacamole on top, then the salsa.
Sprinkle on the cheese and lettuce.
Top with olives and green onions.
Serve with tortilla chips, or chill for up to 4 hours.

recipes.name: Buffalo chicken dip
ingredients: 2 cups (250 g) shredded cooked chicken, like rotisserie chicken
1/2 cup (120 ml) ranch or blue cheese dressing
1 cup (115 g) shredded cheddar or mozzarella
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Stir the cream cheese, dressing and hot sauce until smooth.
Stir in the chicken and half the cheese.
Spread in a small baking dish and top with the rest of the cheese.
Bake for 20 minutes, until hot and bubbly.
Serve with celery, crackers or tortilla chips.

recipes.name: French onion dip
steps: Chop the onions small. Ask an adult to help with the knife.
Melt the butter in a pan over medium low heat and add the onions and salt.
Cook for 25 to 30 minutes, stirring now and then, until soft and deep golden brown.
Let cool for 15 minutes.
Stir the onions into the sour cream, mayo, garlic powder, Worcestershire and pepper.
Chill for 1 hour. Serve with potato chips.

recipes.name: Baba ganoush
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Ask an adult to help.
Poke the eggplant all over with a fork and put it on a lined baking sheet.
Roast for 40 to 45 minutes, turning once, until it collapses and is very soft.
Let cool for 15 minutes, then cut it open and scoop the flesh into a strainer to drain for 5 minutes.
Mash the eggplant with the tahini, lemon juice, garlic and salt.
Spread in a bowl, drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with parsley.
Serve with pita.

recipes.name: Fluffy fruit dip
ingredients: Fruit to dip: strawberries, apple slices, grapes, pineapple
steps: Beat the cream cheese until smooth.
Beat in the marshmallow creme and zest until fluffy.
Spoon into a bowl and serve with fruit. Keep in the fridge.

recipes.name: Trail mix
ingredients: 1 cup (145 g) roasted peanuts or almonds
steps: Put everything in a big bowl.
Stir to mix.
Scoop 1/2 cup into small bags for each serving.
Store in a sealed container for up to 2 weeks.

recipes.name: Chewy granola bars
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Spread the oats and almonds on a baking sheet and toast for 10 minutes. Put them in a big bowl.
Line an 8 by 8 inch pan with parchment.
Heat the honey, butter and brown sugar in a pot until it bubbles, then simmer for 2 minutes, stirring.
Take it off the heat and stir in the peanut butter, vanilla and salt.
Pour over the oats and stir well.
Press firmly into the pan and let cool for 10 minutes, then press the chocolate chips on top.
Chill for 2 hours, then cut into 12 bars.

recipes.name: No-bake energy balls
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ground flax or chia seeds
steps: Stir everything together in a bowl.
Chill for 30 minutes so it is easier to roll.
Roll into 1 inch balls.
Keep in a sealed container in the fridge for up to a week.

recipes.name: Puppy chow
ingredients: 9 cups (about 270 g) rice or corn Chex cereal
steps: Put the cereal in a very big bowl.
Microwave the chocolate chips, peanut butter and butter for 1 minute, stir, then 30 seconds more until smooth.
Stir in the vanilla.
Pour over the cereal and gently stir until coated.
Put the cereal in a big zip bag with the powdered sugar, seal and shake until coated.
Spread on a tray to cool for 10 minutes.

recipes.name: Oven party mix
steps: Heat the oven to 250°F (120°C). Ask an adult to help.
Mix the cereals, nuts, pretzels and bagel chips in a big roasting pan.
Stir the butter, Worcestershire and spices together.
Pour over the mix and stir until coated.
Bake for 1 hour, stirring every 15 minutes.
Spread on paper towels to cool.

recipes.name: Caramel popcorn
ingredients: 12 cups (about 100 g) popped popcorn, from 1/2 cup kernels
steps: Heat the oven to 250°F (120°C). Ask an adult to help.
Put the popcorn in a big greased roasting pan and pick out any unpopped kernels.
Heat the brown sugar, butter, corn syrup and salt in a pot, stirring, until it boils. An adult should do this, the caramel is very hot.
Boil for 4 minutes without stirring.
Take it off the heat and stir in the baking soda and vanilla. It will foam.
Pour over the popcorn and stir to coat.
Bake for 45 minutes, stirring every 15 minutes.
Spread on parchment to cool for 15 minutes, then break apart.

recipes.name: Kettle corn
steps: An adult should do this. Melted sugar and oil are very hot.
Heat the oil and 3 kernels in a big pot with a lid over medium high heat until the kernels pop.
Add the rest of the kernels and the sugar and stir quickly.
Cover and shake the pot all the time for 2 to 3 minutes, until the popping slows to 2 seconds apart.
Pour into a big bowl right away so the sugar does not burn.
Sprinkle with salt and toss. Let cool for 5 minutes, it clumps as it cools.

recipes.name: Furikake popcorn
steps: Put the popcorn in a big bowl.
Drizzle with the melted butter while tossing.
Sprinkle on the furikake and toss again.
Stir in the rice crackers.

recipes.name: Crispy roasted chickpeas
ingredients: 1 can (15 oz / 425 g) chickpeas, drained and rinsed
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Dry the chickpeas really well with a towel and pull off any loose skins.
Toss with the oil on a baking sheet.
Roast for 25 to 30 minutes, shaking the pan halfway, until crunchy.
Toss the hot chickpeas with the salt, paprika and garlic powder.
Let cool for 5 minutes. They get crunchier as they cool.

recipes.name: Kale chips
steps: Heat the oven to 300°F (150°C). Ask an adult to help.
Pull the kale leaves off the stems and tear into big chip size pieces.
Wash and dry them completely. Wet kale steams instead of crisps.
Toss with the oil and rub it into every leaf.
Spread in one layer on 2 baking sheets and sprinkle with salt.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until crisp but still green.
Sprinkle with parmesan.

recipes.name: Baked tortilla chips
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Brush both sides of the tortillas lightly with oil.
Stack them and cut into 6 wedges each.
Spread in one layer on 2 baking sheets and sprinkle with salt.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, flipping halfway, until crisp and golden.
Squeeze lime over the warm chips.

recipes.name: Pita chips
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Cut each pita into 8 wedges and pull the layers apart.
Toss with the oil, salt and garlic powder.
Spread in one layer on a baking sheet.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes, until golden and crisp.

recipes.name: Homemade cheese crackers
steps: Pulse the cheese, butter, flour and salt in a food processor until crumbly.
Add the water and pulse until a ball forms.
Wrap and chill for 30 minutes.
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Roll 1/8 inch thick and cut into 1 inch squares or fun shapes.
Poke a hole in the middle of each with a skewer and put them on a lined sheet.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until puffed and the edges are golden.

recipes.name: Pigs in a blanket
ingredients: 1 can (8 oz / 225 g) crescent roll dough
24 cocktail sausages, or 8 hot dogs cut in thirds
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Ask an adult to help.
Unroll the dough and split it into 8 triangles.
Cut each triangle into 3 thin strips.
Roll each sausage up in a strip, starting at the wide end.
Put them seam side down on a lined sheet and brush with egg.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until golden.
Serve warm with ketchup and mustard.

recipes.name: Mozzarella sticks
ingredients: 12 mozzarella string cheese sticks, cut in half
Vegetable oil for frying, or cooking spray for the air fryer
steps: Roll each cheese piece in flour, dip in egg, then roll in breadcrumbs.
Dip in egg and breadcrumbs a second time so the cheese cannot leak out.
Freeze for 1 hour. This keeps them from melting too fast.
An adult should fry. Heat 2 inches of oil to 350°F (175°C) and fry a few at a time for 1 to 2 minutes, until golden.
Or air fry at 400°F (200°C) for 6 to 7 minutes, sprayed with oil.
Drain on paper towels and serve right away with warm marinara.

recipes.name: Baked jalapeno poppers
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Wear gloves and have an adult cut the jalapenos in half lengthwise and scrape out the seeds. Do not touch your eyes.
Mix the cream cheese, cheddar, garlic powder and bacon.
Fill each pepper half and put them on a lined baking sheet.
Sprinkle with panko.
Bake for 20 minutes, until the filling is bubbly and golden.
Let cool for 5 minutes.

recipes.name: Tomato bruschetta
ingredients: 1 garlic clove, minced, plus 1 whole clove for rubbing
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Dice the tomatoes. Ask an adult to help with the knife.
Stir the tomatoes, minced garlic, basil, 2 tablespoons oil, vinegar and salt. Let sit for 10 minutes.
Brush the bread with the rest of the oil and put it on a baking sheet.
Toast for 6 to 8 minutes, until golden.
Rub the warm toasts with the cut whole garlic clove.
Spoon the tomatoes on top just before serving.

recipes.name: Caprese skewers
steps: Thread a tomato, a folded basil leaf and a mozzarella ball onto each skewer.
Lay them on a plate.
Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic glaze.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper.

recipes.name: Cheesy stuffed mushrooms
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Ask an adult to help.
Wipe the mushrooms clean and pull out the stems. Chop the stems small.
Cook the stems and garlic in the oil in a pan over medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes. Ask an adult to help.
Mix the cooked stems with the cream cheese, parmesan, breadcrumbs, parsley and salt.
Stuff each mushroom cap and put them on a baking sheet.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes, until golden and juicy.

recipes.name: Salted edamame
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) frozen edamame in pods
Optional: 1 teaspoon soy sauce and 1 minced garlic clove warmed in 1 teaspoon sesame oil
steps: Bring a pot of water to a boil. Ask an adult to help.
Add the edamame and boil for 4 to 5 minutes, until hot and tender.
Drain well.
Toss with the flaky salt, or the garlic and soy mix.
Squeeze the beans out of the pods with your teeth. Do not eat the pods.

recipes.name: Ants on a log
ingredients: 1/2 cup (130 g) peanut butter or sunflower seed butter
steps: Wash the celery and cut each stalk into 3 pieces with a butter knife.
Spread peanut butter into the groove of each piece.
Press a row of raisins on top like ants.

recipes.name: Apple nachos
steps: Have an adult core and thinly slice the apples.
Toss the slices with lemon juice so they stay white and spread them on a plate.
Microwave the peanut butter for 15 seconds so it drizzles.
Drizzle the peanut butter and caramel over the apples.
Sprinkle with chocolate chips and granola.

recipes.name: Oven s'mores
ingredients: 2 milk chocolate bars (1.55 oz / 44 g each), broken into pieces
steps: Turn on the oven broiler and put the rack near the top. Ask an adult to help.
Lay 8 cracker squares on a baking sheet and put chocolate and a marshmallow on each.
Broil for 1 to 2 minutes, watching the whole time, until the marshmallows are golden.
Press the other cracker squares on top.
For one in the microwave, heat the cracker, chocolate and marshmallow for 15 seconds.

recipes.name: Cinnamon sugar tortilla chips
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Mix the sugar and cinnamon.
Brush the tortillas with melted butter and sprinkle with cinnamon sugar.
Cut each into 8 wedges with a pizza cutter.
Spread on 2 baking sheets in one layer.
Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until crisp.
Serve with fruit salsa or fruit dip.

recipes.name: Chocolate covered pretzels
ingredients: 8 oz (225 g) milk or white chocolate, chopped
steps: Line a tray with parchment.
Microwave the chocolate and coconut oil for 30 seconds at a time, stirring, until smooth.
Dip each pretzel with a fork, tap off the extra and lay it on the tray.
Add sprinkles right away.
Chill for 15 minutes, until set.

recipes.name: Cinnamon candied pecans
steps: Heat the oven to 250°F (120°C). Ask an adult to help.
Whisk the egg white and water until frothy.
Toss the pecans in the egg white until coated.
Mix the sugar, cinnamon and salt and toss with the pecans.
Spread on a lined baking sheet.
Bake for 1 hour, stirring every 15 minutes.
Let cool for 10 minutes, then break apart.

recipes.name: Party cheese ball
steps: Beat the cream cheese, cheddar, garlic powder, Worcestershire and green onions until mixed.
Scoop onto plastic wrap and shape into a ball.
Wrap and chill for 1 hour, until firm.
Roll the ball in the pecans.
Serve with crackers.

recipes.name: Pizza pinwheels
ingredients: 1/2 cup (120 ml) pizza sauce, plus more to dip
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Roll the dough into a 12 by 16 inch rectangle on a floured counter.
Spread with the sauce, leaving a 1 inch border on one long side.
Sprinkle with cheese, pepperoni and Italian seasoning.
Roll up from the long side and pinch the seam closed.
Cut into 12 slices and put them cut side up in a greased muffin pan or on a lined sheet.
Bake for 15 to 18 minutes, until golden and bubbly.
Serve with warm sauce to dip.

recipes.name: Tortilla pinwheels
ingredients: 1/4 cup finely diced red bell pepper
steps: Mix the cream cheese, ranch seasoning, cheddar, bell pepper and green onions.
Spread a thin layer over each tortilla all the way to the edges.
Lay turkey slices on top.
Roll each tortilla up tight and wrap in plastic.
Chill for 1 hour.
Trim the ends and cut into 1 inch slices.

recipes.name: Cucumber cream cheese bites
steps: Cut the cucumber into 1/4 inch rounds. Ask an adult to help with the knife.
Mix the cream cheese, dill and garlic powder.
Spread or pipe a little on each cucumber round.
Top with half a cherry tomato and a pinch of salt and pepper.

recipes.name: Bhel puri
steps: Boil the potato for 15 to 20 minutes, until soft. Ask an adult to help. Let cool, then peel and dice.
Chop the onion and tomato small.
Mix the potato, onion, tomato and cilantro in a big bowl.
Add the chutneys, chaat masala and lemon juice and stir.
Add the puffed rice and most of the sev and toss quickly.
Top with the rest of the sev and eat right away before it gets soggy.

recipes.name: Potato samosas
ingredients: Dough: 2 cups (250 g) all-purpose flour, 1/2 teaspoon salt, 1/4 cup (60 ml) vegetable oil, 1/3 to 1/2 cup (80 to 120 ml) water
3 medium potatoes (1 lb / 450 g), boiled, peeled and diced small
steps: Rub the oil into the flour and salt, then add water a little at a time to make a stiff dough. Cover and rest for 30 minutes.
Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a pan and cook the cumin seeds and ginger for 30 seconds. Ask an adult to help.
Add the potatoes, peas, spices and salt and cook for 3 to 4 minutes. Stir in cilantro and let cool.
Split the dough into 6 balls, roll each into a 7 inch oval and cut in half.
Fold each half into a cone, sealing the edge with water, fill with potato and pinch the top shut.
An adult should fry. Heat 2 inches of oil to 325°F (163°C).
Fry a few at a time for 10 to 12 minutes, turning, until golden and crisp. Low heat keeps the crust from bubbling.
Drain on paper towels. Serve with tamarind or mint chutney.

recipes.name: Vegetable pakoras
steps: Have an adult slice the onion and potato thinly.
Whisk the flours, salt and spices with enough water to make a thick batter like pancake batter.
Stir in the vegetables until coated.
An adult should fry. Heat 2 inches of oil to 350°F (175°C).
Drop small spoonfuls into the oil and fry for 3 to 4 minutes, turning, until golden and crisp.
Drain on paper towels and serve with ketchup or mint chutney.

recipes.name: Scallion pancakes
ingredients: Dip: 2 tablespoons soy sauce and 1 tablespoon rice vinegar
steps: Have an adult pour the boiling water into the flour while you stir with chopsticks, then stir in cold water until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead for 5 minutes when cool enough to touch, cover and rest for 30 minutes.
Split into 4 balls. Roll one into a thin circle, brush with sesame oil and sprinkle with salt and scallions.
Roll it up like a rope, then coil the rope into a snail and flatten it into a 7 inch pancake.
Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a frying pan over medium heat. Ask an adult to help.
Fry for 2 to 3 minutes per side, until golden and crisp.
Cut into wedges and serve with the dip.

recipes.name: Baked apple chips
steps: Heat the oven to 225°F (110°C). Ask an adult to help.
Have an adult core the apples and slice them very thin, about 1/8 inch, with a mandoline or sharp knife.
Lay the slices in one layer on 2 parchment-lined baking sheets.
Sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar.
Bake for 1 hour, flip the slices, then bake for 1 hour more, until dry.
Turn off the oven and let them cool inside. They crisp up as they cool.

recipes.name: Strawberry fruit leather
steps: Heat the oven to 200°F (95°C). Ask an adult to help.
Blend the strawberries, honey and lemon juice until very smooth.
Line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment or a silicone mat.
Spread the puree evenly about 1/8 inch thick.
Bake for 3 to 4 hours, until it is no longer sticky in the middle.
Let cool for 20 minutes, then cut into strips with scissors, paper and all, and roll up.

recipes.name: Banana sushi
ingredients: 2 tablespoons peanut butter or sunflower seed butter
2 tablespoons crispy rice cereal or granola
steps: Peel the banana and spread the peanut butter all over it.
Roll it in the cereal so it sticks.
Drizzle with honey.
Cut into 1 inch pieces with a butter knife, like sushi rolls.

recipes.name: Puff pastry cheese straws
ingredients: 1 sheet (about 9 oz / 245 g) puff pastry, thawed
1 cup (100 g) finely grated parmesan or cheddar
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Unfold the pastry on a floured counter and brush with egg.
Sprinkle with the cheese and paprika and press it in with a rolling pin.
Cut into 1/2 inch strips with a pizza cutter.
Twist each strip a few times and lay it on a lined baking sheet.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until puffed and golden.

recipes.name: Sausage rolls
ingredients: 1 sheet (about 9 oz / 245 g) puff pastry, thawed
1 lb (450 g) pork sausage meat, casings removed
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Mix the sausage, onion, breadcrumbs and thyme with clean hands. Wash your hands after touching raw meat.
Cut the pastry in half lengthwise.
Shape the sausage into 2 long logs and lay one down the middle of each strip.
Brush one edge with egg, fold the pastry over and press with a fork to seal.
Cut each log into 6 pieces and put them on a lined sheet. Brush with egg.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, until deep golden and the sausage reaches 160°F (71°C) inside.

recipes.name: Pimento cheese
ingredients: 1 jar (4 oz / 115 g) diced pimentos, drained
steps: Beat the cream cheese and mayo until smooth.
Stir in the cheddar, pimentos, garlic powder and cayenne.
Chill for 30 minutes.
Serve with crackers and celery, or spread on sandwiches.

recipes.name: Mexican fruit cup
ingredients: 1 teaspoon chili lime seasoning like Tajin
steps: Have an adult help cut the fruit and vegetables into sticks and cubes.
Pile them into 4 cups.
Squeeze lime juice over the top.
Sprinkle with the chili lime seasoning and drizzle with chamoy.

recipes.name: Esquites
ingredients: 3 cups (450 g) corn kernels, fresh or frozen
2 tablespoons sour cream or Mexican crema
steps: Melt the butter in a big pan over medium high heat. Ask an adult to help.
Add the corn and cook for 5 to 6 minutes, stirring only now and then, until it has golden brown spots.
Take it off the heat and stir in the mayo, crema, most of the cotija, lime juice and salt.
Spoon into cups and top with the rest of the cotija, chili powder and cilantro.

recipes.name: Muhammara
ingredients: 1 cup (200 g) jarred roasted red peppers, drained
1 tablespoon pomegranate molasses, or 1 teaspoon honey with 1 teaspoon lemon juice
steps: Put everything in a food processor.
Pulse until mostly smooth with a little texture.
Taste and add salt or lemon if needed.
Serve with pita chips or vegetables.

recipes.name: Parmesan crisps
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon black pepper or Italian seasoning
1 tablespoon sesame seeds or chopped herbs (optional)
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Line a baking sheet with parchment.
Drop level tablespoons of cheese on the sheet 2 inches apart and pat into flat circles.
Sprinkle with pepper and seeds or herbs.
Bake for 5 to 7 minutes, until golden and lacy.
Let cool for 5 minutes on the sheet so they crisp.

recipes.name: Baked potato chips
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Have an adult slice the potatoes very thin, about 1/16 inch, with a mandoline.
Rinse the slices in cold water, then dry them really well with towels.
Toss with the oil and lay in one layer on parchment-lined sheets.
Bake for 15 to 20 minutes, flipping halfway. Take off any chips that brown early.
Sprinkle with salt and let cool for 5 minutes to crisp.

recipes.name: Watermelon pizza
ingredients: 1 round slice of watermelon, 1 inch thick, from the middle
steps: Have an adult cut a 1 inch thick round slice from the middle of the watermelon.
Stir the yogurt and honey and spread it over the slice like sauce.
Top with berries, kiwi and mint.
Cut into 8 wedges like a pizza and eat right away.

recipes.name: Cowboy caviar
ingredients: 1 can (15 oz / 425 g) black beans, drained and rinsed
1 can (15 oz / 425 g) black-eyed peas, drained and rinsed
Dressing: 1/4 cup (60 ml) olive oil, 3 tablespoons red wine vinegar, 1 tablespoon lime juice, 1 tablespoon sugar, 1/2 teaspoon chili powder, 1/2 teaspoon salt
steps: Dice the pepper and onion. Ask an adult to help with the knife.
Put the beans, peas, corn, pepper, onion, tomatoes and cilantro in a big bowl.
Whisk the dressing and pour it over.
Stir and chill for 30 minutes.
Serve with tortilla chips or as a side.
